items.title: ベネズエラで約2年ぶりに全国抗議デモ、自由な選挙要求
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［カラカス／マラカイ（ベネズエラ）　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［カラカス／マラカイ（ベネズエラ）　２２日　ロイター］ - ベネズエラ各地で２２日、野党側による全国規模の抗議デモが約２年ぶりに行われ、数千人が自由な選挙の実施や政治の変革を求めて街頭に繰り出した。

米国は、１月に米軍がマドゥロ大統領を拘束して以降、ロドリゲス暫定大統領が率いる政権と緊密に協力している。トランプ米大統領とロドリゲス氏はいずれも選挙を実施すると述べているが、議会選、大統領選ともに日程は決まっていない。

ノーベル平和賞を受賞したベネズエラの野党指導者マリア・コリナ・マチャド氏は、結果を巡り争いとなった２０２４年の選挙後に潜伏生活を送った後、国外に出て間もなく１年になる。同氏は２７年７月までに選挙を実施する必要があると訴えている。

デモはマチャド氏率いる政治運動「ベンテ・ベネズエラ」が主催し、首都カラカスのほか、バレンシア、マラカイ、サンクリストバル、マラカイボなどで行われた。

野党の一派と暫定政権の間では、将来の選挙の公正さを確保するため、最高裁と選挙管理委員会の体制刷新を目指す協議が米国の支援の下で続いている。直近の協議は今月行われたが、改革には相当な時間がかかる可能性がある。

items.title: Singer Raye wins Mercury Prize for 'This Music May Contain Hope'
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Singer Raye won the Mercury Prize for her second studio album "This Music May Contain Hope" on Thursday, beating the likes of veteran Paul McCartney, rock band Suede and rapper Dave for the British music award.
items.body:
Singer Raye won the Mercury Prize for her second studio album "This Music May Contain Hope" on Thursday, beating the likes of veteran Paul McCartney, rock band Suede and rapper Dave for the British music award.
Judges praised the "scale, structure, ambition and sheer charm" of the 28-year-old chart-topper's 73-minute record, which blends jazz, orchestral pop, funk and other genres.
"Hope is a very cheesy word ... but hope is just something that we all need," Raye said while accepting the award at the ceremony held in the northern English city of Newcastle.
"Music is medicine, so I just hope as well that message comes across to anyone who needs it."
First handed out to rockers Primal Scream in 1992, the annual £25,000 ($33,495) Mercury Prize shortlists 12 albums released by British and Irish acts in the United Kingdom in the past year. It is considered less mainstream than the BRIT Awards, Britain's pop music honours, and is open to all music genres.
This year's contenders included McCartney, who was nominated for his album "The Boys of Dungeon Lane", and past winners Suede and Dave, who were shortlisted for their respective records "Antidepressants" and "The Boy Who Played The Harp".
The nominees also included singer Olivia Dean for "The Art of Loving", former Little Mix star Jade for "That’s Showbiz Baby!", and producer Nia Archives, who was recognised for "Emotional Junglist".
Band Knats, musicians Kojey Radical and Dove Ellis were also in the running for their respective records "A Great Day In Newcastle", "Don't Look Down" and "Blizzard".
Florence + the Machine's "Everybody Scream" and "Help (2)", a compilation album by various artists for War Child, completed the list.
Rocker Sam Fender won the prize last year for his third album "People Watching".
($1 = £0.7464)

items.title: 'Slow down': Hamilton jokes to champion-in-waiting Antonelli
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: Lewis Hamilton had one piece of advice for Kimi Antonelli as the 20-year-old Mercedes driver stands on the verge of becoming Formula One's youngest ever champion: "Slow down!"
items.body:
Lewis Hamilton had one piece of advice for Kimi Antonelli as the 20-year-old Mercedes driver stands on the verge of becoming Formula One's youngest ever champion: "Slow down!"
The Italian would have to win the US Grand Prix and have everything else fall his way for the title to be secured in Austin on Sunday but, with a lead of 102 points and a maximum 150 still to be won, he can be sure it is just a matter of time.
Hamilton, winner of seven championships and the most successful driver in the history of the sport, left no doubt he was joking.
"He doesn't need any advice. I think he's shown this year, and also last year, but particularly this year, his talent and his ability, his calmness and his approach," said the Ferrari driver of the man who replaced him at Mercedes last season.
"He's done an amazing job this year, and I'm so proud of him. I'm so proud of the way he's carried himself, how he interacts with the drivers and even with you guys," he told reporters on Thursday. "It's great to see him and the team excel. If it's not my team, I'd always want to see my old team do well."
Antonelli would be the first Italian to take the title since Alberto Ascari in 1953 and, while professing to be taking one race at a time, he knows what awaits.
"It definitely is crazy if you think about it, but that's why I won't think about it," he said of the possibility that he could be champion already on Sunday with five races to spare as the calendar stands.
"I've heard that something catastrophic needs to happen to the others for me to become champion (in Austin). For me, it needs to be a perfect weekend. The others need to have a poor result, which is unlikely to happen," he added.
Antonelli said following in Hamilton's footsteps as a champion as well as a Mercedes driver would be a dream come true, but also made clear he was prepared to wait.
"Obviously, I'm in an incredible position... But, of course, I still have to keep going, and the mindset is always the same: whenever I go on track, I want to be at the top and try to win as much as possible, whether I win the championship this weekend, next weekend or in Brazil. Let's see," he said.

items.title: Deckers results show aggressive discounts from rivals are hitting premium brands
items.author: Sanskriti Shekhar
items.creator: Sanskriti Shekhar
items.summary: Deckers Outdoor , the maker of UGG boots and Hoka sneakers, said aggressive discounting by rivals hurt its sales in the second quarter, highlighting challenges facing premium footwear brands as shoppers grow more selective.
items.body:
Deckers Outdoor (DECK.N) , the maker of UGG boots and Hoka sneakers, said aggressive discounting by rivals hurt its sales in the second quarter, highlighting challenges facing premium footwear brands as shoppers grow more selective.
Shares of the company fell 8% in extended trading after the results. Here are more details:
The footwear maker reported sales of $1.48 billion, [USN:L1N46819K TEXT:"missing"] analysts' estimate of $1.51 billion, but reported a 27% rise in profit for the quarter ended September 30
"In the US, we saw promotional activity increase throughout the quarter, particularly in athletic footwear, which weighed on our US e-commerce performance as we maintained full-price discipline," CEO Stefano Caroti said on the company's earnings call
Comparable direct-to-consumer sales fell 6.4% in the second quarter
"There is a heightened focus on revenues over margins," said Simeon A. Siegel, analyst at CFA
"Share declines were evident across every household income bracket, including higher-income consumers, highlighting the challenges facing even premium brands as shoppers become more selective," said Michael Gunther, analyst at Consumer Edge
Deckers continues to grapple with intense competition in the athletic footwear market, including from larger rivals such as Nike (NKE.N)
"Where we potentially lose share to others are the more compressed price points below $120, where the competition is greater," CEO Caroti said
"We will continue to prioritize margin preservation and long-term value over chasing potential incremental near-term revenue that could dilute our brands," he added

items.title: Fondo soberano de Noruega pierde 0,5% por caída de bonos y alerta por deuda global
items.author: Heidi Taksdal Skjeseth
items.summary: El fondo de US$2,3 billones registró pérdidas en renta fija por el alza de las tasas de interés. Norges Bank Investment Management propone reducir el peso de los bonos gubernamentales en su cartera.
items.body: Bloomberg — El fondo soberano de Noruega, valorado en US$2,3 billones, registró una pérdida del 0,5% en el tercer trimestre, lastrado por su cartera de bonos, ya que el crecimiento de la deuda mundial supone un motivo de preocupación para el inversionista. Una rentabilidad del 0,5% en renta variable no fue suficiente para compensar una pérdida del 3,5% en renta fija para el mayor fondo del planeta, gestionado por Norges Bank Investment Management (NBIM), de acuerdo un comunicado publicado este jueves, que citó el alza de las tasas de interés como motivo. Se trata de la segunda pérdida trimestral en los últimos tres trimestres. “La deuda pública se ha convertido en un fenómeno más global”, declaró Trond Grande, subdirector ejecutivo, en una entrevista. “Antes se concentraba en unos pocos países”, pero “ahora es un fenómeno más generalizado”. Ver más: Fondo soberano de Noruega mantuvo acciones turcas pese a investigaciones por manipulación bursátil Para un inversor a largo plazo, el consiguiente aumento del riesgo se traduce en mayores rendimientos, lo cual es “algo positivo”, afirmó Grande, añadiendo que el deterioro de la confianza en las finanzas públicas es “sin duda” motivo de preocupación. Algo más de una cuarta parte del fondo soberano está invertida en renta fija. Un poco más de la mitad de esta cantidad está invertida en valores estadounidenses, confirmó Grande. Las pérdidas en las inversiones de renta fija ponen de manifiesto la difícil situación del fondo, cuyo mandato le exige mantener el 70% de sus inversiones en bonos en deuda soberana. Recientemente, NBIM presentó al gobierno una propuesta para reducir sus tenencias de bonos gubernamentales, incluidos los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense, al 50%. El inversor quiere aumentar sus tenencias de deuda de mayor riesgo y mejorar la rentabilidad. La medida se presentará al parlamento en el primer semestre del próximo año como parte de un informe anual que los legisladores revisan, según indicó Grande. “En realidad no hay urgencia en torno a este tipo de decisiones”, dado que se refieren a una visión estratégica a largo plazo y no a consideraciones tácticas a corto plazo, afirmó. El fondo invierte en más de 7.200 empresas en todo el mundo. Creado en la década de 1990, invierte la riqueza petrolera de Noruega en el extranjero. Ver más: El fondo soberano de Noruega propone uno de los mayores cambios de su historia: ¿de qué se trata? Su rentabilidad global fue 0,18 puntos porcentuales inferior al índice de referencia fijado por el Ministerio de Finanzas de Noruega. Dado el peso de las mayores compañías tecnológicas del mundo en los índices globales, entre las principales posiciones del fondo se encuentran Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ), Microsoft Corp. ( MSFT ), Apple Inc. ( AAPL ), Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ), Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ) y Meta Platforms Inc. ( META ), lo que hace que su rentabilidad sea cada vez más sensible a las fluctuaciones de las principales acciones del sector tecnológico y de la IA. La rentabilidad de medio punto porcentual en acciones contrasta fuertemente con la rentabilidad del 16% registrada en el segundo trimestre de este año. “Nada crece hacia el cielo. Después de un período de gran crecimiento durante muchos años, tener un trimestre con resultados prácticamente planos no es gran cosa”, dijo Grande, sin querer comentar si esto podría reflejar una futura caída de los mercados. Ver más: Los fondos soberanos más grandes del mundo y de América Latina, según IE University e ICEX “Obviamente, unos rendimientos más altos, sobre todo a largo plazo, no son buenos para las acciones”, afirmó. “Pero el crecimiento económico sigue siendo sólido”. El fondo obtuvo una rentabilidad del 0,4% en bienes inmuebles no cotizados y del 7,5% en infraestructuras de energías renovables no cotizadas. Su valor disminuyó en 670.000 millones de coronas durante el tercer trimestre. La apreciación de la corona redujo su valor en 472.000 millones de coronas, mientras que las pérdidas por inversiones ascendieron a 278.000 millones de coronas. Las entradas de capital al fondo, por un valor de 80.000 millones de coronas, impulsaron su valor. Estos resultados se dan a conocer mientras Noruega debate una reforma del marco ético del fondo tras la controversia surgida por sus inversiones en empresas vinculadas a la guerra de Gaza. Un comité designado por el gobierno presentó este mes propuestas para un nuevo marco, que ahora están en consulta pública. El gobierno planea presentar sus conclusiones al parlamento en la primavera de 2027. -Con la colaboración de Stephen Treloar. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: ＧＭ、米レアアース磁石工場との供給契約解除　仲裁手続きに
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Eric Onstad

[ロンドン ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Eric Onstad

[ロンドン ２２日 ロイター] - 米ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）が、電気自動車（ＥＶ）向けレアアース（希土類）磁石を製造する米工場との長期供給契約を解除し、双方が仲裁手続きに入っていることが、規制当局への提出書類と事情に詳しい関係者の話で分かった。ＧＭは同工場の最大の顧客だった。

今回の動きは、世界の永久磁石の約９０％を生産する中国への依存を減らし、国内でのレアアース生産を拡大しようとする欧米企業が直面する課題を浮き彫りにしている。

また、トランプ米大統領が２０２５年にホワイトハウスに復帰し、ＥＶに対する連邦政府の支援を削減して以降、米自動車業界を取り巻く環境がいかに変化したかも示している。

ドイツのバキュームシュメルツ（ＶＡＣ）は２３年、米サウスカロライナ州の新工場からＧＭのＥＶ向けに永久磁石を供給する長期契約を結んだ。

６月にＶＡＣを１９億ドルで買収することで合意したエナジー・フュエルズは米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）に先週提出した書類で、同工場の顧客が７月１日に供給契約を解除し、その数日後にＶＡＣがこの顧客に対する仲裁手続きを開始したと明らかにした。

エナジー・フュエルズは顧客名を公表していないが、ＧＭは今週のＳＥＣへの提出書類で、ＥＶ駆動用モーター部品の供給業者が「当社による戦略的調達契約の解除を受け、損害賠償を求める仲裁を申し立てた」と記した。契約を解除した理由は説明していない。

事情に詳しい関係者は、ＶＡＣの米子会社ｅ─ＶＡＣマグネティクスとの契約を解除した顧客がＧＭだと確認した。

ＧＭとエナジー・フュエルズは、仲裁手続きは非公開だとしてコメントを控えた。

ＶＡＣは昨年終盤、５億ドルを投じた米国の磁石工場を稼働させた。ＶＡＣのエリック・エッシェン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が昨年９月にロイターに語ったところによると、年間生産能力は２０００トン弱で、その９０％をＧＭに販売し、残りを米政府に供給する予定だった。

ＶＡＣの米子会社は、不当な契約解除を理由に仲裁で損害賠償を求めていると述べた。

Eric Onstad

[ロンドン ２２日 ロイター] - 米ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）が、電気自動車（ＥＶ）向けレアアース（希土類）磁石を製造する米工場との長期供給契約を解除し、双方が仲裁手続きに入っていることが、規制当局への提出書類と事情に詳しい関係者の話で分かった。ＧＭは同工場の最大の顧客だった。

今回の動きは、世界の永久磁石の約９０％を生産する中国への依存を減らし、国内でのレアアース生産を拡大しようとする欧米企業が直面する課題を浮き彫りにしている。

また、トランプ米大統領が２０２５年にホワイトハウスに復帰し、ＥＶに対する連邦政府の支援を削減して以降、米自動車業界を取り巻く環境がいかに変化したかも示している。

ドイツのバキュームシュメルツ（ＶＡＣ）は２３年、米サウスカロライナ州の新工場からＧＭのＥＶ向けに永久磁石を供給する長期契約を結んだ。

６月にＶＡＣを１９億ドルで買収することで合意したエナジー・フュエルズは米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）に先週提出した書類で、同工場の顧客が７月１日に供給契約を解除し、その数日後にＶＡＣがこの顧客に対する仲裁手続きを開始したと明らかにした。

エナジー・フュエルズは顧客名を公表していないが、ＧＭは今週のＳＥＣへの提出書類で、ＥＶ駆動用モーター部品の供給業者が「当社による戦略的調達契約の解除を受け、損害賠償を求める仲裁を申し立てた」と記した。契約を解除した理由は説明していない。

事情に詳しい関係者は、ＶＡＣの米子会社ｅ─ＶＡＣマグネティクスとの契約を解除した顧客がＧＭだと確認した。

ＧＭとエナジー・フュエルズは、仲裁手続きは非公開だとしてコメントを控えた。

ＶＡＣは昨年終盤、５億ドルを投じた米国の磁石工場を稼働させた。ＶＡＣのエリック・エッシェン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が昨年９月にロイターに語ったところによると、年間生産能力は２０００トン弱で、その９０％をＧＭに販売し、残りを米政府に供給する予定だった。

ＶＡＣの米子会社は、不当な契約解除を理由に仲裁で損害賠償を求めていると述べた。

items.title: Estas son las costosas promesas electorales de Lula y Bolsonaro y las dudas sobre cómo pagarlas
items.author: Daniel Carvalho, Martha Beck
items.summary: A días de la segunda vuelta presidencial del 25 de octubre, ambos candidatos proponen ayudas sociales, condonaciones de deuda y beneficios fiscales, mientras persisten las dudas sobre cómo financiarán ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Transporte público gratis durante los fines de semana. Reembolso en efectivo de las facturas de energía y otros servicios a través de un sistema de pago instantáneo. Condonación de la deuda para millones de pequeños empresarios. A unos días de la segunda vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales de Brasil, y con la contienda técnicamente empatada, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva y Flávio Bolsonaro están haciendo costosas promesas con el fin de atraer a los votantes indecisos, aunque ofrecen pocos detalles sobre cómo las financiarían. La generosidad en campaña choca con uno de los principales retos a los que se enfrentará quienquiera que gane este 25 de octubre: estabilizar la deuda pública de Brasil. Ver más: Elecciones Brasil 2026: Flávio Bolsonaro pierde ventaja frente a Lula en las encuestas para la segunda vuelta Desde la primera vuelta, celebrada a inicios de este mes, Lula ha presentado propuestas cuyo coste se estima en más de 50.000 millones de reales (US$10.000 millones) en los próximos años, al tiempo que se compromete a mantener la disciplina fiscal. En tanto que Bolsonaro promete recortes generalizados en el gasto, aunque todavía no ha especificado en qué ámbitos se aplicarían, al tiempo que propone un alza de las pensiones, desgravaciones fiscales y un programa de reembolso para los consumidores. Para los inversionistas, la cuestión ya no se centra tanto en qué candidato parece más responsable desde el punto de vista fiscal, sino más bien en qué promesas electorales se mantendrán una vez finalizadas las elecciones. Quienquiera que gane tendrá mucho que aclarar porque, como señala Adriana Dupita, de Bloomberg Economics, “sencillamente no hay margen fiscal para todos esos programas” sin una subida de impuestos que ninguno de los candidatos parece dispuesto ni capaz de llevar a cabo. “Dar marcha atrás en las promesas electorales molestará a los votantes; no hacerlo, molestará a los inversionistas; y existe un riesgo considerable de que una solución de compromiso acabe acortando cualquier luna de miel, con los mercados bajo presión y la popularidad mermando al inicio del nuevo mandato presidencial”, afirmó Dupita. Ver más: ¿Momento de invertir en Brasil? Lo que debe saber previo a la victoria de Bolsonaro o Lula A continuación se enumeran las principales promesas, y las más costosas, que Lula y Bolsonaro han presentado durante las últimas tres semanas: El Gobierno ha adelantado el calendario de pagos de este mes del programa Bolsa Família, el programa estrella de bienestar social de Brasil. Las prestaciones, que Lula aumentó en un 15%, llegan a todos los beneficiarios que cumplan los requisitos el miércoles, en lugar de a finales de mes. El Gobierno ha señalado que estos pagos anticipados constituyen una medida de precaución ante los riesgos derivados de El Niño. Lula anunció la cancelación de las deudas contraídas con el Gobierno federal por los denominados microempresarios que se han visto en situación de morosidad. El plan incluye también un programa de compra de las deudas de los microempresarios y subvenciones de hasta 5.000 reales (US$995.00) para ayudarles a mejorar sus negocios. Lula anunció una ampliación de su programa de ayudas económicas a los estudiantes para incluir a los universitarios. Aquellos que cumplan los requisitos recibirían un total de 9.500 reales (US$1.890) a lo largo de cuatro años, con un coste de 4.600 millones de reales (US$915,2 millones) al año. Este miércoles, Lula remitió al Congreso una propuesta que exigiría que al menos el 26,8% de las enmiendas parlamentarias, fondos que los diputados destinan a proyectos en sus estados de origen, se utilicen para ofrecer transporte público gratuito los fines de semana. El Gobierno afirma que esto supondría un coste de hasta 12.000 millones de reales (US$2.387,5 millones) al año, financiado con fondos procedentes de las enmiendas presupuestarias del Congreso. La Asociación Nacional de Empresas de Transporte Urbano de Brasil estima que el coste ascendería a 20.800 millones de reales (US$4.138,3 millones) anuales. Ver más: Bolsonaro gana poder en Brasil y pone en alerta al Supremo por posibles destituciones Bolsonaro se ha comprometido a crear un fondo de 3 billones de reales (US$597.181 millones) denominado SOS Brasil, financiado con los ingresos del petróleo, los ingresos procedentes de titulizaciones y la venta de activos inmobiliarios del Estado. Según ha declarado, el fondo compraría la deuda de particulares y empresas y la refinanciaría en condiciones más favorables. Bolsonaro afirmó este martes que reactivaría un programa de incentivos fiscales para empresas de turismo y eventos que su padre, el expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, creó para apoyar a las empresas durante la pandemia. El Gobierno de Lula puso fin a la iniciativa en 2025, alegando su elevado coste fiscal y los indicios de irregularidades en la misma. Daniella Marques, coordinadora de política económica de la campaña, se comprometió este martes a que Bolsonaro crearía un programa para devolver a los consumidores una parte de lo que gastan en costes energéticos y otras facturas. La devolución se realizaría a través de Pix, el popular sistema de pagos instantáneos de Brasil, aunque no facilitó detalles sobre cómo funcionaría el programa ni cuánto costaría. -Con la colaboración de A ugusta Saraiva. items.title: Florida attorney general proposes bill that limits social media, AI features for teens in the state
items.author: Diana Jones
items.creator: Diana Jones
items.summary: Days after Florida lost its bid for a court order forcing Meta Platforms to overhaul Instagram and Facebook for teens in the state, its attorney general said he was proposing legislation that would force the company to make the same changes.
items.body:
Days after Florida lost its bid for a court order forcing Meta Platforms (META.O) to overhaul Instagram and Facebook for teens in the state, its attorney general said he was proposing legislation that would force the company to make the same changes.
Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier, a Republican, proposed the legislation, called the Safe Screens Act, on Thursday
The act, which would need to be introduced by a legislator, dictates changes for app stores, social media companies and AI chatbots
It would require app stores to verify user ages and direct social media platforms to implement two-hour time limits for teens and remove features like infinite scroll or autoplay unless parents enable them
It would also bar AI chatbots from simulating companionship with minors and sharing content about self-harm and suicide, among other changes
Florida is suing [USN:L6N44N0VA TEXT:"Meta"] and [USN:L6N429106 TEXT:"OpenAI"] over claims the companies have designed their platforms to be addictive to children
The state asked the judges overseeing [USN:L6N45K0T3 TEXT:"each"] [USN:L6N45T10H TEXT:"case"] for orders directing the companies to make changes to their platforms
On Sunday, the judge overseeing the Meta case rejected Florida’s request, saying it wasn’t appropriate to order the company to make major changes at the start of the case
The judge overseeing the OpenAI case has not yet ruled
Florida has a state law that bars users under the age of 14 from social media, which a US appeals court [USN:L6N4601B4 TEXT:"just upheld"]
A spokesperson for Meta did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Thursday

items.title: Lehman Says Diesel, Tariffs Have Been Devastating for Farmers
items.summary: Aaron Lehman, president of the Iowa Farmers Union and fifth-generation farmer in Polk County, Iowa, says both diesel prices and tariffs have been devastating for farmers. Lehman says farmers have not felt that an Iowa voice has been standing up for them in Washington and says that while farmers need relief, temporary measures do not address the underlying causes of their financial strain. Lehman says agriculture has a monopoly problem that leaves farmers especially vulnerable when fertilizer supplies are disrupted. Lehman says he finds President Donald Trump's deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to try to lower diesel costs disturbing. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: ATP roundup: Jiri Lehecka cruises into quarterfinals at Brussels
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Second-seeded Jiri Lehecka of Czechia served nine aces without a double fault while soaring to a 6-4, 6-2 victory over Belgium's Raphael Collignon in the BNP Paribas Fortis European Open at Brussels.
items.body:
Second-seeded Jiri Lehecka of Czechia served nine aces without a double fault while soaring to a 6-4, 6-2 victory over Belgium's Raphael Collignon in the BNP Paribas Fortis European Open at Brussels.
Lehecka won 26 of 30 (86.7%) first-serve points and had 24 winners against 14 unforced errors in the victory. He will next face Tallon Griekspoor of the Netherlands in the quarterfinals.
Fifth-seeded Alex Michelsen notched a 6-3, 6-4 victory over 35-year-old Belgian David Goffin, who played in the final singles match of his 18-year career. Goffin, the former world No. 7, had 23 winners and 32 unforced errors and was honored on the court after the match.
Michelsen will next face top-seeded Frenchman Arthur Fils, who won a walkover against Spain's Jaume Munar (back discomfort). In the other match, sixth-seeded Belgian Zizou Bergs beat Bosnian Damir Dzumhur 6-2, 6-4.
Grand Prix Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes
Second-seeded Taylor Fritz won 29 of 35 (82.9%) first-serve points while recording a 6-2, 7-5 victory over Frenchman Pierre-Hugues Herbert to advance to the quarterfinals at Lyon, France.
Fritz committed just 10 unforced errors, 19 fewer than Herbert. Fritz will next face Germany's Daniel Altmaier, who beat Croatia's Borna Gojo 6-3, 6-4.
Top-seeded Flavio Cobolli of Italy had a 22-10 edge in winners while dispatching Switzerland's Stan Wawrinka 6-2, 6-4. France's Luca Van Assche knocked off No. 3 Valentin Vacherot of Monaco 2-6, 6-4, 6-4, and No. 5 Brandon Nakashima sailed to a 6-4, 6-3 victory over Kyrian Jacquet of France.
Almaty Open
Top-seeded Daniil Medvedev of Russia had seven aces and saved all three break points he faced while recording a 6-2, 6-1 victory over Japan's Sho Shimabukuro to reach the quarterfinals in Kazakhstan.
Medvedev held a 20-9 edge in winners and won 25 of 31 (80.6%) first-serve points. Shimabukuro committed 21 unforced errors to Medvedev's 10.
Medvedev will next face Frenchman Terence Atmane, who knocked off Italy's Mattia Bellucci 6-7 (4), 7-6 (2), 7-6 (5). Also, No. 3 Alexander Bublik of Kazakhstan beat Hungary's Fabian Marozsan (illness) in a walkover and No. 5 Karen Khachanov of Russia outlasted Czechia's Thomas Machac 6-2, 4-6, 7-6 (7).
--Field Level Media

items.title: New York City bans horse-drawn carriages from June 2028
items.author: Maria Tsvetkova
items.creator: Maria Tsvetkova
items.summary: The New York City Council voted on Thursday to ban horse-drawn carriages from city streets and Central Park beginning in June 2028, ending a historic tourist attraction and long-standing industry.
items.body:
The New York City Council voted on Thursday to ban horse-drawn carriages from city streets and Central Park beginning in June 2028, [USN:L6N465056 TEXT:"ending a historic tourist attraction"] and long-standing industry.
Out of the city's 51 lawmakers, 40 supported the bill, which was backed by Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who earlier this month said the horse-drawn carriage industry would come to an end. Seven council members voted against it and two abstained.
Support for the ban grew after the death this summer of Romanch Mahajan, an 18-year-old tourist from India. Mahajan was thrown from a carriage and died on June 17, when the horse bolted after the driver stepped away to take a picture of Mahajan's family.
President Donald Trump , who has both attacked Mamdani and held cordial meetings with him, expressed skepticism about the ban.
"When there is a car accident in the area, of which there are many, they don't stop cars from entering the Park. So why would they stop the Carriages? It was a Great Tradition. Another piece of History that’s gone. It will be missed!" Trump, whose business empire is headquartered in Trump Tower, minutes from Central Park, wrote on Truth Social.
The bill requires the city to develop a transition plan for the workforce by April and to consider a program to compensate carriage operators for their businesses and help with the disposition of their horses. Under the proposal, the horses could not be slaughtered.
The day before the vote, the Transport Workers Union, which represents carriage business owners and drivers, said that if the bill is enacted, it will seek a temporary restraining order from a court "the minute the ink dries," according to a letter sent to New York City Corporation Counsel Steve Banks.
"This may be the first time in City history that a previously licensed profession was banned," the letter signed by principal attorney Arthur Schwartz said. "The proposed bill deprives the owner of all economically beneficial or productive use of their property."

items.title: 和平協議、ロシア・ウクライナ双方への安保確約軸に　プーチン氏主張
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［モスクワ　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［モスクワ　２２日　ロイター］ - ロシアのプーチン大統領は２２日、ウクライナ戦争の終結に向けた今後の協議では、ロシアとウクライナ双方に対する安全保障の確約と、欧州全体の安全保障の枠組みを議論の中心に据えるべきだと述べた。

米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使との会談翌日にロシアのテレビインタビューに応じ、米国仲介によるウクライナとの協議を１１月に再開する用意があると確認した。

プーチン氏は、ロシアは戦争を始めることを望んでいなかったが、自国が懸念する主要な問題についてウクライナから敵対的な反応を受けたとする従来の立場を改めて示した。

さまざまな問題について協議すれば前向きな結果につながる可能性があるとする一方、ロシアが求めているのは短期間の停戦ではなく、紛争を終結させる解決策だと強調。

「協議の目標は、短期間の一時的な停戦によってではなく、最終的な和平合意に達した後のウクライナとロシアの安全を確保することだ。この目標を達成するため、協議を再開する用意がある」と語った。

プーチン氏は、ウィットコフ氏も「欧州全体の安全保障の枠組み」にまで議論を広げる必要があると強調したと説明。「私もその点に同意する。今後数日間の展開を見てみよう」と述べた。

プーチン氏は２１日、ウィットコフ氏と会談後、ウクライナ和平に向けた米国仲介の協議を来月にも再開することで合意。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領も同日、ロシア、米国、ウクライナの実務レベル協議を早期に開催するとの米国の提案を支持すると表明した。 

ウクライナ戦争を巡る争点の多くは領土に関するもので、ロシアはウクライナ東部ドンバス地域の全域を割譲するよう要求している。ウクライナ側は、現在支配している領土の放棄を一切拒否している。

プーチン氏は、ウクライナ東部の領土に関するいかなる議論でも、同地域が「歴史的にロシアの土地」であるという自身の主張を考慮する必要があると述べた。

その上で、ロシアが侵攻を開始してから７カ月後に実施された住民投票で、同地域の住民はロシアへの編入を支持したと指摘。「まず、この問題に関する私の立場は、ここは彼らの領土ではないということだ。歴史的にロシアの領土だ」と語った。

items.title: Farkas Says Starlink Slowdown Helped the Russians
items.summary: Evelyn Farkas, McCain Institute executive director and former deputy assistant secretary of defense for Russia, Ukraine and Eurasia, says it's a moral problem for the US that Starlink speeds were slowed while Ukrainians were trying to intercept missiles and drones targeting civilians. Farkas says Russian President Vladimir Putin continues to signal openness to negotiations while maintaining his maximalist claims and continuing attacks on Ukrainians. Farkas says Putin is trying to get European countries to stop supporting Ukraine and says a diesel deal with President Donald Trump came out of a call between the two leaders. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Vantagem de Flávio sobre Lula diminui para 47% a 46%, mostra Datafolha
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A vantagem numérica do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) sobre o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) diminuir mais uma vez no segundo turno da disputa pelo Planalto, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha divulgada nesta quinta-feira, ainda que as variações registradas estejam dentro da margem de erro.
items.body:
A vantagem numérica do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) sobre o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) diminuir mais uma vez no segundo turno da disputa pelo Planalto, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha divulgada nesta quinta-feira, ainda que as variações registradas estejam dentro da margem de erro.
Flávio segue com 47% das intenções de voto, enquanto Lula passou a 46%, um ponto percentual a mais que no levantamento anterior. Como a margem de erro da pesquisa é de 2 pontos percentuais, os dois candidatos continuam em situação de empate técnico.
Os indecisos se mantiveram em 2%, enquanto aqueles que dizem que votarão em branco, anularão o voto ou não votarão em nenhum candidato agora chegam a 5% (eram 6%).
Em votos válidos, quando não são considerados os votos brancos e nulos e os indecisos, os dois candidatos estão empatados numericamente em 50%. Na semana passada, o placar era 51% a 49%.
Flávio venceu o primeiro turno da disputa pelo Planalto no início do mês com 47,03% dos votos válidos, contra 45,16% de Lula. O segundo turno será realizado no domingo.

items.title: Tunisian police clash with protesters in capital on day of heightened tensions
items.author: Tarek Amara
items.creator: Tarek Amara
items.summary: Tunisian police fired tear gas to disperse protesters in Ettadhamen, a suburb of the capital, after the death of a man detained on suspicion of drug dealing, amid clashes with police in two towns in southern Tunisia.
items.body:
Tunisian police fired tear gas to disperse protesters in Ettadhamen, a suburb of the capital, after the death of a man detained on suspicion of drug dealing, amid clashes with police in two towns in southern Tunisia.
The conflicts on Thursday coincide with a deepening economic, social and political crisis in the country, heightening fears of a wider wave of violent protests as anger grows over deteriorating living conditions and poor public services.
The man's family said he died as a result of violence by police officers after his arrest, calling for the circumstances of his death to be clarified and those responsible to be held accountable. Local media, however, reported that he died after swallowing drugs. The interior ministry was not immediately available for comment.
Protesters blocked roads, burned tyres and threw stones at police. Security forces responded by firing tear gas, while seeking to secure a National Guard station in the area.
Earlier on Thursday, police clashed with protesters in the southern town of Jebeniana following the death of a man who his relatives say died during a security chase. The city of Agareb, also in Sfax governorate, witnessed similar clashes.
In the city of Sfax, students protested on Thursday over the death of a female student who suffered a cardiac problem. Her colleagues said ambulance personnel took too long to arrive, citing a lack of medical facilities, and called for a strike at Sfax's faculties on Friday.
Thousands of Tunisians joined the [USN:L1N463047 TEXT:"largest protest"] against President Kais Saied in years in the capital on Saturday, accusing him of undermining democracy and mishandling the economy in a growing challenge to his rule.

items.title: ウクライナのスターリンク利用制限問題、米上院民主議員が調査開始
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - 米上院常設調査小委員会の民主党トップ、リチャード・ブルーメンソル議員は２２日、ウクライナ軍が米宇宙開発企業スペースＸの衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の軍事版「スターシールド」への重要なアクセスができなくなり、防衛能力が低下した問題について調査を開始したと明らかにした。

ブルーメンソル氏はヘグセス国防長官宛ての書簡で「１０月１３日夜、ウクライナ軍はスターシールドへの接続維持に必要な通信速度の上限が設定されたため、重要なアクセスを失った。こうした能力を変更する技術的・法的権限を誰が持つのか、またスペースＸのサービスが利用できなくなった場合に、国防総省が十分な代替手段を有しているのかという緊急の疑問が生じている」と述べた。

このサービス変更がホワイトハウス、国防総省、スペースＸのいずれの指示によるものだったのか、ブルーメンソル氏は情報提供を求めている。

現在の上院は共和党が多数派を占めているため、民主党には召喚状発付権限がなく、ブルーメンソル氏は政府内外の関係者に対して情報や説明を「要請」することしかできない。

ブルーメンソル氏は、今回の措置によってウクライナ軍と民間人が危険にさらされたほか「米政府が数十億ドルを投じて調達してきた重要な能力を誰が管理しているのか」という懸念も生じていると指摘した。

スターシールドは米国防総省が最大の顧客。国防総省報道官は「議会からの書簡には、他の案件と同様に直接回答する」とコメントした。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１４日、イーロン・マスク氏率いるスペースＸがスターリンクのサービスを制限し、ウクライナの防空能力が弱体化したと発言していた。

ブルーメンソル氏はヘグセス氏に対し、政府とスペースＸとの関係や同社技術への依存状況に関しても調査すると説明した。また書簡に盛り込んだ質問への回答期限を１１月５日、スターシールドの利用制限に関する知識を持つスペースＸ関係者による説明会の期限を１１月１２日に設定した。

１１月３日の中間選挙で民主党が上院の多数派を奪還した場合、ブルーメンソル氏が同小委員会の委員長に就任する見通しだ。

items.title: Flavio Bolsonaro and Lula about even ahead of Brazil runoff, Datafolha poll shows
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva are about even heading to Sunday's election runoff, a Datafolha poll showed on Thursday.
items.body:
Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva are about even heading to Sunday's election runoff, a Datafolha poll showed on Thursday.
The senator, the eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, would receive 47% of the vote compared with 46% for the president, according to the poll. Last week, a Datafolha poll [USN:L1N461163 TEXT:"showed the younger Bolsonaro"] at 47% and Lula at 45%.
The poll has a margin of error of plus or minus 2 percentage points.
5% of the respondents said they would cast a blank vote, and undecided voters made up 2%, the poll showed.
Datafolha surveyed 2,154 people between October 20-22.
The senator [USN:L6N45Q04L TEXT:"surprisingly led"] Lula in the first-round vote earlier this month.

[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日、石油の生産や精製、関連事業が国防に不可欠だと認定した。

トランプ氏はまた、冷戦時代に制定された国防生産法を発動した。これにより、こうした石油関連事業やパイプライン、エネルギー貯蔵の整備などに対し、財政的な優遇措置を講じることが可能になる。

items.title: Appeals court lifts block on Mississippi's DEI ban, ejects judge over AI errors
items.author: Mike Scarcella, Nate Raymond
items.creator: Mike Scarcella, Nate Raymond
items.summary: A federal appeals court on Thursday vacated a ruling that blocked Mississippi's ban on diversity, equity and inclusion programs in public schools, reassigning the case away from a district court judge who had acknowledged that a key ruling contained AI-generated errors.
items.body:
A federal appeals court on Thursday vacated a ruling that blocked Mississippi's ban on diversity, equity and inclusion programs in public schools, reassigning the case away from a district court judge who had acknowledged that a key ruling contained AI-generated errors.
The New Orleans-based 5th US Circuit Court of Appeals threw out the preliminary injunction against the state law and reassigned the civil rights lawsuit to a different district judge for further review.
The decision is a victory for Republican Mississippi Attorney General Lynn Fitch's office, which had argued that US District Judge Henry Wingate's apparent misuse of generative AI tools had compromised the integrity of the judicial process.
US Circuit Judge Jerry Smith, writing for the three-judge panel, took Wingate to task for a "botch job" that led to a ruling that contained "sloppy edicts" and "several factual assertions nowhere to be found in the record" and got the law wrong.
"The district court — or perhaps, being charitable, its AI agent — ignored and manipulated governing law, apparently to satisfy a policy agenda," Smith wrote.
The appeals court laid out detailed instructions for how the new judge should assess the law, which it said only applies to educators and not students. It also stressed that states also have broad power to regulate their own curricula and publicly funded speech.
Representatives for Fitch and the plaintiffs did not immediately respond to requests for comment, nor did Wingate’s office. Wingate and the judges on the appeals court panel are all Republican appointees.
State and federal courts have grappled with a wave of AI-generated [USN:L6N42B15L TEXT:"inaccuracies in filings"]. The cases have led to mounting concerns about the technology's role in the legal process, including whether and how judges are using AI programs to help craft opinions.
US courts do not have uniform rules about lawyers' use of AI, and the policies can [USN:L6N41A09S TEXT:"differ from one judge to another"] about their own use of the technology.
The case before the 5th Circuit concerned a challenge by teachers, professors, students and advocacy groups to a law Republican-led Mississippi enacted last year that bars government-run educational institutions from mandating activities like diversity training or promoting DEI.
The plaintiffs argued the law violated the US Constitution's First and Fourteenth Amendments, and convinced Wingate to issue a temporary restraining order blocking its implementation.
But that order was later found to contain fabricated names and nonexistent legal authorities, prompting scrutiny from Republican Senator Chuck Grassley, the current chairman of the Senate Judiciary Committee.
Wingate [USN:L1N3W40R4 TEXT:"in a subsequent letter"] told Grassley that the errors stemmed from a law clerk's unvetted use of the AI platform Perplexity. Even after the errors in that initial order, Wingate continued to block the law by issuing a preliminary injunction.
Lawyers for Mississippi [USN:L6N44S0X9 TEXT:"argued on appeal"] that even after Wingate replaced the faulty ruling, the AI-related errors cast doubt on the court's core legal reasoning, and they urged the appeals court to reassign the case.
Attorneys representing the teachers and civil rights advocates challenging the law had asked the appeals court to keep the case with Wingate, arguing that the AI use was a regrettable "shortcut" that did not affect the ultimate constitutionality of the state's DEI restrictions.
But Smith said the case "easily calls for reassignment." He said given the number of errors in Wingate's ruling, the judge might be tempted in future proceedings to want to unjustly find a way "to prove that, even with the correct law and fact, that his initial view should prevail."
The case is Jackson Federation of Teachers, et al, v Fitch, 5th US Circuit Court of Appeals, No. 25-60496.
For the plaintiffs: Robert McDuff of Mississippi Center for Justice
For the defendant: Anthony Shults of the Mississippi Attorney General's Office

items.title: Aerolíneas Argentinas volvió a registrar pérdidas por la suba del precio del combustible
items.author: Florencia Lendoiro
items.summary: La compañía aérea perdió US$63 millones en el primer semestre, tras dos años de resultados positivos. El aumento del precio del combustible aeronáutico le generó un sobrecosto superior a US$100 millon ...
items.body: Buenos Aires — Aerolíneas Argentinas volvió a registrar pérdidas durante el primer semestre de 2026, después de dos años consecutivos con resultados positivos. La compañía estatal cerró los primeros seis meses del año con un resultado negativo de US$63 millones (ARS$95.580 millones), afectada por el aumento del precio del combustible aeronáutico. Según explicó a Bloomberg Línea una persona con conocimiento directo del asunto, el encarecimiento del combustible por los conflictos bélicos en el mundo generó un sobrecosto superior a US$100 millones durante el semestre. No obstante, remarcó que la aerolínea pudo afrontar sus obligaciones con recursos propios, sin recurrir a nuevos aportes del Tesoro Nacional ni a financiamiento bancario. Incluso, agregó que al 30 de junio se terminó de cancelar el fideicomiso financiero Global ARSA, contratado en octubre de 2023 por US$100 millones. Previamente, sobre el fin de 2025, se habían liquidado todos los pagos pendientes de los leasings financieros de las 30 aeronaves que son propiedad de la compañía. VER MÁS: Aerolíneas Argentinas sigue en verde y pagará el impuesto a las Ganancias por primera vez en su historia Los datos de ejecución presupuestaria de la Secretaría de Hacienda muestran que los gastos corrientes de la compañía crecieron un 38,3% interanual, mientras que los ingresos aumentaron un 20,7%. Así, se registra un resultado económico negativo de ARS$95.580 millones, un déficit primario de ARS$185.091 millones y un resultado financiero negativo de ARS$193.095 millones durante los primeros seis meses de 2026. VER MÁS: YPF producirá combustible para aviones en Santa Fe: inversión de US$400 millones y acuerdo con TotalEnergies El precio del combustible JP-1, utilizado por los aviones comerciales, aumentó cerca del 90%, según advirtió la persona, que además estimó que, sin el encarecimiento del combustible, habría obtenido un EBIT positivo de aproximadamente US$25 millones. En cambio, el resultado operativo antes de intereses e impuestos (EBIT) resultó negativo en US$84 millones durante el primer semestre. El resultado antes de intereses, impuestos, depreciaciones, amortizaciones y alquileres de aeronaves (EBITDAR) fue positivo en US$64 millones. El impacto del combustible se concentró especialmente en los primeros meses del año, cuando el aumento de precios coincidió con el comienzo de la temporada baja y con pasajes vendidos antes de la suba de costos. El aumento afecta a toda la industria aerocomercial. Según las proyecciones de junio de la Asociación Internacional de Transporte Aéreo (IATA), las compañías aéreas gastarán US$350.000 millones en combustible durante 2026, frente a los US$252.000 millones de 2025. La entidad estimó un precio promedio anual de US$152 por barril de combustible aeronáutico, un 69% más que el año anterior. VER MÁS: ¿Por qué volar en Argentina sale más caro que en Chile? Lo que pagan las aerolíneas cada 1.000 km, según ALTA IATA también recortó sus previsiones de ganancias para el sector en 2026, de US$41.000 millones a US$23.000 millones, y redujo el margen neto esperado del 3,9% al 2%. La utilidad estimada por pasajero cayó a US$4,50, según las proyecciones publicadas en junio. El impacto alcanza a las principales aerolíneas internacionales. A fines de septiembre, de hecho, el CEO de Lufthansa, Carsten Spohr, advirtió que el sobrecosto de combustible del grupo alemán durante 2026 superará los 1.500 millones de euros que había estimado previamente, aunque no precisó una nueva cifra. Aerolíneas no recibe aportes del Tesoro desde mediados de 2024 y, según las previsiones de la empresa, tampoco espera necesitarlos durante lo que resta de 2026 ni en 2027. Según los datos, la aérea cumplió con sus vencimientos financieros durante el primer semestre sin refinanciarlos. En el primer semestre de 2023, el EBIT había sido negativo en aproximadamente US$266 millones, mientras que en igual período de 2024 la pérdida se redujo a US$44 millones. En los primeros seis meses de 2025, el indicador pasó a terreno positivo, con una ganancia operativa de US$66 millones, antes de volver a registrar pérdidas por US$84 millones este año. Esta semana, durante la convención anual de la Asociación Latinoamericana y del Caribe de Transporte Aéreo (ALTA), el presidente de Aerolíneas Argentinas, Fabián Lombardo, había destacado que la compañía había logrado incrementar su actividad y facturación con 2.200 empleados menos.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
＜為替＞ 円が１日としては約１カ月ぶりの大幅上昇となる見通し。株式市場の不安定な動きや中東での戦争長期化に伴う原油高、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資の将来の収益性に対する疑念を背景に、投資家が安全資産を求めた。

円は対ドルで０．７５％上昇し、１ドル＝１５６．９６円となった。

円相場の動きの一部は、重要な節目である１ドル＝１６０円に近づいていたことも背景にある可能性がある。この水準に近づくほど、日本当局が円を下支えするため再び介入する可能性が高まると見られている。

円やユーロなど主要通貨に対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．０８％低下し、１０１．６０。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 国債利回りが短期債から長期債まで大幅に低下した。ＡＩ（人工知能）成長の持続性を巡る懸念が再燃し、株式相場が下落したことを受け、安全資産と見なされる国債に買いが入った。

終盤の取引で、１０年債利回りは１９．３ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．９５３％。１日の低下幅としては２０２３年３月１０日以来の大きさとなる。１０年債利回りは１０月７日に５．３６４５％と、０２年４月以来の高水準を付けていた。

３０年債利回りは１５ｂｐ低下の５．２８７％。２４年８月以来の大幅な低下となる。

２年債利回りは１８．５ｂｐ低下の４．６３８％。２５年８月以来の大幅な低下となる。

写真はニューヨーク証券取引所の外にあるウォール街の道路標識。2021年7月、米ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

＜為替＞ 円が１日としては約１カ月ぶりの大幅上昇となる見通し。株式市場の不安定な動きや中東での戦争長期化に伴う原油高、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資の将来の収益性に対する疑念を背景に、投資家が安全資産を求めた。

円は対ドルで０．７５％上昇し、１ドル＝１５６．９６円となった。

円相場の動きの一部は、重要な節目である１ドル＝１６０円に近づいていたことも背景にある可能性がある。この水準に近づくほど、日本当局が円を下支えするため再び介入する可能性が高まると見られている。

円やユーロなど主要通貨に対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．０８％低下し、１０１．６０。

３０年債利回りは１５ｂｐ低下の５．２８７％。２４年８月以来の大幅な低下となる。

２年債利回りは１８．５ｂｐ低下の４．６３８％。２５年８月以来の大幅な低下となる。

items.title: Grupo Mexico to press ahead with major US copper projects after output dip
items.author: Raul Cortes
items.creator: Raul Cortes
items.summary: Grupo Mexico said on Thursday it will push ahead with major investments at its US mining unit Asarco, expanding the Ray and Silver Bell mines in Arizona and aiming to restart the Hayden smelter and refinery, after copper output fell in the third quarter.
items.body:
Grupo Mexico (GMEXICOB.MX) said on Thursday it will push ahead with major investments at its US mining unit Asarco, expanding the Ray and Silver Bell mines in Arizona and aiming to restart the Hayden smelter and refinery, after copper output fell in the third quarter.
The mining and transportation conglomerate expects to spend $4 billion to $6 billion over the next three years on Asarco's main projects, mining head Leonardo Contreras told analysts on a call.
The investment would mark a significant step up from the unit's recent spending levels, which came in at just $101 million in 2024, though in line with what the firm had [USN:S0N3SX04G TEXT:"previously floated"] for potential US expansion plans.
US EXPANSION PUSH Grupo Mexico has [USN:L1N3HQ26W TEXT:"long weighed kickstarting"] output from its US assets, particularly as Washington has prioritized domestic copper production and securing critical mineral supply chains.
The plans come after Grupo Mexico reported that third-quarter [USN:L1N46616V TEXT:"copper output fell"] about 2%, hurt by lower production in the US and Peru.
In September, Itau analysts said management intended to move ahead with Asarco investments despite uncertainty over possible US tariffs, while also evaluating opportunities to integrate Mexican concentrates and US copper scrap.
Grupo Mexico shares closed down more than 4% on Thursday, making them among the weakest performers on the Mexican market, with copper prices also falling on the day.
Contreras said Grupo Mexico is continuing work on the [USN:S0N3SX04V TEXT:"Ray expansion"] while carrying out feasibility studies. He added that the company is becoming "increasingly optimistic" about restarting Hayden with capacity to process 1.4 million metric tons of copper concentrate a year, restoring additional copper-processing capacity in the United States.
"That would represent almost 350,000 metric tons of contained copper," Contreras said. "If that feeds into our refinery, we could be looking at 500,000 metric tons of copper."
He said the Silver Bell project is also in the feasibility stage, with more clarity expected in coming quarters.
PERU LONG-TERM FOCUS Even so, Grupo Mexico's long-term growth plans remain centered on Peru through subsidiary Southern Copper (SCCO.N) , despite a delay to its [USN:L6N43H166 TEXT:"flagship Tia Maria"] project. The company said this week that startup had been [USN:L1N4140GX TEXT:"pushed back"] from the fourth quarter of 2027 to the first half of 2028.
Southern Copper is also developing the Los Chancas and Michiquillay projects in Peru, expected to produce 130,000 and 225,000 tons of copper a year, respectively. Both are currently scheduled to begin operating around 2032.

By AJ Vicens
Oct 22 : Much of the world woke Wednesday to news that PHP, a coding language most people have never heard of but that underlies roughly 70 per cent of all websites, had a hackable vulnerability, sending businesses and governments scrambling to fix it.
While the PHP glitches sit in the underlying code itself, the NSA warned that attackers could use them to take control of web servers to steal data, disrupt services or move through networks on services the average person relies on every day.

Experts say responsibility mostly lies with software providers and organizations that serve customers. But there are basic steps everyone should take to protect themselves. 
USE MULTI-FACTOR AUTHENTIFICATION
MFA, or multi-factor authentication, requires two forms of verification to access a protected site, such as a password plus a text-based code or security key. Emily Austin, principal security researcher at cybersecurity firm Censys, recommended unique passwords for individual websites, and for people to monitor any transactions.
“But realistically, for situations like the PHP vulnerabilities, there really isn’t much an end user can do beyond hope the services they rely on either don’t use PHP or have people actively working on patching,” Austin said.
The PHP flaws are the latest in a series of severe software bugs made worse by increasingly capable and accessible large language models. Long-hidden flaws in widely used software, once too obscure or complex for humans to exploit, are now much easier to surface and weaponize.
MAKE HARDWARE UPDATES AUTOMATIC
Dan Guido, CEO and co-founder of cybersecurity firm Trail of Bits, recommended people “turn on automatic updates for your phone, computer, and home router.” Companies typically issue security updates when patches are available for known vulnerabilities, so installing them promptly limits the window for bad actors. 
Even so, consumers remain at the mercy of the services they rely on, Guido said.
“Someone visiting a website can do everything right, like use two-factor authentication, and still have their information exposed,” Guido said. “You can't patch your hospital's website.” 
Most of the work falls on companies running services, Guido said. “They need to deploy fixes faster and limit the damage that compromised systems can cause.”
Runa Sandvik, the founder of Granitt and a digital security expert, said people need to update apps and services on their devices whenever they're available, and to not forget about internet-connected devices around the house.
"I can see a scenario in which some people have some sort of IoT device at home that maybe doesn't get frequent updates, maybe doesn't get any updates at all," Sandvik said. "It's worth double checking with the vendor to see if there is anything available."
PATCH, PATCH, PATCH
Dr. Daniel Gardham, a lecturer at the Surrey Centre for Cyber Security and the University of Surrey, said organizations must know what software they run, patch promptly and check whether they've already been compromised. In the AI age, attackers have the advantage, Gardham added.
“Finding vulnerabilities is becoming faster and easier, but fixing them across the range of systems that rely on this software is much harder,” Gardham said. “How well organizations manage that gap will determine whether AI makes the internet safer or more vulnerable.” 
BEWARE OF SCAMMERS
Any time a major cybersecurity threat makes the news, scammers and cybercriminals will try to take advantage, said Nic Adams, co-founder and CEO of 0rcus, a cyberkinetics company.
Be wary of unsolicited links. "When these headlines hit, check the affected company's instructions by opening its app or typing its website address yourself," Adams said. "An urgent message telling you to 'secure your account' deserves extra scrutiny." 
YOUR MONEY IS SAFE
Banks have been preparing for this moment since frontier models came out, and have "worked extremely hard to ensure there is no more low-hanging fruit for the bad guys to go after," said Paul Benda, executive vice president of risk, fraud and cybersecurity at the American Bankers Association. 
However, Benda added, "we are in a new normal" in terms of cyber threats, and consumers need to be aware, especially in the wake of the PHP vulnerabilities, when shopping with random retailers or websites "where their security is not going to be as good as your bank." 
Benda said consumers should not reuse passwords across shopping sites, and should consider using passkeys where possible, which are digital keys specific to certain websites, that avoid the need to enter a password into a website and a phishing resistant.

“But realistically, for situations like the PHP vulnerabilities, there really isn’t much an end user can do beyond hope the services they rely on either don’t use PHP or have people actively working on patching,” Austin said.
The PHP flaws are the latest in a series of severe software bugs made worse by increasingly capable and accessible large language models. Long-hidden flaws in widely used software, once too obscure or complex for humans to exploit, are now much easier to surface and weaponize.
MAKE HARDWARE UPDATES AUTOMATIC
Dan Guido, CEO and co-founder of cybersecurity firm Trail of Bits, recommended people “turn on automatic updates for your phone, computer, and home router.” Companies typically issue security updates when patches are available for known vulnerabilities, so installing them promptly limits the window for bad actors. 
Even so, consumers remain at the mercy of the services they rely on, Guido said.
“Someone visiting a website can do everything right, like use two-factor authentication, and still have their information exposed,” Guido said. “You can't patch your hospital's website.” 
Most of the work falls on companies running services, Guido said. “They need to deploy fixes faster and limit the damage that compromised systems can cause.”
Runa Sandvik, the founder of Granitt and a digital security expert, said people need to update apps and services on their devices whenever they're available, and to not forget about internet-connected devices around the house.
"I can see a scenario in which some people have some sort of IoT device at home that maybe doesn't get frequent updates, maybe doesn't get any updates at all," Sandvik said. "It's worth double checking with the vendor to see if there is anything available."
PATCH, PATCH, PATCH
Dr. Daniel Gardham, a lecturer at the Surrey Centre for Cyber Security and the University of Surrey, said organizations must know what software they run, patch promptly and check whether they've already been compromised. In the AI age, attackers have the advantage, Gardham added.
“Finding vulnerabilities is becoming faster and easier, but fixing them across the range of systems that rely on this software is much harder,” Gardham said. “How well organizations manage that gap will determine whether AI makes the internet safer or more vulnerable.” 
BEWARE OF SCAMMERS
Any time a major cybersecurity threat makes the news, scammers and cybercriminals will try to take advantage, said Nic Adams, co-founder and CEO of 0rcus, a cyberkinetics company.
Be wary of unsolicited links. "When these headlines hit, check the affected company's instructions by opening its app or typing its website address yourself," Adams said. "An urgent message telling you to 'secure your account' deserves extra scrutiny." 
YOUR MONEY IS SAFE
Banks have been preparing for this moment since frontier models came out, and have "worked extremely hard to ensure there is no more low-hanging fruit for the bad guys to go after," said Paul Benda, executive vice president of risk, fraud and cybersecurity at the American Bankers Association. 
However, Benda added, "we are in a new normal" in terms of cyber threats, and consumers need to be aware, especially in the wake of the PHP vulnerabilities, when shopping with random retailers or websites "where their security is not going to be as good as your bank." 
Benda said consumers should not reuse passwords across shopping sites, and should consider using passkeys where possible, which are digital keys specific to certain websites, that avoid the need to enter a password into a website and a phishing resistant.

items.title: Whitehaven Coal's first-quarter output rises nearly 22%
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Australia's Whitehaven Coal reported about a 22% rise in first-quarter output on Friday, driven by resilient production in its Queensland operations and volume recovery at its New South Wales mines.
items.body:
Australia's Whitehaven Coal (WHC.AX) reported about a 22% rise in first-quarter output on Friday, driven by resilient production in its Queensland operations and volume recovery at its New South Wales mines.
The country's top independent coal miner reported managed run-of-mine coal production of 11 million metric tons for the three months ended September 30, up from 9 million tons a year ago.
That beat the Visible Alpha consensus estimate of 9.5 million tons.
The company earned A$226 per metric ton of coal sold in the quarter, compared with an average of A$188 a ton last year.
The temporary impact of sales slippages and elevated inventories is expected to unwind in the second quarter, Whitehaven said.

items.title: Deadly fire at Canada military base was caused by live grenade exercise, army says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A fast-moving grass fire that killed at least four soldiers at a western Canadian military base on Saturday was sparked by an exercise using live grenades, a senior defense official said on Thursday.
items.body:
A fast-moving grass fire that killed at least four soldiers at a western Canadian military base on Saturday was sparked by an exercise using live grenades, a senior defense official said on Thursday.
High winds then propelled the blaze across the army base in Wainwright, overwhelming dozens of soldiers. The incident was one of the worst peacetime tragedies for Canada's military.
"The fire initiated on the automatic grenade launcher range ... (it) initiated as a result of routine military training that was happening on that range at the time," Brigadier-General Vanessa Hanrahan told reporters.
Officials said 27 people remain hospitalized, several in critical condition. The soldiers and reserve members were preparing to deploy to Latvia, where Canadian forces have their largest international military operation.

items.title: QatarEnergy in talks with Venture Global to buy LNG in long term supply deal, sources say
items.author: Curtis Williams, Marwa Rashad
items.creator: Curtis Williams, Marwa Rashad
items.summary: QatarEnergy is in advanced talks with Venture Global for a long-term supply deal to buy at least 3 million metric tons of LNG per year, three people with knowledge of the negotiations told Reuters.
items.body:
QatarEnergy is in advanced talks with Venture Global (VG.N) for a long-term supply deal to buy at least 3 million metric tons of LNG per year, three people with knowledge of the negotiations told Reuters.
QatarEnergy has been buying liquefied natural gas on the spot market from Venture Global to supply some of its customers due to the ongoing blockage of the Strait of Hormuz as the US-Israeli war on Iran and Tehran’s strikes this year have sharply curtailed shipping.
Reuters could not immediately learn the timeline of any agreement between Venture Global and QatarEnergy, or how long a contract could run. Neither company immediately responded to requests for comment.
Venture Global is the US supplier with the most uncommitted LNG capacity and could become the second largest exporter in the country when it starts producing from its CP2 plant currently under construction in Louisiana. An agreement could become the second major long-term deal that QatarEnergy signs with a US exporter this year.
On Thursday, Cheniere (LNG.N) , the largest US exporter of liquefied natural gas, announced a long-term deal to supply QatarEnergy with 4 million metric tons per annum (mtpa) from 2031 to 2054. Two million metric tons per year will be sourced from Cheniere’s Sabine Pass facility in Louisiana, and another 2 mtpa will come from its Corpus Christi terminal in Texas.
items.raw_description: QatarEnergy is in advanced talks with Venture Global for a long-term supply deal to buy at least 3 million metric tons of LNG per year, three people with knowledge of the negotiations told Reuters.

items.title: Australia's Rio Tinto to invest $1.9 billion in Queensland bauxite project
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Rio Tinto said on Friday it will invest $1.9 billion to develop the Kangwinan bauxite project in Queensland, Australia, replacing output from its ageing Andoom mine and lifting annual production capacity at its Weipa bauxite operations.
items.body:
Rio Tinto (RIO.AX) said on Friday it will invest $1.9 billion to develop the Kangwinan bauxite project in Queensland, Australia, replacing output from its ageing Andoom mine and lifting annual production capacity at its Weipa bauxite operations.
The miner said the investment would add 20 million tonnes of annual bauxite production in Weipa, with first output targeted in 2029 and full production expected by 2032.
Located in Queensland, Weipa is one of the world's largest bauxite mining complexes. It supplies the ore to make alumina and aluminium for applications ranging from construction and transportation to packaging and renewable energy infrastructure.
Kangwinan will replace production from the Andoom mine near Weipa as it reaches the end of its life this decade, while increasing Weipa's annual production capacity to about 44 million tonnes from around 38 million tonnes currently.
The development will also help offset the planned 2029 closure of Rio's Gove bauxite mine in the Northern Territory.
The announcement follows Rio's [USN:L4N4500BL TEXT:"agreement last month"] to acquire the adjacent Aurukun Bauxite Project from Glencore (GLEN.L) and Mitsubishi, subject to regulatory approvals, as it seeks to extend long-term growth in the region.
Rio said the combined Amrun, Kangwinan and Aurukun operations are expected to support its Weipa bauxite business well beyond the middle of the century.

items.title: UK financial regulators propose easing vetting rules for finance employees
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Britain's financial regulators on Thursday proposed further easing of rules on vetting employees at finance firms, aiming to reduce regulatory burden and boost economic growth.
items.body:
Britain's financial regulators on Thursday proposed further easing of rules on vetting employees at finance firms, aiming to reduce regulatory burden and boost economic growth.
The Senior Managers and Certification Regime was introduced a decade ago, after the 2008 financial crisis, to hold senior decision-makers accountable in regulated finance firms
The Financial Conduct Authority and the Bank of England's Prudential Regulation Authority are now proposing to scrap annual certification checks on about 139,000 employees below senior management level and replace regulatory approval with notification for senior roles
Chief executives, finance chiefs and chairs would still need regulatory approval before taking up their posts, the regulators said, launching consultations on the proposals, with final policy expected in 2027
The Bank of England said the changes are expected to save firms around £2 billion ($2.68 billion) over a 10-year period
The regulators had in April already [USN:S8N3YU021 TEXT:"eased"] some rules to streamline senior manager accountability, as part of a broader government-led push to cut red tape
As part of the latest proposal, the regulators are also raising the threshold on reporting conduct rule breaches for most staff below senior manager level, saying it would let the firms better target more serious misconduct
($1 = 0.7467 pounds)

items.title: ¿Quién es Kim Ju-ae? Lo que se sabe de la hija de Kim Jong-un y de su posible sucesión¿Quién es Kim Ju-ae? Lo que se sabe de la hija de Kim Jong-un y de su posible sucesión
items.author: Fátima Romero
items.summary: Tiene alrededor de 13 años, su nombre no ha sido confirmado oficialmente y aparece cada vez más junto a Kim Jong-un.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Desde finales de 2022, Kim Ju-ae ha aparecido junto a su padre en lanzamientos de misiles, desfiles militares y actos oficiales de Corea del Norte. Ver más: Las fotos de la reaparición de Kim Jong-Un, el líder de Corea del Norte En un país donde la familia gobernante mantiene su vida privada bajo reserva, la presencia cada vez más frecuente de la adolescente ha llevado al Servicio Nacional de Inteligencia de Corea del Sur a pensar que podría ser su sucesora. En los últimos años, la hija del líder norcoreano ha ocupado un lugar cada vez más visible en actos vinculados con el Ejército y el desarrollo de armas, y ha acompañado a su padre en actividades oficiales fuera del ámbito militar. En septiembre de 2025, incluso viajó con él a Pekín a la conmemoración del 80º aniversario del final de la Segunda Guerra Mundial en el Pacífico, en su primera aparición pública conocida fuera de Corea del Norte. Meses después, en marzo, medios estatales difundieron imágenes de la adolescente conduciendo un tanque militar, con su padre detrás, y otras en las que aparece disparando un rifle durante una visita a una fábrica de municiones. Su última aparición pública conocida fue el 19 de octubre, cuando acompañó a Kim Jong-un y a su madre, Ri Sol-ju, a una exposición de ropa y calzado en Pionyang, según informó la agencia estatal KCNA al día siguiente. Las imágenes se difundieron después de que circularan en redes sociales rumores sin pruebas de que el líder norcoreano había sufrido una hemorragia cerebral y había muerto. Pese a esa exposición, buena parte de su vida sigue siendo desconocida. Las autoridades norcoreanas no han confirmado oficialmente su nombre ni su edad. La información disponible indica que tendría alrededor de 13 años y que sería una de los tres hijos de Kim Jong-un y su esposa, Ri Sol-ju, aunque ni el número de hermanos ni el orden de nacimiento están plenamente verificados. La información sobre la existencia de la hija de Kim Jong-un surgió en 2013, cuando el exjugador de baloncesto estadounidense Dennis Rodman contó que había sostenido en brazos a la pequeña durante una visita a Pionyang. Ver más: Trump plantea la posibilidad de reunirse con Kim Jong Un durante su viaje a Asia Rodman dijo a The Guardian que se llamaba Ju-ae, un nombre que desde entonces han retomado medios internacionales, aunque el Gobierno norcoreano nunca lo ha confirmado. Su primera aparición pública ocurrió casi una década después. En noviembre de 2022, los medios estatales difundieron imágenes de la niña junto a su padre durante la inspección de un misil balístico intercontinental. La escena llamó la atención porque fue la primera vez que el régimen mostró a una de las hijas de Kim Jong-un, y lo hizo durante una actividad vinculada con una de las principales prioridades del Gobierno: su programa de armas. Con el tiempo, los medios locales comenzaron a referirse a ella como la hija “respetada” del líder, una expresión reservada para las figuras más veneradas del país, y en febrero de 2023, la Corporación de Sellos Postales de Corea del Norte presentó una serie de estampillas con imágenes de Kim junto a ella. La posibilidad de que Kim Ju-ae sea la futura líder de Corea del Norte ha ganado peso en las evaluaciones de los servicios de inteligencia de Corea del Sur. Ver más: Kim Jong Un exhibe armas y refuerza lazos con China y Rusia antes del viaje de Donald Trump En enero de 2024, el Servicio Nacional de Inteligencia describió a la adolescente como la candidata más probable para suceder a Kim Jong-un, y dos años más tarde, en febrero de 2026, según legisladores surcoreanos informados por la agencia, la evaluación avanzó hacia la posibilidad de que la hija del líder norcoreano estuviera en una etapa de designación interna como sucesora. En septiembre pasado, el organismo señaló que todavía intentaba verificar si Kim Jong-un tenía un hijo mayor. Sin embargo, sostuvo que, incluso si existiera, no parecía encontrarse en condiciones de sucederlo. La agencia también indicó que el dirigente tendría otro hijo menor, cuyo sexo no ha podido confirmar. La familia Kim gobierna Corea del Norte desde su fundación, en 1948. Kim Il-sung, fundador del Estado, fue sucedido por su hijo Kim Jong-il y, tras la muerte de este en diciembre de 2011, el poder pasó a Kim Jong-un. Expertos citados por NBC News dudan de que los altos funcionarios norcoreanos de mayor edad acepten el mando de una mujer. También señalan que el ascenso al poder de Kim Ju-ae podría significar, a la larga, el fin del dominio de su familia si se casa con un hombre de otra familia y le entrega el poder a su hijo. Otros analistas afirman que Kim Jong Un, de unos 42 años, aún es demasiado joven para designar a su heredero, una medida que podría disminuir su poder.

items.title: Getty Images says investor litigation helped push it to bankruptcy
items.author: Dietrich Knauth
items.creator: Dietrich Knauth
items.summary: Costly investor disputes helped accelerate Getty Images' fall into bankruptcy, its attorney said Thursday, with about $200 million in legal judgments weighing on the photo and image company's recent performance.
items.body:
Costly investor disputes helped accelerate Getty Images' fall into bankruptcy, its attorney said Thursday, with about $200 million in legal judgments weighing on the photo and image company's recent performance.
Bankruptcy attorney Brian Schartz said at a court hearing in Wilmington, Delaware, that the company could also face up to $275 million in future liabilities related to the investor disputes. Getty Images has spent another $35 million on legal fees to dispute the investor claims over the past four years, he added.
Getty Images filed for [USN:L6N4670CJ TEXT:"bankruptcy"] on Wednesday with $1.46 billion in debt, citing the investor litigation, a failed merger with Shutterstock, and its high debt as reasons for the move. Despite having total revenue of $978 million over the past 12 months, Getty Images was down to just $20 million in cash at the time of its Chapter 11 filing, and had been hit with a large legal judgment over the summer it could not pay.
"Thus far, defending those claims outside of bankruptcy court has not swung in the company's favor, and the company does not have the liquidity or time to engage in that type of challenge at this point," Schartz told US Bankruptcy Judge Kate Stickles, who is overseeing the company’s Chapter 11 case.
Getty Images has been sued by several investors, who alleged that the company violated agreements that should have allowed them to acquire shares at $11.50 per share. Getty blocked investors from exercising warrants at a time when the share price briefly rose to $32, and it has lost two lawsuits over the warrants so far. Getty had argued that the warrants could not be exercised at that time because they were still awaiting approval from US securities regulators.
Getty paid $110 million to two large investors in April, after losing a federal court case and an appeal. Getty recently lost another lawsuit that resulted in a $92 million judgment that it has not yet paid. The company sought to appeal that judgment, but it could not afford to post a bond that would have enabled it to put that judgment on hold while it appealed.
Shareholders, who are set to have their equity stakes wiped out in bankruptcy, plan to seek a court-appointed equity committee to represent their interests in bankruptcy, Schartz said.
In addition to the investor disputes, Getty also cited its [USN:L4N4321Q5 TEXT:"failed merger"] with Shutterstock, which the two companies abandoned earlier this year due to the UK competition regulator's requirement to sell Shutterstock's editorial business as a condition for approval.
Getty Images entered bankruptcy with a restructuring agreement that would cancel existing equity and convert it into a private company that is 100% owned by affiliates of the Getty family and Koch Equity Development. The Getty family affiliates and Koch Equity Development have agreed to make a $533 million investment in the company, and the deal is supported by creditors who hold 90% of Getty Images’ debt, according to the company.
The case is Getty Images Holdings Inc, US Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware, No. 26-11643
For Getty Images: Brian Schartz of Simpson Thacher & Bartlett LLP
For an ad hoc group of equity holders: Robert Stark of Brown Rudnick LLP

[USN:L4N4321Q5 TEXT:"Getty Images scraps $3.7 billion merger with Shutterstock over UK scrutiny"]
