items.title: Week 7 TNF: Patriots-Bears Preview, Prop Picks, Prediction
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The New England Patriots will have a makeshift offensive line when they visit the Chicago Bears on Thursday night to kick off Week 7 of the NFL season.
items.body:
The New England Patriots will have a makeshift offensive line when they visit the Chicago Bears on Thursday night to kick off Week 7 of the NFL season.
Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel confirmed that starting guards Ben Brown and Alijah Vera-Tucker have been ruled out against Chicago (4-2) after being injured during last Sunday's 26-19 victory over the New York Jets. Brown left the game with a knee injury, while Vera-Tucker exited the contest with a hamstring injury.
The Patriots (4-2) have won their past three games but will be facing a Bears defense that has recorded 17 sacks, including a season-high five in the team's 31-23 win at Atlanta last week.
ODDS AND TRENDS The Bears are consensus 3-point favorites. That includes at BetMGM, where they have attracted 61% of the total bets and 70% of the spread-line money wagered since opening as 2.5-point favorites.
The moneyline action has been more evenly split, with the Patriots backed by 56% of the bets and 53% of the money while shifting from +110 underdogs to +125.
The total points line opened at 50. It has since edged up to 50.5 with the Over supported by 60% of the total bets and 67% of the money.
PROP PICKS --Patriots WR DeMario Douglas Over 37.5 Receiving Yards (-110 at BetMGM): This has been the most popular player prop at the sportsbook, with Douglas entering the game with a team-high 20 receptions on 30 targets. He becomes an even bigger focal point of the offense with fellow wide receiver Romeo Doubs on injured reserve.
--Bears RB D'Andre Swift Anytime TD Scorer (-160 at DraftKings): With backfield mate Kyle Monangai out again, the brunt of the workload falls on Swift, who has six rushing touchdowns on the season. Three of those have come with Monangai sidelined the past two weeks. This has been the most popular player prop at DraftKings.
KEY STAT The Patriots rank sixth in total defense, allowing an average of 300.8 yards per game. That is just ahead of the Bears at 302.3.
THE NEWS It's been a Jekyll-and-Hyde season for Maye, who had one touchdown pass and was intercepted six times in his first three games. He has 10 touchdown passes and one interception in the three games since.
"Drake Maye is one of those guys who does an outstanding job with his feet," Bears defensive coordinator Dennis Allen said. "There's been times when you watch it, there's been pressure on the quarterback and he makes people miss and he creates run plays down the field, so I see him doing a lot of good things. I see especially his athleticism showing up. His ability to throw the ball down the field has been exceptional."
One of Chicago's two losses came when the Bears were without starting quarterback Caleb Williams because of a hamstring injury. Williams returned against Atlanta and completed 30 of 36 passes for 305 yards and a touchdown in a 31-23 victory. It was the first time Williams played since he left the fourth quarter of a 9-3 loss to Minnesota on Sept. 20.
The Bears enter this game averaging an NFL-best 160.7 rushing yards per game. Only Buffalo (14) has more rushing scores than Chicago's 13. Swift has run for a team-high 398 yards and six touchdowns on 94 carries.
"They have really good talent," Vrabel said. "The O-line is excellent. They're well-coached. It's a good scheme. I think that the backs run hard and the receivers ... when you can run the football, the receivers have to be a big factor in that, and they are.
"(Stopping the run) will be our emphasis, but obviously there's a lot more that they do than run the football."
INJURY REPORT PATRIOTS: Vera-Tucker and Brown will be replaced by Matt Pryor and Walter Rouse. Pryor, 31, has started 40 of the 111 games he has played in during his NFL career, including 15 of 17 games with the Bears in 2024. Rouse, 25, will make his first career NFL start Thursday.
Doubs was placed on injured reserve Monday after he sustained a shoulder injury while catching a 42-yard touchdown pass against the Jets. He has 14 receptions for 261 yards and three scores this season.
Backup cornerbacks Karon Prunty (hamstring) and Channing Canada (hamstring) also were ruled out. Right tackle Morgan Moses (foot), linebacker Christian Elliss (chest) and safeties Kevin Byard III (chest) and Craig Woodson (shoulder) were listed as questionable.
BEARS: Running back Monangai (thumb, toe) has been ruled out for a third straight game. Linebacker Jack Sanborn (concussion) also was ruled out, fellow linebacker T.J. Edwards (hamstring) is doubtful and defensive back Tyrique Stevenson (hip) is questionable after participating fully in practice Wednesday.
THEY SAID IT "It's been a next-man-up mentality," Maye said. "That's a Coach Vrabel-coached team. He always says it and we believe it. We gotta have identity throughout. It's not just the top guys. It's the guys in practice in the huddle." --Maye, on the Patriots' injury situation
PREDICTION The Patriots will be hard-pressed to continue their recent surge while traveling on a short week to face a Bears defense that has already racked up 17 sacks. --Bears 31, Patriots 23
--Field Level Media

items.title: S&P 500 e Nasdaq fecham com forte queda, conforme novas dúvidas sobre IA levam a vendas no setor de tecnologia
items.author: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.summary: As ações nos EUA fecharam em forte baixa nesta quinta-feira, e o Nasdaq registrou sua maior queda diária desde junho, à medida que uma série de relatórios de resultados financeiros de grande repercussão reacendeu novos temores sobre a corrida por gastos com IA.
items.body:
As ações nos EUA fecharam em forte baixa nesta quinta-feira, e o Nasdaq registrou sua maior queda diária desde junho, à medida que uma série de relatórios de resultados financeiros de grande repercussão reacendeu novos temores sobre a corrida por gastos com IA.
O S&P 500 encerrou o dia em território profundamente negativo. O Nasdaq, com forte presença de empresas de tecnologia, foi puxado para baixo pelo setor de microchips e registrou a maior queda, caindo 2,6% na esteira de uma enxurrada de resultados financeiros de grande repercussão relacionados à IA.
O Dow Jones, índice de blue chips, conseguiu um ganho nominal minutos antes do fechamento do mercado.
Os resultados da Meta (META.O) superaram as expectativas dos analistas, mas suas ações tombaram 7,0%, já que a controladora do Facebook registrou seu primeiro fluxo de caixa negativo em mais de uma década devido aos gastos com IA e anunciou planos de emitir ações sem direito a voto em uma divisão de duas por uma para levantar capital a ser investido nessa tecnologia emergente.
As ações da Tesla (TSLA.O) caíram 3,1%, embora a fabricante de carros elétricos tenha, inesperadamente, registrado fluxo de caixa livre positivo no trimestre e reduzido seus planos de gastos de capital para 2026.
O índice Philadelphia SE Semiconductor (.SOX) , que impulsionou grande parte dos ganhos do atual mercado em alta, despencou 6,7%, sua maior queda percentual diária desde 23 de junho.
Com a queda desta quinta-feira, o SOX está mais de 26% abaixo de sua máxima histórica de fechamento, alcançada em 22 de junho, mas ainda apresenta alta de 51,5% no acumulado do ano. O S&P 500 subiu 11,9% no mesmo período.
“É um dia maravilhoso em Wall Street”, disse Paul Nolte, consultor sênior de patrimônio e estrategista de mercado da Murphy & Sylvest, em Elmhurst, Illinois. “A única parte do mercado que está realmente sofrendo aqui é a de tecnologia, que tem sido a queridinha dos mercados até mais ou menos junho.”
“Os investidores estão começando a perceber que há algumas lacunas na narrativa da IA”, acrescentou Nolte. “E isso está causando impacto nos índices, pois eles têm uma ponderação muito grande no setor de tecnologia.”
No cenário geopolítico, os houthis, apoiados pelo Irã, lançaram novos ataques contra alvos sauditas, levando os preços do petróleo bruto à maior alta em cinco meses. Os investidores temem que os conflitos em curso no Oriente Médio possam manter a inflação elevada e forçar o Federal Reserve a continuar aumentando as taxas de juros.
Dados do Departamento do Trabalho mostraram que os pedidos iniciais de auxílio-desemprego continuaram oscilando perto dos níveis mais baixos em várias décadas. Sinais de estabilidade no mercado de trabalho permitirão que o Fed se concentre no combate à inflação. Atualmente, os mercados financeiros estão precificando a probabilidade de que o banco central aumente sua taxa básica de juros em mais 25 pontos-base antes do final do ano.
O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) teve variação positiva de 0,02%, para 52.867,98 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) caiu 1,21%, para 7.663,43 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) registrou queda de 2,60%, para 26.008,86 pontos.
A temporada de resultados do terceiro trimestre está em pleno andamento, com 111 das empresas do S&P 500 já tendo divulgado seus resultados. Dessas, 83% superaram as expectativas dos analistas, de acordo com os dados mais recentes da LSEG.
A Procter & Gamble (PG.N) alertou que as crescentes pressões de custo teriam um impacto cada vez maior sobre o lucro, mas superou as estimativas dos analistas, levando as ações a uma alta de 5,6% e impulsionando o setor de bens de consumo básico (.SPLRCS) .
A Blackstone (BX.N) saltou 8,4%, depois que a empresa afirmou que a ampliação dos spreads de crédito sobre dívidas relacionadas à IA poderia representar uma oportunidade para garantir retornos mais elevados.
A Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) subiu 7,0% depois que a empresa aeroespacial e de defesa elevou suas previsões anuais de vendas e lucro.
A Spotify (SPOT.N) saltou 11,1% depois que a empresa sueca de streaming de música previu lucro no quarto trimestre acima das estimativas de Wall Street, apostando em seus recursos baseados em IA para impulsionar o crescimento do número de usuários.
A Union Pacific (UNP.N) registrou alta de 3,6% após a empresa superar as expectativas nos resultados trimestrais, impulsionados por aumentos nos preços de seus principais produtos, embora a ferrovia tenha sinalizado um impacto negativo devido ao aumento dos preços dos combustíveis.
As fabricantes de chips Intel (INTC.O) , AMD (AMD.O) , Sandisk (SNDK.O) e Marvell (MRVL.O) caíram mais de 8% em meio à onda de vendas generalizada no setor de chips.

items.title: Folha de S.Paulo não publicou capa com "extrato bancário" de R$300 bi de Lula
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: É falso que a Folha de S.Paulo tenha publicado uma capa da edição impressa mostrando as supostas "primeiras imagens do extrato bancário" do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), candidato à reeleição, que somariam quase R$300 bilhões em "propinas e desvios identificados".
items.body:
É falso que a Folha de S.Paulo tenha publicado uma capa da edição impressa mostrando as supostas "primeiras imagens do extrato bancário" do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), candidato à reeleição, que somariam quase R$300 bilhões em "propinas e desvios identificados".
Posts no Facebook espalham a imagem, que simula a identidade visual do jornal, atribuindo as informações à edição de "terça-feira, 14 de outubro de 2026".
No entanto, a capa da Folha de S.Paulo do último dia 14 trouxe a manchete "Flávio acena a assalariados, e Lula, a MEIs a 12 dias do segundo turno", e não mencionou supostas acusações de propina contra o presidente.
Além disso, neste ano a data caiu em uma quarta-feira.
Uma análise da ferramenta SynthID Detector, que identifica a presença de marcas d'água ocultas em materiais criados com IA, detectou que a imagem foi feita ou editada com ferramentas de IA da OpenAI.
A Folha de S.Paulo não respondeu a um pedido de comentário.
O conteúdo circula nas redes sociais após Lula propor a Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), seu adversário no segundo turno, que ambos abram ao público suas contas bancárias e registros telefônicos.
INCONSISTÊNCIAS A falsa capa com o suposto extrato mostra uma lista com nomes de escândalos de corrupção e valores que seriam oriundos dos esquemas, totalizando R$299,4 bilhões.
A Folha de S.Paulo noticiou denúncias de supostos pagamentos indevidos ao presidente na época da operação Lava Jato, mas a Reuters não encontrou registros de que o jornal tenha publicado que o petista recebeu R$300 bilhões, como dizem os posts.
As postagens também exageram cifras e omitem o desfecho de parte dos casos mencionados. A imagem atribui a Lula, por exemplo, uma propina de R$1,2 bilhão em um processo relacionado à operação Zelotes, no qual o presidente era acusado de ter favorecido montadoras, mas a Justiça absolveu o petista.
O presidente foi condenado em um processo da Lava Jato por supostamente ter recebido R$2,2 milhões em propina por meio de um triplex no Guarujá (SP). A montagem atribui um valor de R$3,6 bilhões ao caso.
Em 2021, o Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) anulou todas as sentenças de Lula relacionadas à Lava Jato ao declarar a incompetência da Justiça Federal do Paraná e a suspeição do ex-juiz Sergio Moro, hoje governador eleito do Paraná pelo PL.
VEREDICTO Falso. A Folha de S.Paulo não publicou uma capa ou uma notícia mostrando um "extrato bancário" de propinas atribuído a Lula.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278. . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: EEUU impone restricciones de visa a 21 colombianos por presunta corrupción y narcotráfico
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Departamento de Estado de Estados Unidos anunció el jueves restricciones de visa a 21 personas en Colombia, incluidos el expresidente de la petrolera estatal Ecopetrol Ricardo Roa, dos congresistas y un alcalde de una ciudad capital, a quienes acusa de socavar a gobiernos elegidos democráticamente mediante la corrupción o el narcotráfico.
items.body:
El Departamento de Estado de Estados Unidos anunció el jueves restricciones de visa a 21 personas en Colombia, incluidos el expresidente de la petrolera estatal Ecopetrol Ricardo Roa, dos congresistas y un alcalde de una ciudad capital, a quienes acusa de socavar a gobiernos elegidos democráticamente mediante la corrupción o el narcotráfico.
La medida amplía la campaña de Estados Unidos contra ambos delitos en la región. Según el Departamento, la decisión impulsa los compromisos asumidos por los socios en la Cumbre de Doral, en marzo, y en la declaración de líderes del Escudo de las Américas del 22 de septiembre.
"La Administración Trump respalda al Gobierno de Colombia en sus esfuerzos por eliminar la influencia criminal, incluso en sus tribunales, fuerzas policiales y legislatura", dijo el Departamento de Estado en un comunicado.
Roa enfrenta investigaciones criminales por su gestión al frente del grupo energético Ecopetrol y por su desempeño como gerente de la campaña que llevó al poder al expresidente Gustavo Petro en 2022.
En la lista del Departamento de Estado también figuran Yahir Fernando Acuña, alcalde de Sincelejo, capital del departamento de Sucre; el senador Wadith Alberto Manzur; y la representante de la Cámara Karen Astrith Manrique.
El Gobierno del presidente de derecha Abelardo De La Espriella mejoró las relaciones de Colombia con Estados Unidos, y Washington se comprometió a colaborar con su administración en la lucha contra el narcotráfico y los grupos armados ilegales.
Washington es el principal socio de Colombia en su lucha contra la producción y el tráfico de cocaína, así como contra las guerrillas izquierdistas y las bandas criminales que se financian con esa actividad ilegal e intervienen en un conflicto armado interno de más de seis décadas que ha dejado 450.000 muertos.
Estados Unidos también es el principal destino de las exportaciones colombianas.
No hubo reacciones inmediatas de las personas sancionadas por el Departamento de Estado ni del Gobierno de Colombia.

items.title: US to tighten Ebola screening with new air passenger declarations
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: The US government will increase measures aimed at preventing entry by people exposed to Ebola with a new requirement for US-bound air travelers to attest they have not been in the Democratic Republic of Congo in the prior 21 days, according to a memo on Thursday seen by Reuters.
items.body:
The US government will increase measures aimed at preventing entry by people exposed to Ebola with a new requirement for US-bound air travelers to attest they have not been in the Democratic Republic of Congo in the prior 21 days, according to a memo on Thursday seen by Reuters.
The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention in May adopted rules barring airline passengers who have been in the DRC, the center of the 2026 outbreak, in the prior three weeks. The restrictions were extended to US citizens in July.
The new CDC order takes effect November 3 and requires all US-bound airline passengers to file digital or paper attestations.
Airlines for America, which represents United Airlines (UAL.O) , American Airlines (AAL.O) , Southwest Airlines (LUV.N) and Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) , did not immediately comment.
The CDC is holding briefing calls with major US and foreign airlines on Friday to detail how carriers should comply with the new requirements.
As part of the Ebola measures, the CDC since earlier this year has also barred foreign nationals from the US if they have been in Uganda or South Sudan in the prior three weeks.
The Bundibugyo strain of the virus spread undetected for months before the outbreak was declared in May. It kills about half of those infected and has no approved treatment or vaccine.
So far the outbreak is confirmed to have killed about 4,700 people in Africa, according to the Africa CDC.
To date, no Ebola cases associated with this outbreak have been reported in the United States, the CDC said.

items.title: El alto costo de la IA pasa la cuenta a Meta y a otras acciones tecnológicas
items.author: Lewis Krauskopf, Sudeshna Ghoshal
items.creator: Lewis Krauskopf, Sudeshna Ghoshal
items.summary: Los inversionistas vendieron el jueves acciones de Meta Platforms y de una gran cantidad de empresas tecnológicas, un día después de que la compañía, uno de los proveedores de servicios en la nube a gran escala que está gastando miles de millones para construir centros de datos y otra infraestructura de IA, anunció que emitirá una nueva clase de acciones para conseguir fondos.
items.body:
Los inversionistas vendieron el jueves acciones de Meta Platforms (META.O) y de una gran cantidad de empresas tecnológicas, un día después de que la compañía, uno de los proveedores de servicios en la nube a gran escala que está gastando miles de millones para construir centros de datos y otra infraestructura de IA, anunció que emitirá una nueva clase de acciones para conseguir fondos.
La acción de Meta cayó un 7%, su mayor descenso desde julio, la de SpaceX (SPCX.O) perdió un 9% y la de la empresa de semiconductores Nvidia (NVDA.O) , un barómetro del sector de la IA, retrocedió un 4%,5. El índice compuesto Nasdaq (.IXIC) cerró con su mayor caída en cuatro meses.
Una caída del 12% de las acciones de la empresa de semiconductores Lam Research (LRCX.O) tras sus resultados, también influyó negativamente en el ánimo del mercado y provocó una caída del índice de semiconductores (.SOX) del 6,6%.
El retroceso es una prueba para los inversores en el sector de la IA, que asiste a un aumento de los costos de un proyecto a largo plazo cuyas ganancias siguen siendo inciertas y probablemente se distribuirán de forma desigual.
Las empresas tecnológicas han contraído enormes deudas durante el último año para financiar proyectos de IA, pero Wall Street ahora prevé que las tasas de interés más altas obligarán a compañías como Meta a vender miles de millones de dólares en acciones para financiar la siguiente fase de desarrollo, lo que ejercerá presión sobre el precio al incrementar el número de títulos.
Se trata de un revés para un mercado donde los principales índices bursátiles estadounidenses se mantienen cerca de máximos históricos a pesar de un mes de gran volatilidad en las operaciones.
PREOCUPA EL RETORNO DE LA INVERSIÓN La caída comenzó con "la gran pregunta sobre el retorno de la inversión de todo el gasto", dijo Matthew Maley, estratega jefe de mercado de Miller Tabak. "Cada vez es más evidente para la gente que esto va a llevar mucho más tiempo".
Thomas Hayes, presidente de Great Hill Capital LLC en Nueva York, coincidió en que las preocupaciones sobre el retorno de la inversión son fundamentales, y mencionó comentarios del CEO de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, sobre el cuello de botella en el financiamiento para las empresas de IA más pequeñas como un factor que contribuye a la venta de acciones.
Meta anunció el miércoles que usará nuevas acciones de Clase C, sin derecho a voto, para financiar gastos en inteligencia artificial y otras prioridades. Meta también elevó el límite inferior de su previsión de gasto anual de 130.000 millones de dólares a 135.000 millones, manteniendo el límite superior sin cambios en 145.000 millones.
El nivel de gasto requerirá una gran participación de los inversionistas en las próximas ventas de acciones. Meta registró un flujo de caja libre negativo de 2.120 millones de dólares en el tercer trimestre, en comparación con un flujo de caja libre positivo de 10.630 millones de dólares un año antes. Es el primer déficit de efectivo de Meta en más de una década.
“Un mayor gasto, un flujo de caja libre negativo y la falta de ingresos generados por el gasto preocupan a los inversionistas, que consideran que esto se está convirtiendo en una especie de pozo sin fondo”, dijo Robert Pavlik, gestor sénior de cartera de Dakota Wealth en Fairfield, Connecticut.
Esta medida pone de relieve la preocupación sobre cómo se financiará la inversión en IA.
Los swaps de incumplimiento crediticio, que miden el riesgo percibido de impago de muchos de los principales actores del sector de la IA, han aumentado durante el último año, y el de Meta alcanzó un récord el jueves, lo que refleja la incertidumbre sobre quién se beneficiará más de las sumas que se están invirtiendo actualmente.
Las nuevas señales de presión del mercado para frenar el gasto en IA se tradujeron rápidamente el jueves en una caída generalizada del mercado, lo que refleja las expectativas de que cualquier retroceso en la IA afectará al crecimiento estadounidense, lo que repercute en un fuerte repunte de los precios de los bonos del Tesoro.
"Este es un día típico de rotación", dijo Joe Saluzzi, socio, cofundador y codirector de operaciones de renta variable en Themis Trading. "Se puede ver cómo el dinero se dirige a los bonos del Tesoro, por lo que es una estrategia clásica de seguridad (...) Están rotando sus inversiones, saliendo de las empresas tecnológicas y de las empresas de inteligencia artificial, hacia inversiones más seguras, ya sean bonos o algunas de las grandes acciones del Dow Jones".

items.title: Elevada umidade retarda plantio de soja no RS; Emater eleva previsão de produtividade para o trigo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O plantio de soja do Rio Grande do Sul na safra 2026/27 avançou lentamente nesta semana devido a chuvas, com o importante Estado produtor realizando a semeadura em 3% da área total projetada, abaixo da média histórica para a época, informou a Emater em boletim nesta quinta-feira.
items.body:
O plantio de soja do Rio Grande do Sul na safra 2026/27 avançou lentamente nesta semana devido a chuvas, com o importante Estado produtor realizando a semeadura em 3% da área total projetada, abaixo da média histórica para a época, informou a Emater em boletim nesta quinta-feira.
"A elevada umidade do solo e a ocorrência de chuvas frequentes restringiram as janelas de plantabilidade, e as baixas temperaturas e a limitada radiação solar retardaram o desenvolvimento das primeiras lavouras implantadas", afirmou o órgão de assistência técnica vinculado ao governo gaúcho.
A média histórica indica plantio em 5% das áreas nesta época. Mas o ritmo está igual ao mesmo período do ano passado.
O Rio Grande do Sul tem potencial de ser o quarto maior Estado produtor de soja do Brasil na temporada 2026/27, segundo a primeira estimativa da estatal Conab, divulgada na semana passada. O Estado ficaria atrás de Mato Grosso, Paraná e Goiás.
No Paraná, chuvas excessivas associadas ao El Niño também [USN:L1N4660QU TEXT:"reduziram"] os ritmo dos trabalhos de plantio.
"Em áreas semeadas antecipadamente, houve prejuízo à emergência após as chuvas volumosas, embora os estandes ainda estejam, em geral, satisfatórios", acrescentou a Emater, que chamou também a atenção para o aparecimento do fungo da ferrugem asiática.
A safra gaúcha está estimada pela Conab em 20,2 milhões de toneladas, avanço anual de 8,3%.
Com relação ao milho, a Emater afirmou que o plantio avançou em ritmo desigual, atingindo 78% da área do Estado, e que as temperaturas amenas também retardaram o crescimento em algumas regiões.
O Rio Grande do Sul é normalmente o principal Estado produtor do cereal na primeira safra e deve colher 6,6 milhões de toneladas, alta de 10,2% ante o ciclo passado, segundo a Conab.
TRIGO Embora tenha citado perdas para a safra de trigo em decorrência de chuvas excessivas, a Emater elevou nesta quinta-feira sua projeção de produtividade para a safra do cereal do Estado, afirmando que a projeção inicial considerou resultados de mais perdas em anos de El Niño.
A produtividade projetada no início do plantio era de 2.701 kg/hectare, e o cenário atual aponta 2.833 kg/ha, segundo a Emater. Ainda assim, o desempenho indica uma retração de 5,55% em relação ao ano anterior.
A safra de trigo, com colheita em andamento, está estimada agora pela Emater em 2,16 milhões de toneladas, o que representa queda de 37,48% no comparativo com o ciclo passado, quando a área plantada foi maior, superando 1 milhão de hectares.
O Rio Grande do Sul é um dos principais produtores do Brasil, ao lado do Paraná.
Ademais, Neimar Peroni, um dos organizadores do Informativo Conjuntural da Emater, alertou que a empresa poderá revisar para baixo a projeção, caso os resultados esperados no campo não sejam confirmados.

items.title: EEUU bloquea dos dispositivos con chips de vigilancia fabricados en China
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: La Comisión Federal de Comunicaciones (FCC) anunció el jueves que prohibió la comercialización en el mercado estadounidense de dos dispositivos que contienen chips de vigilancia extranjeros fabricados por una filial de la empresa china Huawei, la primera vez que ejerce su autoridad en virtud de una nueva normativa.
items.body:
La Comisión Federal de Comunicaciones (FCC) anunció el jueves que prohibió la comercialización en el mercado estadounidense de dos dispositivos que contienen chips de vigilancia extranjeros fabricados por una filial de la empresa china Huawei, la primera vez que ejerce su autoridad en virtud de una nueva normativa.
La agencia señaló que había prohibido una cámara para salpicadero y un transmisor de video inalámbrico que contenían chips fabricados por HiSilicon, filial de Huawei, y que, según la agencia, anuncia su chip como "diseñado para el mercado de la vigilancia" e incluye "algoritmos de detección de rostros humanos".
El presidente de la FCC, Brendan Carr, afirmó que los dispositivos de video que contienen chips de vigilancia fabricados por empresas incluidas en su lista de seguridad nacional "suponen un riesgo evidente e inaceptable para la nación y nuestra población".
Huawei no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios y no fue posible contactar con HiSilicon.
La FCC votó en julio a favor de prohibir en EEUU la venta de dispositivos que contengan componentes de hardware clave de empresas chinas consideradas un riesgo para la seguridad nacional

items.title: Exempleado de Eminem se declara culpable de un delito de infracción de derechos autor
items.author: Blake Brittain
items.creator: Blake Brittain
items.summary: Un antiguo empleado de Eminem se declaró culpable el jueves de un delito de infracción de los derechos de autor por vender sin permiso música inédita del rapero, según un escrito presentado ante un tribunal federal de Míchigan.
items.body:
Un antiguo empleado de Eminem se declaró culpable el jueves de un delito de infracción de los derechos de autor por vender sin permiso música inédita del rapero, según un escrito presentado ante un tribunal federal de Míchigan.
Joseph Strange, de 48 años, se enfrenta a una pena de hasta cinco años de prisión por vender varias canciones inéditas de Eminem en 2024 por unos 50.000 dólares, según el acuerdo de declaración de culpabilidad
El acuerdo señala que las canciones se filtraron posteriormente en Internet y se reprodujeron entre ocho y nueve millones de veces
Strange trabajó para Eminem, cuyo nombre real es Marshall Mathers, en un estudio de música de Ferndale, Míchigan,
aproximadamente entre 2007 y 2021
La conducta de Strange "socavó tanto los derechos legales como los artísticos", afirmó el fiscal general adjunto A. Tysen Duva en un comunicado.
"Joe Strange es un buen hombre cuyos hijos han sufrido mucho con todo esto", declaró el abogado de Strange, Wade Fink, en un comunicado. "Se trata de un asunto mucho más complicado y matizado que el simple hecho de que un hombre haya robado descaradamente".
Los portavoces del sello discográfico de Eminem, Universal Music Group, no respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios

items.title: Gilead to buy PepStar's inflammation drug program in $1.28 billion deal
items.author: Sahil Pandey
items.creator: Sahil Pandey
items.summary: Gilead Sciences said on Thursday it will acquire PepStar Therapeutics' oral inflammation drug program, including an experimental bowel disease treatment, for $1.275 billion in cash upfront.
items.body:
Gilead Sciences (GILD.O) said on Thursday it will acquire PepStar Therapeutics' oral inflammation drug program, including an experimental bowel disease treatment, for $1.275 billion in cash upfront.
The deal follows positive mid-stage [USN:L4N4650Q7 TEXT:"results"] for Gilead's experimental pill for chronic bowel disease, emvistegrast, on Monday and adds the new inflammatory bowel disease candidate to its portfolio.
Gilead said it sees potential for HCXT-2001 to be developed on its own or in combination with other programs in its pipeline.
Inflammatory bowel disease, or IBD, is a group of long-term conditions in which the immune system causes inflammation in the digestive tract. Gilead said HCXT-2001 is designed to block the IL-23 receptor, part of an immune pathway involved in inflammatory diseases.
Citi analyst Geoffrey Meacham said the $1.275 billion upfront payment was notable given that HCXT-2001 remains in early-stage testing and has no published clinical data.
Meacham said the acquisition reinforces Gilead's inflammation and immunology strategy while offering an opportunity to diversify its longer-term growth beyond its core HIV business.
Gilead said the deal, expected to close in the final quarter of this year, gives it worldwide rights to the program.

items.title: 米国株式市場＝Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック急落、ＡＩ投資巡る懸念再燃
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Stephen Culp

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Stephen Culp

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合が反落。ナスダックは１日の下落率として６月５日以来の大きさを記録した。注目企業の決算発表が相次ぐ中、人工知能（ＡＩ）への投資競争を巡る懸念が再燃した。

一方、優良株で構成するダウ工業株３０種は取引終了の数分前に小幅高に転じた。

フェイスブックの親会社メタ・プラットフォームズは、決算がアナリスト予想を上回ったものの、株価は７．０％下落した。ＡＩ関連支出により１０年以上ぶりにキャッシュフローがマイナスとなったほか、ＡＩ技術への投資資金を調達するため、１対２の株式分割で議決権のない株式を発行する計画を発表した。

電気自動車（ＥＶ）メーカーのテスラは３．１％安。四半期のフリーキャッシュフローが予想外のプラスとなり、２０２６年の設備投資計画を引き下げたものの、売られた。

現在の強気相場を大きくけん引してきたフィラデルフィア半導体指数は６．７％急落し、１日の下落率として６月２３日以来の大きさとなった。

同指数はこの日の下落で、６月２２日に付けた終値ベースの最高値を２６％超下回った。ただ、年初来ではなお５１．５％上昇している。同期間のＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種の上昇率は１１．９％。

マーフィー・アンド・シルベストのシニアウェルスアドバイザー兼市場ストラテジスト、ポール・ノルテ氏は「ウォール街にとっては素晴らしい一日だ。市場で本当に苦戦しているのは、６月ごろまで市場の寵児だったハイテク株だけだ」と指摘。「投資家はＡＩの成長シナリオにいくつかの穴があると気付き始めている。株価指数はハイテク株の比重が非常に大きいため、その影響を受けている」と述べた。

地政学面では、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジアラビアの標的に新たな攻撃を仕掛け、原油価格が５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。投資家は、中東情勢の混乱が続けばインフレが高止まりし、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げ継続を迫られる可能性を懸念した。

米労働省が発表した新規失業保険申請件数は、数十年ぶりの低水準付近での推移が続いた。労働市場の安定を示す兆候は、ＦＲＢがインフレ抑制に注力する余地を与える。金融市場は現在、ＦＲＢが年末までに政策金利をさらに２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げる可能性を織り込んでいる。

プロクター・アンド・ギャンブル（Ｐ＆Ｇ）は、コスト上昇圧力が利益を一段と圧迫すると警告したものの、決算がアナリスト予想を上回り、５．６％上昇。主要消費財指数を支えた。

ブラックストーンは８．４％高。ＡＩ関連債務の信用スプレッド拡大が、より高いリターンを確保する機会になり得るとの見方を示した。

航空宇宙・防衛大手ロッキード・マーチンは通期の売上高と利益の見通しを引き上げ、７．０％上昇した。

スウェーデンの音楽配信大手スポティファイは１１．１％上昇。第４・四半期の利益見通しが市場予想を上回った。ＡＩを活用した機能が利用者数の拡大を促すと見込んでいる。

半導体株が幅広く売られる中、インテル、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（ＡＭＤ）、サンディスク、マーベル・テクノロジーはいずれも８％超下落した。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では、値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．０１対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．３７対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１８７億９０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７１億９０００万株。

items.title: US nuclear power regulator allows applicants to include data from agency projects
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US nuclear power regulator finalized a rule on Thursday allowing companies to use data from demonstration projects at US agencies, calling it the first major change to reactor regulations since President Donald Trump ordered faster agency reviews.
items.body:
The US nuclear power regulator finalized a rule on Thursday allowing companies to use data from demonstration projects at US agencies, calling it the first major change to reactor regulations since President Donald Trump [USN:L1N3RV0O8 TEXT:"ordered"] faster agency reviews.
The Nuclear Regulatory Commission rule will now allow companies to use analyses, data and information from reactor demonstration projects at the US energy and defense departments to support an expected wave of applications to the NRC of high-tech reactor projects, including small modular reactors.
Trump's orders in May 2025 directed the NRC to finish approvals for new reactor designs within 18 months, igniting criticism that his administration was reducing the NRC's independence. Nuclear plants are powered by radioactive fuels the NRC monitors at all stages. The agency also monitors the safety of nuclear reactors.
NRC Chairman Ho Nieh said the rule will not allow projects to get around his agency's strict standards. "This is not a shortcut, this is not a compromise," Nieh told reporters.
Nieh said NRC reviews could be more stringent on "consequence analysis," or estimations of potential offsite radiological, health or economic impacts of severe reactor accidents, or hazards from natural events like earthquakes or tornadoes.
Nuclear safety activist and physicist Edwin Lyman of the Union of Concerned Scientists said it is critical that the NRC maintain its authority to make independent safety and security determinations and not simply ape the decisions of other agencies.
"For all their flaws, the NRC's licensing procedures are far more rigorous and transparent" than the energy and defense department procedures, Lyman said.

AUSTIN, Texas, Oct 22 : Williams driver Carlos Sainz said talk of Formula One seeing out the season with races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi was "premature" in the current circumstances.
Formula One and the sport's governing body, the International Automobile Federation (FIA), have both said the calendar remains as scheduled despite conflict in the Gulf region and the Iran war.
FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem told reporters this week that the situation was currently "fine", the races were going to happen and he would be happy for his staff and teams to go. Qatar is scheduled for November 29 and Abu Dhabi for December 6. 
Sainz, a director of the Grand Prix Drivers Association (GPDA), sounded less sure.

"I think they seem very convinced that it's going to go ahead. On my personal side, I'm not speaking as the GPDA, it's very difficult to be convinced right now," the Spaniard told reporters on Thursday ahead of the US Grand Prix in Austin.
"There's still plenty of things happening in the Middle East and also there is obviously an election that is going to happen in the US and things that are going to happen in the political side of the world that could affect the next month, month and a half.
"So I think it's relatively premature to be so convinced. But as it stands, we would go to Qatar and Abu Dhabi and if the FIA and Formula One decide that's still safe and a good scenario I think we as drivers have to go with whatever they say."
The US midterm elections are on November 3. President Donald Trump said on October 8 that the US will not launch an attack on Iran before those elections. 
The US and Israel launched strikes on Iran in February, with Tehran firing missiles and drones at Gulf neighbours that host American forces.
Sainz said the drivers lacked inside information and needed to trust in the decision-making of those running the show.
"The world can change a lot in the next month and we need to stay diligent and reactive to whatever happens and not just go because we want to go right now," added the Spaniard.

items.title: Sainz says talk of F1 racing in Middle East is 'premature'
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: Williams driver Carlos Sainz said talk of Formula One seeing out the season with races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi was "premature" in the current circumstances.
items.body:
Williams driver Carlos Sainz said talk of Formula One seeing out the season with races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi was "premature" in the current circumstances.
Formula One and the sport's governing body, the International Automobile Federation (FIA), have both said the calendar [USN:L6N466191 TEXT:"remains as scheduled"] despite conflict in the Gulf region and the Iran war.
FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem told reporters this week that the situation was currently "fine", the races were going to happen and he would be happy for his staff and teams to go. Qatar is scheduled for November 29 and Abu Dhabi for December 6.
Sainz, a director of the Grand Prix Drivers Association (GPDA), sounded less sure.
"I think they seem very convinced that it's going to go ahead. On my personal side, I'm not speaking as the GPDA, it's very difficult to be convinced right now," the Spaniard told reporters on Thursday ahead of the US Grand Prix in Austin.
"There's still plenty of things happening in the Middle East and also there is obviously an election that is going to happen in the US and things that are going to happen in the political side of the world that could affect the next month, month and a half.
"So I think it's relatively premature to be so convinced. But as it stands, we would go to Qatar and Abu Dhabi and if the FIA and Formula One decide that's still safe and a good scenario I think we as drivers have to go with whatever they say."
The US midterm elections are on November 3. President Donald Trump [USN:L1N45U0PH TEXT:"said on October 8"] that the US will not launch an attack on Iran before those elections.
The US and Israel launched strikes on Iran in February, with Tehran firing missiles and drones at Gulf neighbours that host American forces.
Sainz said the drivers lacked inside information and needed to trust in the decision-making of those running the show.
"The world can change a lot in the next month and we need to stay diligent and reactive to whatever happens and not just go because we want to go right now," added the Spaniard.
[USN:L6N43R03E TEXT:"Italy's Imola circuit"] has been lined up as a possible Plan B, although winter cold in early December could also make that challenging.
McLaren's Oscar Piastri said he would be happier going to Australia at that time of year.
"We might have to get some snowploughs out if we race in Imola," he added. "I think Imola is being kind of touted as the replacement. Hopefully it's above zero."

items.title: Australian agency mulled firing KPMG over data-handling rule breach, documents show
items.author: Byron Kaye, Christine Chen
items.creator: Byron Kaye, Christine Chen
items.summary: KPMG Australia breached a contract with the country's biggest federal agency by transferring sensitive government material outside its secure environment, prompting officials to consider firing the firm, documents reviewed by Reuters show.
items.body:
KPMG Australia breached a contract with the country's biggest federal agency by transferring sensitive government material outside its secure environment, prompting officials to consider firing the firm, documents reviewed by Reuters show.
The incident is the global accounting firm's first apparent violation of client information-handling protocols regarding its vast portfolio of Australian government work — A$650 million ($456 million) in active [USN:L1N42K03U TEXT:"federal contracts"] as of 2026.
KPMG's Australian unit has been at the centre of a [USN:L1N42R05P TEXT:"scandal"] over accusations it shared confidential private-sector client information to pitch for work, which it has admitted, but has maintained the conduct did not extend to government contracts.
The government incident in late 2025 involved Services Australia, which operates the country's public health and welfare systems and handles data of most of the country's population of 27 million.
Both KPMG and Services Australia said in comments to Reuters the matter did not involve any data breach, however the government agency has not awarded any new audit work to the firm since.
The incident came to light when a KPMG employee sent a draft audit report marked "OFFICIAL: Sensitive" from a KPMG email account rather than from a specifically-assigned account for Services Australia.
"It appears KPMG has taken agency materials outside of the network which is in breach of their obligations under the contract," a director of the Services Australia audit branch wrote to the agency's national audit manager, Sally Bond, in a December 17 email obtained under Freedom of Information law.
The director, whose name was redacted, recommended the agency demand an explanation from KPMG then "assess whether any further action is required ... including termination of contracts, noting there is no remedy available for a breach of this nature".
Bond wrote to KPMG a week later saying "information was transferred outside of the Services Australia environment by KPMG during our engagement", adding the transferral was "explicitly prohibited under the contract".
"Services Australia takes a breach of this nature extremely seriously," Bond wrote in the email dated December 23. "We will be in parallel engaging with our relevant agency teams to undertake a review of the situation."
In an email the same day to another Services Australia general manager, Bond wrote that the information taken outside the government system was not of "particular concern", but said: "I am more concerned that KPMG has acted outside the contract and has not taken any proactive steps to assure us of this fact".
In a response to Bond on December 23, KPMG said the only document transferred outside the agency was an internal audit report template which had been deleted, and the KPMG employee involved would face follow-up action, including additional training.
The documents didn't show whether Services Australia took additional measures, but an internal cybersecurity review into the incident concluded in January that the risk of data breach was low and closed it off.
NO NEW AUDIT WORK FOR KPMG FROM SERVICES AUSTRALIA KPMG said in a statement to Reuters it "confirmed with Services Australia that no confidential information was exchanged and reminded our people of their obligations in relation to data protocols".
A Services Australia spokesperson told Reuters KPMG had "used its own network and email system, rather than the agency's, to develop and distribute a draft internal audit report", but the incident did not amount to a data breach.
The agency "considered the available contractual options", the spokesperson added. Since "the work was substantially complete and remedial action had been taken, the agency finalised the engagement rather than terminate the contract".
"This was the only instance of this type occurring and Services Australia has not awarded KPMG additional internal audit work since the incident," they said.
The agency gave KPMG an A$12 million multi-year contract in 2024 for "program assurance services", and in April awarded the firm an A$69,850 contract to provide actuarial services, according to published government tender data.
Gary Monroe, a University of New South Wales professor who specialises in audit, said regardless of what material was taken outside the government system, "it's a breach of trust with the client".
On Thursday, the government said it had [USN:L1N468031 TEXT:"extended"] a ban on KPMG bidding for new federal work until February 28, while the firm fixes cultural and governance weaknesses.
($1 = 1.4247 Australian dollars)

items.title: Grupo México prevé invertir hasta 6,000 mln dlr en Asarco en próximos tres años
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El gigante minero Grupo México prevé destinar entre 4,000 y 6,000 millones de dólares en los próximos tres años a los principales proyectos de su filial estadounidense Asarco, dijo el jueves un ejecutivo, después de que reportó esta semana un declive en la producción del tercer trimestre.
items.body:
El gigante minero Grupo México prevé destinar entre 4,000 y 6,000 millones de dólares en los próximos tres años a los principales proyectos de su filial estadounidense Asarco, dijo el jueves un ejecutivo, después de que reportó esta semana un declive en la producción del tercer trimestre.
La producción de cobre de Grupo México (GMEXICOB.MX) , con negocios también en los sectores transporte e infraestructura, alcanzó en el tercer trimestre las 260,322 toneladas, un 1.9% por debajo del mismo periodo del año anterior, afectada por menores volúmenes en Perú y Asarco, en Estados Unidos.
La disminución fue parcialmente compensada por una mayor actividad en México, según su [USN:L6N4661HF TEXT:"informe trimestral"] divulgado el martes.
El director de la división minera, Leonardo Contreras, dijo a analistas durante una conferencia telefónica que la empresa mantiene la expansión de su mina Ray, en Arizona, al tiempo que lleva a cabo estudios de viabilidad.
Contreras añadió que la compañía es "cada vez más optimista" sobre la puesta en marcha de la fundición y refinería de Hayden, en Arizona, con capacidad para procesar 1.4 millones de toneladas anuales de concentrado de cobre.
El proyecto buscaría recuperar capacidad de procesamiento de cobre en Estados Unidos. "Esto supondría casi 350,000 toneladas métricas de cobre contenido y, si se incorporara a nuestra refinería, podríamos alcanzar las 500,000 toneladas métricas de cobre", añadió Contreras.
El ejecutivo dijo además que Silver Bell, también en Arizona, permanece en fase de estudios de viabilidad. La empresa espera tener mayor claridad sobre el proyecto en los próximos trimestres.

items.title: 米ロッキード、国防総省にＦ３５を850機供給で合意　通期業績見通し引き上げ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Mike Stone　Aatreyee Dasgupta

[２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Mike Stone　Aatreyee Dasgupta

[２２日 ロイター] - 米防衛機器大手ロッキード・マーチンは２２日、通期の売上高と利益の見通しを上方修正した。米国防総省に「Ｆ３５ライトニングⅡ」戦闘機を今後１０年間に少なくとも８５０機供給する枠組み合意も発表した。

同戦闘機は最も低価格な機種で１機当たり９２００万ドルであるため、１０年間の枠組み合意では少なくとも７８２億ドル相当に達する見込みだ。海兵隊向けの短距離離陸・垂直着陸が可能な「Ｆ３５Ｂ」は１億２１００万ドル、海軍向け「Ｆ３５Ｃ」は１億１０００万ドル。契約における機種構成は不明で、価格はインフレや人件費の上昇に伴って上がると予想される。

また同社は、２０２６年通期の売上高は約８００億─８２０億ドルになるとの見通しを示し、従来の７９７億５０００万─８１７億５０００万ドルから引き上げた。通期の１株当たり利益見通しも、従来の２９．９５─３０．６５ドルから３０．３５─３０．７５ドルに引き上げた。

２６年のフリーキャッシュフロー見通しも、従来の７０億─７２億ドルから約７８億─８０億ドルに引き上げた。

併せて発表した第３・四半期（９月２７日終了）の売上高は１１％増の２０７億１０００万ドル。ミサイル部門の売上高がＰＡＣ３とＴＨＡＡＤの増産で２４％伸びたほか、Ｆ３５とＣ１３０プログラムで航空部門も１３％増加したのが寄与した。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想は２０５億１０００万ドルだった。

同四半期の１株当たり利益は７．９７ドルで、アナリスト予想の７．４３ドルを上回った。

エバン・スコット最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）はロイターに対し、第４・四半期の設備投資増加は、弾薬生産能力の拡大に向けた投資が主因になるとの見方を示した。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日、一戸建て住宅の保有や住宅ローンに伴うコストの軽減を目指す大統領令に署名した。ホワイトハウスが発表した。

大統領令は、借り手が現在の市場価値に基づく自己資本比率の要件を満たした場合、住宅ローン保険料を自動的に打ち切る試験プログラムの開始を連邦住宅金融庁（ＦＨＦＡ）に指示するもの。また、借り換え時の権原保険を免除するＦＨＦＡの試験制度も恒久化する。

このほか、連邦政府の支援対象となる工場生産型住宅の普及拡大に向け、「住宅イノベーション・タスクフォース」を設置。農務長官と退役軍人省長官に対し、それぞれの省が提供する一戸建て住宅向け融資の金利引き下げに取り組むことも指示した。

items.title: New UK banking watchdog to review impact of rules on competitiveness
items.author: Kirstin Ridley, Phoebe Seers
items.creator: Kirstin Ridley, Phoebe Seers
items.summary: Britain's banking watchdog will review how financial regulation affects investment, capital and economic growth, signalling a sharper focus on transparency and an objective to promote competition.
items.body:
Britain's banking watchdog will review how financial regulation affects investment, capital and economic growth, signalling a sharper focus on transparency and an objective to promote competition.
Around four months after becoming CEO of the Prudential Regulation Authority, Katharine Braddick said the PRA would publish its first five-year strategy next year, focusing in part on ensuring its regime remained relevant, effective and proportionate.
"We will set out how that (competitiveness and growth) framework is embedded in our day-to-day decision-making and how we will track the effect our work is having on the growth and international competitiveness of the UK," she told a dinner at London's Mansion House on Thursday, in her first major speech in the role.
Braddick said the PRA, part of the Bank of England, would work with industry to develop its competitiveness and growth agenda, including examining how regulation influences investment, the availability of capital and the pricing of financial services.
RESILIENCE IS THE FIRST PRIORITY But ensuring the resilience of the UK's banking and insurance sectors remains the PRA's first priority, Braddick said, particularly given the threat of cyberattacks.
She laid out a dedicated supervisory division to act as a "centre of excellence" for operational and cyber resilience, reporting directly to her.
"We will significantly increase our focus on firms' operational and cyber resilience," she said.
Reuters reported this month that [USN:L6N45Z0FI TEXT:"banking regulators"] including the Bank of England were intensifying efforts to contain AI cyber risks.
The PRA and the Financial Conduct Authority on Thursday also laid out plans to further streamline a regime introduced after the 2007-09 financial crisis, in part by speeding up some senior bank job approvals.
In the second phase of a consultation on the Senior Managers & Certification Regime, or SMCR, regulators said lightening the regulatory load on the industry would cut annual compliance costs by 53% to about £229.9 million ($307.91 million).
SMCR rules include how firms should deal with senior manager roles, identify and assess people's fitness for office and report conduct breaches.
The regulators have said the final rules should be published in the first half of next year, with implementation in the second half of 2027.
($1 = 0.7467 pounds)

items.title: Apple bets iPhone Duo can remake foldable market as sales begin
items.author: Aditya Soni
items.creator: Aditya Soni
items.summary: For nearly two decades Apple has made only small changes to the iPhone, its money machine. That changes on Friday when Apple starts selling its first folding phone, iPhone Duo, betting that the device can do for the small foldables market what the iPhone did for smartphones.
items.body:
For nearly two decades Apple (AAPL.O) has made only small changes to the iPhone, its money machine. That changes on Friday when Apple starts selling its first folding phone, iPhone Duo, betting that the device can do for the small foldables market what the iPhone did for smartphones.
Its reception could prove an early test for new Apple CEO John Ternus, the former hardware chief who unveiled iPhone Duo barely a week after taking charge in September.
It could also have large implications for a niche category in which rivals such as Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and Huawei Technologies have sold premium offerings for years.
Within minutes of pre-orders opening last Friday, Apple's estimated delivery dates for the Duo had slipped to late January as demand outpaced supply. The company called the response from customers "nothing short of extraordinary."
MIXED REVIEWS Early reviews have praised the $1,999 Duo's premium design as well as its sturdy and barely visible hinge, a major feat for the phones whose prominent creased screen has long been a major drawback and potential deterrent to buyers.
But reviewers have also said that camera compromises including the absence of a telephoto lens and third-party apps that still need to be reworked for the new display size could disappoint some buyers. They have noted that iPhone Duo in its smaller, folded state is less handy for the litany of quick tasks that most users carry out each day on standard iPhones, leading several prominent reviewers to recommend against the Duo for many Apple customers.
"It's been a lot of fun trying the Duo out for a week, but it feels like I've gotten to use an extraordinarily polished prototype  —  not a finished product that I'd want to buy and carry," longtime Apple commentator John Gruber, the author of the blog Daring Fireball, wrote in a review.
Tech commentator Marques Brownlee, popularly known as MKBHD, said in a YouTube review that "if you're just a regular person who doesn't do much more than texting, social media and browsing here and there, then it is probably a no. But if the $2,000 doesn't mean much to you, and you like the idea, after the learning curve and getting used to not having facial identification, it is a really fun phone."
TOUGH TO FIND The limited supplies could disappoint Apple fans lining up in front of stores to buy the Duo. Apple told Reuters that walk-in availability would vary by country, with limited stocks in the US, Australia, Canada, Mexico and much of Britain and Europe. In China, France, Hong Kong, India and Japan, units would be available only for customers who had ordered online.
In the China-governed territory of Macau, where the iPhone Duo will be available for walk-in customers only, fans already started lining up hours in advance, social media posts and media reports showed.
"Foldables have been an established category for years, but adoption has remained relatively limited compared with conventional smartphones. Apple's entry could bring the format to a much broader audience," said Francisco Jeronimo, vice president at market research firm IDC.
IDC expects Apple will take 44% of the foldable value in 2026 on 31% of foldable units. By 2027, it will become the market leader in the category both in value and units shipped, according to the firm.
"Apple has made a convincing case for this form factor," Jeronimo said after spending a week with the Duo.
"Now comes the next test: turning excitement into availability, adoption and a lasting new chapter for the smartphone market," Jeronimo added.
items.raw_description: For nearly two decades Apple has made only small changes to the iPhone, its money machine. That changes on Friday when Apple starts selling its first folding phone, iPhone Duo, betting that the device can do for the small foldables market what the iPhone did for smartphones.

items.title: Ibovespa fecha em queda com tombo de 4% da Vale e ajuste antes de eleição
items.author: Paula Arend Laier
items.creator: Paula Arend Laier
items.summary: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta quinta-feira, quase perdendo o patamar dos 203 mil pontos no pior momento, contaminado pelo viés negativo em praças acionárias no exterior e ajustes antes do desfecho da disputa presidencial no Brasil no domingo.
items.body:
O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta quinta-feira, quase perdendo o patamar dos 203 mil pontos no pior momento, contaminado pelo viés negativo em praças acionárias no exterior e ajustes antes do desfecho da disputa presidencial no Brasil no domingo.
Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) recuou 1,15%, a 204.120,21 pontos, mas chegou a 203.051,87 na mínima do dia. No melhor momento, marcou 206.493,11 pontos. O volume financeiro no pregão somou R$39,45 bilhões.
A bolsa paulista encerrou os negócios com agentes financeiros na expectativa de nova pesquisa Datafolha, prevista para as 19h, em meio a um cenário ainda acirrado para o segundo turno da eleição para o Palácio do Planalto.
Na véspera, [USN:L6N4670YJ TEXT:"pesquisa Quaest"] divulgada pelo jornal O Globo mostrou o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) com 45% das intenções de votos, enquanto o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) somou 44%.
Desde o recorde intradia registrado no último dia 9 (209.713,45 pontos), ainda sob efeito do entusiasmo com o resultado do primeiro turno no dia 4, com Flávio à frente de Lula, o Ibovespa acumula um declínio de 2,67%. Em outubro, ainda sobe 9,54%.
"A impressão é que, no geral, o mercado está indo 'mais leve' para o segundo turno do que foi no primeiro", afirmou um gestor. "As pesquisas que o mercado mais olha estão mostrando um cenário bem apertado."
Estrangeiros têm sido um relevante suporte para as ações brasileiras no mês, com entrada líquida de R$20 bilhões até o dia 20.
No cenário externo, o índice acionário norte-americano S&P 500 (.SPX) terminou com declínio de 1,21%, com apreensões envolvendo inteligência artificial e o avanço do petróleo. O europeu STOXX 600 (.STOXX) fechou em [USN:L6N46819T TEXT:"queda"] de 1,01%.
Na visão do especialista de investimentos Josias Bento, sócio da GT Capital, a bolsa paulista refletiu uma combinação de tensão eleitoral pré-segundo turno, com os candidatos muito próximos nas pesquisas, e uma aversão ao risco no mercado internacional.
Em relação ao cenário doméstico, ele chamou atenção especial ao fato de que "os candidatos até agora não mostraram ou falaram de um plano de contingência para controlar as contas públicas, que é uma das principais agendas para 2027".
DESTAQUES VALE ON (VALE3.SA) recuou 3,97%, acompanhando o viés negativo de mineradoras no exterior (.SXPP) . Na China, o contrato futuro de [USN:L6N4680V1 TEXT:"minério de ferro"] mais negociado na Bolsa de Mercadorias de Dalian (DCE) caiu 1,62%, para 669 iuanes (US$100,23) por tonelada. No setor de mineração e siderurgia no Brasil, CSN ON (CSNA3.SA) perdeu 5,43%, USIMINAS PNA fechou em queda de 4,81% e GERDAU PN (GGBR4.SA) cedeu 3,92%. Números divulgados pela Inda também mostraram que, em setembro, os distribuidores de [USN:L1N4680WC TEXT:"aços planos"], que costumam ser responsáveis por cerca de um terço das vendas das usinas siderúrgicas nacionais, tiveram queda de 7,2% na comercialização sobre um ano antes.
PETROBRAS PN (PETR3.SA) fechou com acréscimo de 0,14%, apesar da forte alta dos preços do petróleo no exterior, onde o barril do Brent terminou com elevação de 4%, a US$113,17, em meio a uma nova [USN:L1N46801N TEXT:"escalada"] das tensões no Oriente Médio. No setor, PRIO ON (PRIO3.SA) avançou 1,85% e BRAVA ON (BRAV3.SA) subiu 0,24%, enquanto PETRORECONCAVO ON (RECV3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, recuou 1,29%.
BRADESCO PN cedeu 2,08%, tendo no radar a divulgação do balanço do terceiro trimestre após o fechamento do mercado. Estimativas compiladas pela LSEG apontam lucro líquido de R$7,1 bilhões. No setor, BTG PACTUAL UNIT recuou 1,37%, SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT perdeu 1,35%, ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN caiu 1,84% e BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) fechou em baixa de 0,75%.
MBRF ON (MBRF3.SA) caiu 2,71%, com investidores ainda especulando potenciais reflexos da ocorrência de [USN:L1N4650PD TEXT:"foco da doença"] de Newcastle em estabelecimento de criação comercial de perus da empresa em Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. Na véspera, a companhia disse que "entende que eventuais impactos decorrentes da ocorrência sobre suas operações, situação econômico-financeira ou resultados, se houver, não serão materiais". No setor, JBS , que é listada nos Estados Unidos, encerrou com declínio de 0,80%.
BRADSAÚDE ON (SAUD3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, avançou 4,22%, após reportar [USN:L1N467172 TEXT:"lucro líquido"] de R$1,1 bilhão no terceiro trimestre, avanço de 14,4% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior. A companhia vinculada ao grupo Bradesco também anunciou que vai distribuir dividendos intercalares de R$1 bilhão, equivalente a R$0,34 por ação em circulação.

items.title: Trump says wind turbine imports threaten national security
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US President Donald Trump on Thursday declared imports of wind turbines and their components a threat to national security, but stopped short of imposing new tariffs on the sector.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump on Thursday declared imports of wind turbines and their components a threat to national security, but stopped short of imposing new tariffs on the sector.
In a White House proclamation, Trump said a Commerce Department investigation found that imported wind turbines threatened national security due to cybersecurity concerns tied to foreign-made equipment, interference with radar systems and air traffic operations, and an increased US reliance on goods made overseas.
The move responds to a probe [USN:L1N3UD0KZ TEXT:"launched"] in August 2025 under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act. It is one of numerous trade investigations the administration has conducted into the national security ramifications of imports across an array of sectors.
Instead of ordering immediate trade restrictions, Trump directed trade officials to pursue negotiations with trading partners and report back within 180 days.
Additional trade measures, including tariffs, could be considered later, the order said.
The order repeats Trump's longstanding criticism of wind energy as being unreliable because it is intermittent.
"Given wind energy’s intermittent reliability, use of wind energy diverts the United States electrical grid from more reliable energy sources," the order said.
Major suppliers of wind turbines and components to the United States include Mexico, France, India, Denmark and Germany, according to trade data cited by the center-right think tank American Action Forum.
A spokesperson for the American Clean Power Association, a trade group representing clean energy companies, was not immediately available for comment.
items.raw_description: US President Donald Trump on Thursday declared imports of wind turbines and their components a threat to national security, but stopped short of imposing new tariffs on the sector.

items.title: Former Eminem employee pleads guilty to criminal copyright infringement
items.author: Blake Brittain
items.creator: Blake Brittain
items.summary: A former employee of rapper Eminem pleaded guilty on Thursday to a criminal copyright infringement charge for selling unreleased music from the rapper without permission, according to a filing in Michigan federal court.
items.body:
A former employee of rapper Eminem pleaded guilty on Thursday to a criminal copyright infringement charge for selling unreleased music from the rapper without permission, according to a filing in Michigan federal court.
Joseph Strange, 48, faces up to five years in prison for selling several unreleased Eminem songs in 2024 for around $50,000, the plea agreement said
The agreement said that the tracks were later leaked to the internet and streamed between eight and nine million times
Strange worked for Eminem, whose given name is Marshall Mathers, at a Ferndale, Michigan, music studio from approximately 2007 to 2021
Strange's conduct "undermined both legal and artistic rights," Assistant Attorney General A. Tysen Duva said in a statement
"Joe Strange is a good man whose children have suffered greatly in all of this," Strange's attorney Wade Fink said in a statement. "It is a far more complicated and nuanced matter than a man just unabashedly stealing."
Spokespeople for Eminem's label Universal Music Group did not immediately respond to a request for comment

items.title: Moderna sheds about $24 billion as cancer vaccine data triggers 'sell-the-news' retreat
items.author: Kamal Choudhury
items.creator: Kamal Choudhury
items.summary: Moderna's shares sank over 25% on Thursday as late-stage trial data for its personalized melanoma vaccine, developed with Merck , triggered what analysts called a "sell-the-news" reaction after a months-long stock surge.
items.body:
Moderna's (MRNA.O) shares sank over 25% on Thursday as late-stage trial data for its personalized melanoma vaccine, developed with Merck (MRK.N) , triggered what analysts called a "sell-the-news" reaction after a months-long stock surge.
The selloff wiped out about $24 billion from the drugmaker's market value, halting a massive rally that has lifted the stock over 500% this year.
Moderna was last down 25.2% at $183.88, set for its steepest one-day percentage fall on record, while Merck shares fell nearly 1%.
The companies, in August, reported [USN:L1N44G0D3 TEXT:"interim data"] that showed the experimental vaccine, intismeran, cut the risk of recurrence and cancer spread in high-risk melanoma patients in a late-stage trial with over 1,100 patients.
[USN:L1N46814F TEXT:"Detailed results"] from the trial on Thursday showed that intismeran combined with Merck's immunotherapy Keytruda [USN:L1N468128 TEXT:"reduced the risk"] of cancer recurrence or death by 42%, while cutting the risk of distant metastasis or death by 38% compared to Keytruda alone.
Moderna and Merck released the data after the results leaked on an oncology website earlier in the day, sparking the stock fall.
'SOLID DATA' UBS analyst Michael Yee said the recurrence-free survival results are "solid data," and that the pullback was an expected "'sell the news' event," referring to the trading strategy of buying shares when a rumor appears and selling them when it becomes a reality.
Expectations were high given the rally driven by "bullish commentary from the companies," he said.
William Blair analyst Myles Minter described the trial data as "great" and concurred that the reversal appears to be a "sell-the-news" reaction.
But investors may now be questioning whether the treatment will prove as effective in other cancer types to justify the high valuation, Minter said.
TD Cowen analysts also said the 42% recurrence reduction was "compelling" and squarely in the "exceptional range" defined by medical experts.
Merck and Moderna said overall survival data are not yet mature but show a "favorable trend," and said they are engaging with regulatory authorities.
The results, based on patient data for the first two years after treatment, are scheduled to be presented on Saturday at the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting in Madrid.

[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - 米連邦通信委員会（ＦＣＣ）は２２日、中国の通信機器大手、華為技術（ファーウェイ）の子会社が製造した監視向け半導体が搭載された２製品について、米国内での販売を禁止したと発表した。ＦＣＣが新たな規則に基づく権限を行使したのは今回が初めて。

ＦＣＣが販売を禁止したのは、ダッシュボードカメラと無線映像送信機。いずれもファーウェイ子会社のハイシリコンが製造した半導体が搭載されている。ハイシリコンはこの半導体を「監視市場向けに設計されている」と宣伝しているほか、「人の顔を検知するアルゴリズム」を備えていると説明しているという。

この件について、ファーウェイとハイシリコンからコメントは得られていない。

items.title: 原油先物4％高、5カ月ぶり高値　サウジ攻撃で供給懸念
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Scott DiSavino

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Scott DiSavino

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 米国時間の原油先物は、北海ブレント先物が約４％上昇し、５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアでの攻撃を受け、主要なエネルギー輸出地域からの供給に一段の混乱が生じるとの懸念が強まった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が４．３５ドル（４．０％）高の１バレル＝１１３．１７ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は２．３２ドル（２．４％）高の９９．４７ドルだった。

ブレントは５月４日以来の高値で取引を終えた。テクニカル指標では、この１週間で３度目の買われ過ぎの状態となった。

エネルギー助言会社リターブッシュ・アンド・アソシエーツのアナリストはリポートで「米中間選挙後に米国とイスラエルがイランを共同攻撃するとの観測が浮上する中、フーシ派によるサウジのインフラへの追加攻撃でリスクプレミアムが再び大きく上乗せされ、原油相場は反発している」と指摘した。

items.title: 仏大統領、「正当性ない」抗議活動禁止へ　暴動は「極左に責任」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Michel Rose

[パリ　２２日　 ロイター] -
items.body:
Michel Rose

[パリ　２２日　 ロイター] - フランスのマクロン大統領は２２日、教育環境の改善などを求める大規模な抗議デモが各地で続く中、「正当性のない」抗議活動を向こう数日以内に禁止すると表明した。また、先週末に発生した暴動や略奪は極左の「扇動的な」団体や破壊行為者に責任があるとの認識を示した。

マクロン氏はこの日、情報機関トップや主要閣僚との会合を実施。会合後に記者団に対し「１７日に国家の転覆を目的とする極左団体による政治的かつ扇動的な行為があった」と述べ、労働組合などが主催するデモについては実施を認めるものの、商店などを保護するためデモ隊のルート変更を求める可能性があると語った。

ダルマナン法相は、デモ参加禁止命令に違反した人の選挙権停止のほか、暴力行為や略奪、警察への攻撃に関与した人に対するソーシャルメディアの利用制限を導入したい考えを示した。

地元当局によると、フランス第２、第３の都市であるマルセイユとリヨンで２４日に予定されていた全ての抗議活動は禁止されている。ただ、フランス最大の学生組合ＵＮＥＦは２４日に集会を呼びかけているほか、２０１８年に発足した反体制運動「黄色いベスト運動」もパリ中心部を行進する計画を届け出るなど、新たな抗議活動の動きは広がりつつある。

２２日はパリで予定されていた学生による抗議集会が当初は禁止されたが、その後実施が認められた。ただ、無許可の集会が開かれる可能性が警戒される中、公共交通当局はパリ中心部の複数の地下鉄駅を閉鎖している。

items.title: Actor Tom Skerritt, star of 'Alien' and 'Top Gun,' dies at 93
items.author: Will Dunham
items.creator: Will Dunham
items.summary: Versatile actor Tom Skerritt, who starred in Hollywood megahits including the sci-fi classic "Alien," the war comedy "M*A*S*H," and the action drama "Top Gun," has died at the age of 93.
items.body:
Versatile actor Tom Skerritt, who starred in Hollywood megahits including the sci-fi classic "Alien," the war comedy "M*A*S*H," and the action drama "Top Gun," has died at the age of 93.
Skerritt, a Detroit native whose Hollywood career spanned from the 1960s to the 2020s, died on Wednesday of natural causes, his family said in a statement.
"While the world knew Tom through his remarkable acting career, we knew him for his humor, curiosity, wisdom, generosity, and the love he brought into our lives," they said. "He cared deeply about imagination, creativity, storytelling, service, veterans, the natural world, and helping others find and share their own voices."
Known for his rugged good looks and ability to shine in a variety of genres, Skerritt delivered memorable performances in leading and supporting roles in film and television.
Skerritt's breakthrough role was a roguish US Army surgeon in director Robert Altman's 1970 Korean War black comedy "M*A*S*H," a film whose ensemble cast also included Donald Sutherland, Elliott Gould and Sally Kellerman. Skerritt played Southerner Duke Forrest as the doctors at the Mobile Army Surgical Hospital stitched up wounded troops.
The film, whose popularity coincided with American unease over the Vietnam War, was nominated for five Academy Awards.
In director Ridley Scott's claustrophobic 1979 sci-fi horror "Alien," Skerritt played Dallas, the captain of an ill-fated spacecraft whose crew encounters a deadly parasitic extraterrestrial creature with a surrealist look and a bad attitude. In the film's famous and bloody "chestburster" scene, Skerritt's character is seated next to cast mate John Hurt when a baby alien violently exits the torso of Hurt's character.
"Alien," an influential masterpiece whose ensemble cast also included Sigourney Weaver and Ian Holm, earned two Oscar nominations.
"It is spontaneity and impulse that make the difference, and that is what I felt we had with 'Alien.' Every one of us had that immediate rapport with each other — the respect that I had for the other actors and the respect that they had for me," Skerritt told interviewer Peter Sobczynski in 2019, while also lauding Scott's directorial brilliance.
"Alien" was one of several films in which Skerritt appeared that featured strong female characters, in this case Weaver's courageous character Ripley. That was considered pioneering at the time.
"When I read the script, one of the things that I liked most about it was that the woman becomes the hero. I loved that," Skerritt said.
"The sight of women being in positions of strength and fortitude to make the right connections and decisions was what appealed to me. I experienced that as well in 'Steel Magnolias,' with the women in that. I liked the idea of women being tough and strong and influential."
In "Steel Magnolias" (1989), Skerritt played Drum Eatenton, husband of Sally Field's M'Lynn Eatenton.
Tony Scott, the brother of the "Alien" director, cast Skerritt in the key supporting role of naval aviation instructor Viper Metcalf in the 1986 blockbuster "Top Gun" that helped star Tom Cruise soar into Hollywood's stratosphere.
Skerritt also played Shirley MacLaine's husband in director Herbert Ross's 1977 ballet drama "The Turning Point," and starred alongside another emerging star in Brad Pitt in Robert Redford's beautifully shot 1992 period drama "A River Runs Through It."
Among other films in which he appeared were: "Harold and Maude" (1971), "Ice Castles" (1978), "The Dead Zone" (1983), "Poltergeist III" (1988), "Contact" (1997), "Tears of the Sun" (2003) and "Ted" (2012).
On the small screen, Skerritt starred in the offbeat CBS series "Picket Fences" from 1992 to 1996, playing a Wisconsin town sheriff and claiming an Emmy as outstanding lead actor in a drama series in 1993.
Born on August 25, 1933, in Detroit, Skerritt served in the US Air Force before becoming an actor, making his film debut in 1962 alongside a young Redford in "War Hunt." He was a father of five children and was married three times.

items.title: Trump signs order aimed at reducing single-family housing costs
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US President Donald Trump on Thursday signed an executive order aimed at reducing expenses for homeowners by lowering insurance premiums, refinancing costs and interest rates on certain government-backed home loans, the White House said.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump on Thursday signed an executive order aimed at reducing expenses for homeowners by lowering insurance premiums, refinancing costs and interest rates on certain government-backed home loans, the White House said.
High home prices and elevated mortgage rates have put pressure on the Trump administration to deliver meaningful relief as affordability has emerged as a political vulnerability for Republicans ahead of the November midterm elections.
Trump's order directs the Federal Housing Finance Agency to launch a pilot program to cancel borrowers' mortgage insurance premiums once they meet equity requirements based on current market values. It also makes permanent an FHFA pilot program waiving title insurance requirements for mortgage refinancings.
In addition, the order establishes a task force on manufactured housing innovation to expand factory-built homes eligible for federal housing programs, and directs the agriculture and veterans affairs secretaries to reduce interest rates on single-family home loans issued by their departments.
Contracts to buy previously owned US homes plunged to a [USN:L1N4650NQ TEXT:"record low"] in September as rising mortgage rates depressed demand for housing, according to the National Association of Realtors.
US single-family housing starts [USN:L1N4650SY TEXT:"fell 4.6%"] in September, while permits for future construction dropped 4% to their lowest level in 3-1/2 years, underscoring the challenges facing the housing market as borrowing costs rise.
The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate last week reached 7.40%, the highest in about three years, before falling to 7.32% this week, according to Freddie Mac. The yield on the 10-year Treasury note, which acts as a pricing benchmark for mortgages, has fallen by more than a quarter percentage point in the last two weeks.

By Jack Queen
Oct 22 (Reuters) – A federal judge on Thursday ordered Donald Trump to sit for a deposition by December 11 in his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC, which has accused the US president of stalling to avoid answering questions under oath.

Trump is suing Britain’s publicly funded broadcaster for at least $10 billion over a misleadingly edited clip of a speech. The case is one of several Trump has privately filed against the news media as part of a wider pressure campaign against coverage he dislikes. 

US Magistrate Judge Enjolique Lett ordered Trump to take questions from the BBC’s lawyers under oath in a ruling from the bench at a court hearing on Thursday, according to a spokesman for Trump’s personal legal team. Trump canceled a deposition in October, citing conflicts with his presidential duties. 

Show Full Article

The Trump spokesman said the lawsuit is aimed at holding the BBC accountable for defamation and “reckless election interference.”

The BBC declined to comment. It previously admitted the edits were misleading and apologized to Trump, though it denies being liable for defamation. 

Trump’s lawsuit filed in December in Florida federal court accuses the BBC of intentionally misleading viewers into thinking he directed supporters to storm the US Capitol by splicing together different parts of a January 6, 2021, speech. 

In court filings, the broadcaster has accused Trump and his lawyers of dragging their feet in response to their requests for records and other information that is exchanged between parties in a process known as discovery. 

The BBC is seeking financial records from Trump’s Mar-a-Lago club and the web of business entities associated with him, saying the information is necessary to defend against Trump’s damages claims. 

Trump’s lawyers say the requests are too broad and irrelevant to the case. They have also denied in court filings that Trump is avoiding a deposition, saying Trump’s duties and security needs must take precedence. 

The edited speech appeared in a BBC “Panorama” documentary show shortly before the 2024 presidential election, which Trump won. A leaked internal BBC memo cited the edits as evidence of potential political bias, sparking a public relations crisis for the broadcaster and leading to high-level resignations. 

(Reporting by Ryan Patrick Jones in Toronto and Jack Queen in New York; Editing by Michelle Nichols, Bill Berkrot and Daniel Wallis)

items.title: Juventus salvage Rennes draw as Benfica, Leverkusen stay perfect
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Juventus dropped their first points of the Europa League campaign after coming from behind to draw 2-2 with visitors Rennes on Thursday.
items.body:
Juventus dropped their first points of the Europa League campaign after coming from behind to draw 2-2 with visitors Rennes on Thursday.
Benfica went top of the standings with a 4-1 demolition of Omonia in Cyprus, after Bayer Leverkusen had also moved onto nine points with a 2-0 win at OFI in Crete.
Bournemouth also maintained their perfect start with a 3-0 victory over 10-man AC Milan. Olympiacos and Ferencvaros made it three wins from three as well, beating Sparta Prague 1-0 and Torreense 4-1 respectively.
Zeki Celik gave Juventus a fifth-minute lead, but the French side kept their composure and were level 10 minutes later when Jordan international Musa Al-Taamari finished from close range for his first goal in the competition.
Rennes then stunned the hosts with a Boulaye Dia penalty two minutes before the break as the Italians struggled to create chances until Nick Woltemade equalised from the spot in the 67th minute.
The German forward twice went close to scoring again as Luciano Spalletti's team upped the pressure, and Juve thought they had won it in the 88th minute when Jhon Lucumi found the net from close range, but his effort was ruled out for offside.
The draw at least spared Juventus a second successive defeat following Sunday's 3-0 home [USN:L6N46407C TEXT:"loss"] to Lazio in Serie A.
Jonas Hofmann made the most of his surprise start for Bayer Leverkusen, scoring twice in three minutes to give the Bundesliga side a 2-0 victory at OFI.
