TURIN, Italy, Oct 22 : Juventus dropped their first points of the Europa League campaign after coming from behind to draw 2-2 with visitors Rennes on Thursday.
Benfica went top of the standings with a 4-1 demolition of Omonia in Cyprus, after Bayer Leverkusen had also moved onto nine points with a 2-0 win at OFI in Crete.
Bournemouth also maintained their perfect start with a 3-0 victory over 10-man AC Milan. Olympiacos and Ferencvaros made it three wins from three as well, beating Sparta Prague 1-0 and Torreense 4-1 respectively.
Zeki Celik gave Juventus a fifth-minute lead, but the French side kept their composure and were level 10 minutes later when Jordan international Musa Al-Taamari finished from close range for his first goal in the competition.

Rennes then stunned the hosts with a Boulaye Dia penalty two minutes before the break as the Italians struggled to create chances until Nick Woltemade equalised from the spot in the 67th minute.
The German forward twice went close to scoring again as Luciano Spalletti's team upped the pressure, and Juve thought they had won it in the 88th minute when Jhon Lucumi found the net from close range, but his effort was ruled out for offside.
The draw at least spared Juventus a second successive defeat following Sunday's 3-0 home loss to Lazio in Serie A.
Jonas Hofmann made the most of his surprise start for Bayer Leverkusen, scoring twice in three minutes to give the Bundesliga side a 2-0 victory at OFI.
OFI, who stunned Hoffenheim 2-0 in their opening league-phase match, were twice caught napping by Hofmann, who was added to the side following an injury to Martin Terrier.
Bournemouth took control against Milan through first-half penalties from Justin Kluivert and Marcus Tavernier before Amine Adli added a third in the 84th minute. Milan goalkeeper Mike Maignan was sent off in the 28th minute.
Hoffenheim beat Olympique Lyonnais 3-0 to claim their first win of the competition, but the victory was overshadowed by an injury to Lyon defender Steeve Kango. Kango fell awkwardly after an aerial challenge and was carried off on a stretcher wearing a neck brace before being taken to hospital for checks.

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

直近四半期の売上高の伸びが鈍化したスーパーマーケット大手セインズベリーは２．２％安。ホテル経営大手のインターコンチネンタル・ホテルズ・グループ（ＩＨＧ）は２．７％安。

ロンドン証券取引所グループ（ＬＳＥＧ）は７．７％高。金融データ企業の買収で合意したことが好材料視された。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

反落して取引を終えた。銀行株の売り注文が目立った。原油高やフランス国債利回りの上昇も相場の重荷となった。

ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は４．１７％安。四半期決算を発表したスペインの銀行バンキンターは７．６％下落。英銀大手バークレイズは２．３％安。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州高級品株１０種指数は０．９１％安。足元の売上高が市場予想に届かずフランスの高級ブランド大手エルメスは４．９％下落した。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は２．０４％安。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への懸念が再燃し、欧州の半導体大手ＳＴマイクロエレクトロニクスは４．９％、オランダの半導体製造装置メーカーＡＳＭＬホールディングは５．０％、ドイツの半導体大手インフィニオン・テクノロジーズは６．０％いずれも下落した。

一方、食品・飲料株指数は１．９２％高。売上高の伸び率が市場予想を上回ったスイスの食品大手ネスレは１．１％上昇した。ヘルスケア株指数は２．０７％上昇。堅調な業績予想を示したベルギーのバイオ医薬品グループ、ユーシービーは２１．６％高だった。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

独仏１０年債利回り格差が１５年ぶりの高水準に拡大した。フランスの厳しい財政状況と抗議デモ継続への懸念が投資家心理を圧迫した。

フランスの指標１０年債利回りは終盤、６．５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の５．０６％。一時は５．１４１５％と、２００２年７月以来の高水準を付けた。

安全資産とされるドイツ国債との利回り格差は１７７．７ｂｐと、ユーロ圏債務危機下の２０１１年１１月以来の水準に拡大。フランスの財政見通しに対する投資家の不安を浮き彫りにした。

ユーロ圏の指標となる独１０年債利回りは７ｂｐ低下の３．３４％。原油価格が上昇する中でも、安全資産需要が独国債を支えた。

独国債に対する利回り格差はユーロ圏全体で拡大した。ベルギーは１０ｂｐ拡大の１１０ｂｐと、２０１２年以来の高水準となった。イタリアは１０．５ｂｐ拡大の１２３ｂｐ、スペインは６ｂｐ拡大の７０ｂｐ、ギリシャは８．５ｂｐ拡大の１０６ｂｐだった。

金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りは６ｂｐ低下し、３．０２％となった。

短期金融市場が終盤に織り込む２７年末のＥＣＢ中銀預金金利は３．１５％。０．２５％ポイントの利上げを２回実施し、３回目を実施する確率が８０％であることを示している。

items.title: トランプ氏、マスク氏がウクライナ向けスターリンクを回復と表明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jacob Bogage

[ワシントン／キーウ　２２日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Jacob Bogage

[ワシントン／キーウ　２２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日、米宇宙開発企業スペースＸを率いるイーロン・マスク氏が、ウクライナ向け衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」へのアクセスを回復させたと述べた。この問題でマスク氏と協議したかについては言及を避けた。

これに先立ち、米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）は、トランプ氏がマスク氏に電話し、ウクライナに対するスターリンクの利用制限を解除するよう求めたと報道。トランプ氏はマスク氏に対し、ウクライナ向けのスターリンクの通信速度が制限された状態が続いていることに不満を示したとしていた。

トランプ氏はマスク氏と話したかと記者団に問われ、「それについてはコメントしたくない。私が電話したのか、他の誰かが電話したのかは、どちらでも変わらないと思う。要するに、彼が元に戻したということだ」と述べた。それ以上の説明はしなかった。 

ウクライナは戦場での通信やドローン（無人機）の運用にスターリンクを利用している。サービスの制限は、ロシアに対する攻撃や防空のためのドローン運用を妨げていた。 

ＷＳＪは、米国とウクライナの当局者の話として、トランプ氏とマスク氏の協議後まもなくスターリンクは通常に近い状態で利用できるようになったと伝えた。

一部のウクライナ当局者は同紙に対し、完全には機能が回復していないものの、システムは制限下よりも高速で稼働していると述べた。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領はＷＳＪの報道に先立ち、スターリンクの通信速度は回復していないと述べ、この問題について向こう数日以内にルビオ米国務長官と協議できることを期待していると語っていた。

トランプ氏はスターリンクの速度制限に関する決定への関与を否定している。ルビオ氏は２１日、ウクライナによるスターリンクへのアクセスに関する決定はホワイトハウスではなく、運営会社のスペースＸとマスク氏次第だと記者団に述べた。

items.title: 和平協議、ロシア・ウクライナ双方への安保確約軸に　プーチン氏主張
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［モスクワ　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［モスクワ　２２日　ロイター］ - ロシアのプーチン大統領は２２日、ウクライナ戦争の終結に向けた今後の協議では、ロシアとウクライナ双方に対する安全保障の確約と、欧州全体の安全保障の枠組みを議論の中心に据えるべきだと述べた。

米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使との会談翌日にロシアのテレビインタビューに応じ、米国仲介によるウクライナとの協議を１１月に再開する用意があると確認した。

プーチン氏は、ロシアは戦争を始めることを望んでいなかったが、自国が懸念する主要な問題についてウクライナから敵対的な反応を受けたとする従来の立場を改めて示した。

さまざまな問題について協議すれば前向きな結果につながる可能性があるとする一方、ロシアが求めているのは短期間の停戦ではなく、紛争を終結させる解決策だと強調。

「協議の目標は、短期間の一時的な停戦によってではなく、最終的な和平合意に達した後のウクライナとロシアの安全を確保することだ。この目標を達成するため、協議を再開する用意がある」と語った。

プーチン氏は、ウィットコフ氏も「欧州全体の安全保障の枠組み」にまで議論を広げる必要があると強調したと説明。「私もその点に同意する。今後数日間の展開を見てみよう」と述べた。

プーチン氏は２１日、ウィットコフ氏と会談後、ウクライナ和平に向けた米国仲介の協議を来月にも再開することで合意。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領も同日、ロシア、米国、ウクライナの実務レベル協議を早期に開催するとの米国の提案を支持すると表明した。 

ウクライナ戦争を巡る争点の多くは領土に関するもので、ロシアはウクライナ東部ドンバス地域の全域を割譲するよう要求している。ウクライナ側は、現在支配している領土の放棄を一切拒否している。

プーチン氏は、ウクライナ東部の領土に関するいかなる議論でも、同地域が「歴史的にロシアの土地」であるという自身の主張を考慮する必要があると述べた。

その上で、ロシアが侵攻を開始してから７カ月後に実施された住民投票で、同地域の住民はロシアへの編入を支持したと指摘。「まず、この問題に関する私の立場は、ここは彼らの領土ではないということだ。歴史的にロシアの領土だ」と語った。

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝円が大幅高、原油高やＡＩ収益懸念で安全資産買い
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、円が１日としては約１カ月ぶりの大幅上昇となる見通し。株式市場の不安定な動きや中東での戦争長期化に伴う原油高、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資の将来の収益性に対する疑念を背景に、投資家が安全資産を求めた。

円は対ドルで０．７５％上昇し、１ドル＝１５６．９６円となった。

円相場の動きの一部は、重要な節目である１ドル＝１６０円に近づいていたことも背景にある可能性がある。この水準に近づくほど、日本当局が円を下支えするため再び介入する可能性が高まると見られている。

ドルは、円と同様に伝統的な安全資産とされるスイスフランに対して０．４２％下落し、１ドル＝０．８２１フランとなった。

円やユーロなど主要通貨に対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．０８％低下し、１０１．６０。

ユーロは０．０９％下落し、１ユーロ＝１．１２２２ドルとなった。

ウェルズ・ファーゴのグローバル為替戦略責任者、エリック・ネルソン氏は「米国のＡＩ関連企業の信用力とフランスの国家としての信用力という、それぞれの弱点を巡る材料がせめぎ合っている。ここ数日は、どちらへの懸念が強いかによって相場が左右されている。フランスへの懸念が米国のＡＩ関連企業の信用力への懸念を上回る限り、ユーロは相対的に軟調に推移するだろう」と語った。

フランスが巨額の債務負担に対処できるかどうかへの懸念が同国の国債を圧迫し、債務水準が高い他のユーロ圏諸国への不安も高めている。

英ポンドは０．０５％上昇し、１ポンド＝１．３４０１ドル。豪ドルは０．１１％下落し、１豪ドル＝０．７０１９米ドルとなった。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは４．２７％下落し、８万１０２３ドルとなった。

items.author: CNA

Oct 22 : Manchester United's all-time leading scorer Wayne Rooney called the club's players "selfish" and said they were "like babies" after captain Bruno Fernandes questioned the coaching staff's tactics following Wednesday's 4-1 Champions League thrashing by Como.
Fernandes said United failed to apply enough pressure and adopted a "mood of defeat" after conceding in the second minute, as the heavy loss intensified scrutiny of manager Michael Carrick.
United's collapse at Como left them staring at another damaging defeat, with only a stoppage-time goal from Joshua Zirkzee reducing the margin of loss.
The criticism follows signs of growing frustration within the squad. Earlier this month, defender Lisandro Martinez criticised the club's hierarchy after a 2-0 Champions League defeat by Atletico Madrid, saying he expected greater investment to help the team compete at the highest level.

"When Martinez came out, I said this is an absolute nightmare because it will rip the dressing room apart," Rooney told the United Stand podcast on Thursday. "That was the start. We've seen it now with Bruno and you're going to see it with more players because they don't want to take responsibility.
"You can say whether Bruno was right or wrong in what he said but you have to take responsibility on the pitch. You have to take responsibility as a group of players.
"These players, they're selfish. They don't care about their teammates, don't care about the manager, the staff or the fans, they care about themselves.
"If they're not getting what's right for them, they're like babies and just throw. their toys out of the pram and go and deflect the blame on to anyone else but themselves."
Carrick, a former United midfielder who played alongside Rooney at Old Trafford, was appointed on an interim basis following Ruben Amorim's dismissal in January before earning a contract through 2028 after overseeing a dramatic improvement in results.
Carrick is under growing pressure with United winless in seven matches across all competitions. They are 20th in the Champions League standings and 13th in the Premier League.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Trump says Musk restored Ukraine's Starlink access, declines to say if they spoke
items.author: Jacob Bogage , Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Jacob Bogage , Kanishka Singh
items.summary: Donald Trump said on Thursday that SpaceX CEO Elon Musk had restored Ukraine's Starlink access but the US president declined to comment when asked whether he had spoken to the billionaire about the matter.
items.body:
Donald Trump said on Thursday that SpaceX (SPCX.O) CEO Elon Musk had restored Ukraine's Starlink access but the US president declined to comment when asked whether he had spoken to the billionaire about the matter.
The Wall Street Journal reported earlier on Thursday that Trump had called Musk and asked him to lift restrictions on Ukraine's use of Starlink.
"I don't want to comment on it, whether I called or whether somebody else called, doesn't make any difference, I guess. The bottom line - he put it back," Trump told reporters when asked if he spoke to Musk. Trump did not elaborate further.
Ukraine uses Starlink for battlefield communications and drone operations. Restricting the satellite service [USN:L8N4600M6 TEXT:"hampered"] the country's attack and air defense drone missions against Russia.
The Starlink system was working more normally on Thursday, shortly after the Trump-Musk conversation, the WSJ reported earlier, citing US and Ukrainian officials.
Some Ukrainian officials told the newspaper the system had not been restored to full functionality but was working at higher speeds than under the cap.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said earlier on Thursday that speed on Starlink systems had not been restored for Ukraine, adding that he hoped for talks with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in the coming days.
Trump told Musk he was frustrated the system's speeds remained capped, according to the newspaper.
Trump has denied being involved in the decision concerning the slowdown. Rubio told reporters on Wednesday that decisions regarding Ukraine's [USN:L6N467096 TEXT:"access to Starlink"] were up to its parent company SpaceX and Musk, not the White House.
Zelenskiy's relations with Washington have sunk to new lows after Trump announced a deal to buy Russian diesel and waived new sanctions on Moscow. Trump has also told Kyiv to stop attacking Russian refineries and urged Ukrainians to replace Zelenskiy.
Russia [USN:L1N4671BN TEXT:"pounded Kyiv"] with ballistic missiles and Ukraine sent hundreds of drones towards Moscow on Thursday, as the warring sides kept up a barrage of attacks despite the latest US push to end the conflict. Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in early 2022.
Trump had promised to end the war when he took office but the goal has remained elusive.

items.body:
[ローマ　２２日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行 （ＥＣＢ ）理事会メンバーのパネッタ・イタリア中銀総裁は２２日、銀行による自国国債の保有を制限するという案は時期尚早であり、有益でないとの考えを示した。

銀行が多額の国債を保有すると金利上昇に対して脆弱になり、銀行と国家財政の「負の連鎖」を招く危険性は広く議論されており、一部のエコノミストは、銀行が自国の国債に対するエクスポージャーを制限することを提案している。

パネッタ氏はトリノで開催された経済フォーラムで、こうした提案は「やや時期尚早である」と指摘。２０１１─１２年のユーロ圏債務危機当時よりも銀行の財務体質は強化されており、資本準備金に対する国債保有比率もはるかに低いと述べた。

現在の問題は長期金利の上昇にあり、こうした状況下で長期国債の購入余地を制限することは賢明でないと述べた。さらに、監督当局は銀行が国債や金利リスクに過度にさらされていないかを既に監視していると説明。その上で「現時点でこの議論を行うことはあまり有意義ではないと思う」と述べた。

items.title: Steep bill for AI buildout punishes Meta, other tech favorites
items.author: Lewis Krauskopf, Sudeshna Ghoshal
items.creator: Lewis Krauskopf, Sudeshna Ghoshal
items.summary: The tab for the next round of the AI buildout came due on Thursday.
items.body:
The tab for the next round of the AI buildout came due on Thursday.
Investors sold shares of Meta Platforms (META.O) and a wealth of companies central to the AI trade, a day after Meta — one of the hyperscalers spending billions to build data centers and other infrastructure supporting the AI boom — said it would issue a new class of shares that will help it raise funds.
Meta fell 7%, its largest drop since July. SpaceX (SPCX.O) declined 9% and semiconductor company Nvidia (NVDA.O) — a bellwether of the AI trade — dropped 4%. The Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) lost 2.6%, its largest decline since June 5.
Sentiment was also hurt by a 12% plunge in shares of semiconductor company Lam Research (LRCX.O) following its results. The Philadelphia Semiconductor index (.SOX) lost 6.7%.
The pullback is the latest test for the AI trade as investors focus on the rising costs of long-term projects where the payoff remains uncertain.
Tech firms have borrowed huge sums over the past year for AI spending, but Wall Street now expects that the rise in borrowing costs will motivate tech companies like Meta to sell billions of dollars in stock to fund the next round of building.
That dilution could put pressure on share prices, and is a potentially unwelcome development when major US stock indexes remain near all-time highs despite a punishing month of volatile trading.
RETURN ON INVESTMENT CONCERNS Selling started with "the big question about the (return on investment) on all the spending," said Matthew Maley, chief market strategist at Miller Tabak. "It's just becoming more and more evident to people that it's going to take a lot longer."
Thomas Hayes, chairman at Great Hill Capital LLC in New York, agreed that ROI concerns are central while also citing remarks by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang about a financing bottleneck for smaller AI companies as contributing to the selling.
Meta said on Wednesday it would use new Class C shares, which hold no voting power, to [USN:l4n4671s3 TEXT:"fund AI spending and other priorities"]. Meta also raised the low end of its annual spending forecast to $135 billion from $130 billion, with the high end unchanged at $145 billion.
That level of spending will require lots of investor participation in coming stock sales. Meta reported negative free cash flow of $2.12 billion in the third quarter, compared with positive free cash flow of $10.63 billion a year earlier. It was the first cash burn at Meta in more than a decade.
“More spending, negative free cash flow, not enough revenue being generated from the spend (is) concerning investors that this is just sort of a bit of a money pit,” said Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth in Fairfield, Connecticut.
The action highlights concern over how AI investment will be paid for. Credit default swaps, which track perceived default risk for the debt of the biggest AI players, have largely risen over the past year, with Meta’s hitting a record on Thursday .
INVESTOR ANXIETY SHOWS Fresh signs of market anxiety over AI spending snowballed into a broad market selloff Thursday, with some saying an AI pullback could hit US growth. Investors sought the safety of Treasury bonds, sending those prices higher .
"This is your classic rotation day,” said Joe Saluzzi, partner, co-founder and co-head of equity trading at Themis Trading in Chatham, New Jersey. “You can see the money going into Treasuries, so it's a classic safety move ... They are rotating out of techs, out of the AIs, and into the more safety trades, whether it's bonds or some of those big Dow Jones stocks.”
Thursday’s selloff added to the pressure on the neocloud companies at the heart of the AI buildout, with Nebius (NBIS.O) off 7% after announcing a new $3.5 billion credit line from Citigroup and CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , whose unsecured bond yields soared to 15% in last week’s AI selloff, down 10%.
Bank of America analyst Tal Liani said in a report on Thursday he is maintaining a buy rating and a price target of $140 on CoreWeave stock heading into next month’s earnings report, though he said he believes the firm will need to raise $20 billion to fund commitments to customers — the sort of prospect that is generating anxiety among tech investors.
"Nobody is worried about Meta or Amazon or Google getting the financing they need," Maley said. "But if it gets prohibitive for smaller companies, then you don't have to have an implosion of things to make people nervous."

items.title: Merck/Moderna cancer vaccine cuts melanoma death or recurrence risk by 42%, shares fall
items.author: Michael Erman, Julie Steenhuysen
items.creator: Michael Erman, Julie Steenhuysen
items.summary: Moderna and Merck said on Thursday that their mRNA cancer vaccine when combined with Merck's widely used immunotherapy cut the risk of melanoma death or recurrence by 42% in a large trial, potentially paving the way for a new era of personalized treatment.
items.body:
Moderna (MRNA.O) and Merck (MRK.N) said on Thursday that their mRNA cancer vaccine when combined with Merck's widely used immunotherapy cut the risk of melanoma death or recurrence by 42% in a large trial, potentially paving the way for a new era of personalized treatment.
Moderna shares have soared since the companies in August announced the trial's success without the actual data, nearly quadrupling through Wednesday's close. They closed more than 17% lower after the results leaked on an oncology website earlier on Thursday. Merck shares closed down about 1.8%.
The data from the Phase 3 trial of more than 1,100 patients also showed that the combination cut the risk of the cancer's spread by 38%.
It is the first data to show that the combination of a vaccine based on mutations unique to each patient's tumor plus a drug that helps the immune system fight cancer can keep the disease at bay. The vaccine, known as intismeran autogene, was tested along with Merck's blockbuster immunotherapy Keytruda, among the world's biggest-selling medicines.
Some analysts said the data may raise concerns among investors about how broadly the technology may extend to other cancers.
Keytruda works by removing a natural brake cancer cells use to hide from immune system attack, while the vaccine instructs the patient's cells to produce copies of specific mutations for the immune system to seek and destroy.
Moderna CEO Stephane Bancel said the data signaled a new chapter in cancer treatment.
"With this ability to create new T cells that are specific to your tumor... the clinical impact is very profound, and as we saw in the Phase 2 (trial), very lasting," Bancel said in an interview.
The companies are preparing to file for US approval and expect the cancer vaccine to launch in 2027, Bancel said.
The intismeran/Keytruda combination is already being tested in multiple other cancers, including kidney, bladder and lung cancer.
Bancel said he believes the vaccine should add to efficacy "everywhere that Keytruda works," but it remains to be seen how much it will improve results. Keytruda is approved for 19 types of cancer.
The CEO also said intismeran could work on its own as a treatment in early-stage cancers.
The Phase 3 melanoma results, based on patient data for the first two years after treatment, are scheduled to be presented on Saturday at the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting in Madrid.
Among those who received the vaccine in addition to Keytruda, 82.2% were still cancer-free after two years, compared with 70% of patients who received Keytruda alone.
"This is highly statistically significant. It is not by chance," Dr. Hussein Tawbi, a melanoma expert and trial investigator at the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center, said of the results.
Several Wall Street analysts said before the meeting that investors were looking for the combination to cut the risk of recurrence by 40% or more.
"We see optimism waning on pricing in multibillion-dollar (intismeran) franchises across oncology," wrote RBC analyst Trung Huynh. "This data makes us less optimistic as melanoma was supposed to be the best case."
The trial tested nine doses of the vaccine along with Keytruda, beginning 13 weeks after surgery to remove melanoma lesions. The response to the combination treatment was compared with that of the patients treated with just Keytruda, a standard therapy for melanoma.

items.title: Silver inflows likely to rebound as import curbs eased for Diwali
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: Fresh import permits are set to ease India's silver supply constraints and premiums ahead of Diwali, though demand is expected to trail last year's levels ...
items.body: India’s silver imports are set to rebound in time for the busiest jewelry-buying season after the government issued a raft of new permits, easing restrictions that had stifled shipments to one of the world’s biggest markets. Traders and bank dealers this week received quotas covering as much as 6,000 tonnes of silver, said according to four people familiar with the matter. The permits are valid for six months, said the people, who asked not to be named because they’re not allowed to speak publicly. The new licences “should be able to easily cover any demand spike,” said Harshal Barot, principal consultant at Metals Focus Ltd, a precious metals consultancy. “As a result, we no longer see a tight market and premiums are likely to ease substantially in the run-up to Diwali.” India imports almost all of its silver. The government  introduced new licensing requirements in May, one of a number of measures taken to preserve foreign-exchange reserves and defend the rupee.  Would-be silver buyers must now apply for a permit, and every shipment must be accompanied by a certificate proving the country of origin. The government also more than doubled import taxes on gold and silver, adding to the cost of buying. As a result, silver imports initially plunged to a fraction of the country’s demand. In June, monthly shipments hit a three-year low of just 37 tonnes. That rose to 328 tonnes in September, according to an estimate by Metals Focus, as a limited num­ber of permits were granted.  Demand for precious metals typically rises during the festival season that peaks with Diwali. With the latest permits granted, premiums paid to secure silver are likely to ease substantially, Barot said. Indian premiums dropped to around 50 cents an ounce over the global benchmark on Thursday, said Monal Thakkar, managing director of Ashoka Global FZCO, a precious metals trader. That was down from around $2 last week, data from Metals Focus shows. Last year, India imported over 7,000 tonnes of silver, a massive wave of buying that helped to trigger a historic short squeeze in the global market. Prices rose further as speculators piled in — hitting a record high above $121 an ounce in January — before slumping after the West Asia war sent energy prices surging, stoking global inflation fears. Spot silver was trading around $56 an ounce on Thursday. While demand has picked up ahead of the festival season, silver consumption is expected to pale in comparison with last year. Stocking by retailers and wholesalers has been subdued, Barot said, and fewer Indians are gifting silver this year. “We have not seen any meaningful dip-buying despite the price correction, as many investors are sitting on losses from silver bought last year,” he added.  Restrictions lifted Traders, bank dealers have received quotas covering as much as 6,000 tonnes of silverThe Centre introduced licensing requirements in May as a measure to conserve Fx reservesAs a result, silver imports initially plunged to a fraction of the country’s demandDespite demand uptick, silver consumption is expected to pale in comparison with last year

トランプ氏が共有した動画には、ジェームズさんが所属するセブンティシクサーズの選手たちと一列に並び、ウオームアップとして腕を振ったり、シュートの動作をする様子が映っていた。

items.title: Neocloud short sellers rack up $6 billion as AI debt fears deepen
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Short sellers betting against US neocloud and data centre companies have made about $6 billion in paper profits this month as AI debt fears trigger a sharp selloff. CoreWeave, Nebius, IREN, Applied Digital and Core Scientific face heavy short interest, highlighting growing concerns over debt-fuelled AI infrastructure spending.
items.body: Short sellers betting against US neocloud and data centre companies have accumulated about $6 billion in unrealised profits this month as concerns over debt fuelled AI spending trigger a sharp selloff across the sector, Reuters reported.The pressure has been particularly strong in companies seen as major beneficiaries of the AI infrastructure boom, with investors increasingly questioning whether aggressive data centre expansion can be supported by rising debt.CoreWeave, Nebius face heavy short betsShort interest in CoreWeave, IREN, Nebius Group, Applied Digital and Core Scientific stood between about 20% and 26% of their free floats, according to data analytics firm ORTEX, cited by Reuters.CoreWeave has seen its short interest rise to 23.7% of free float, from 19.6% at the start of October. Short sellers have made nearly $1.7 billion in paper profits from the stock this month after its shares fell almost 30%.Nebius has also attracted heavier bearish bets, with short interest reaching 20% of its free float, compared with 15.4% at the start of the year. Investors betting against the company have made $2.94 billion in paper profits in October, although they remain down $3.33 billion on a year to date basis.Data centre stocks face broader pressureShort sellers of IREN and Applied Digital have together made more than $1.2 billion in paper profits this month, while bearish bets against Core Scientific have generated another $115 million, Reuters reported.Across the five companies, around $17 billion worth of stock is currently sold short, ORTEX said. Borrowing also remains cheap for all five, potentially allowing bearish positions to remain in place.The selling continued on Thursday. CoreWeave and Nebius fell more than 4% in early trading, while IREN dropped 6.1%, Applied Digital declined 3.7% and Core Scientific slipped 2.4%.The moves highlight how quickly sentiment around AI infrastructure stocks can turn when investors begin questioning the economics of rapid, debt backed expansion.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

items.title: 仏でシャモンダウイルスのヒト感染確認、世界初　患者は死亡
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Sybille de La Hamaide

[パリ ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Sybille de La Hamaide

[パリ ２２日 ロイター] - フランス政府は２２日、主に牛などの家畜が感染するシャモンダウイルスについて、ヒトへの感染を世界で初めて確認したと発表した。患者はその後、死亡した。ただ、現段階で一般市民へのリスクはないとしている。

国際獣疫事務局（ＷＯＡＨ）によると、シャモンダウイルスは吸血性昆虫のヌカカが媒介する。牛のほか、馬やアルパカ、羊、ヤギでも確認されている。

政府の声明によると、患者はフランス東部でウイルスを保有するヌカカに刺された疑いがある。同地域では今春から夏にかけて動物の間でウイルスが広がっていた。

国連の世界保健機関（ＷＨＯ）は、今回の感染について仏当局と連絡を取っていると明らかにしたうえで、「現時点で得られている情報と近縁のウイルスの感染経路に関する知見に基づけば、これはヒトへの単発の感染例であり、現段階で感染拡大につながる可能性は低い」と説明した。

仏政府も、一般市民への健康リスクは確認されていないとした。

地元紙ル・プログレによると、患者はリヨン地域に住む６０代の男性。ストックホルムに本部を置く欧州疾病予防管理センター（ＥＣＤＣ）によると、患者は１０月上旬に死亡した。重い病気の治療を受けており、一般の人より感染しやすい状態だった。

items.title: US regulator is probing suspicious Iran oil trading, official says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission is probing suspicious oil trading activity around the US war in Iran and scrutinizing prediction market trading around elections, the agency's enforcement director said on Thursday at a conference in New York.
items.body:
The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission is probing suspicious oil trading activity around the US war in Iran and scrutinizing prediction market trading around elections, the agency's enforcement director said on Thursday at a conference in New York.
CFTC Enforcement Director David Miller made the remarks in response to a Bloomberg News story last week that said a CFTC political appointee had told market surveillance staff to retract a referral to the agency's enforcement team identifying suspicious trading around President Donald Trump's March decision to back away from strikes on Iran's power plants.
When asked about the story during a panel at the conference, Miller said the agency had "from the beginning" been probing the trading and that the investigation remained open.
The report fueled concerns raised by investor advocates and lawmakers over a decline in enforcement activity at the agency, which is dealing with an [USN:L6N43N0Y2 TEXT:"exodus of staff"] as it tries to oversee the growing prediction markets industry. Prediction markets allow people to bet on the outcome of various events, from US elections to sports games.
Federal lawmakers are starting to scrutinize the industry, and most Americans oppose the idea of betting on government actions or elections, according to a mid-October [USN:L1N45S0TL TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos opinion poll"].
Miller also said the CFTC is watching for problematic trading in prediction markets, including on election outcomes. He declined to comment specifically on the November US midterm elections.
CFTC staff "have investigated, and may have open investigations about some candidates who have placed trades on contracts that are based on their own elections," Miller said.

items.title: 米マイクロン、27年から全世界で業績連動報酬導入へ　台湾労組の圧力受け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Wen-Yee Lee

[台北 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Wen-Yee Lee

[台北 ２２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーは２２日、２０２７会計年度から全世界の従業員を対象に、四半期ごとの業績連動型報酬制度を導入すると発表した。人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームで得られた利益のうち、従業員への分配をより多くするよう求める台湾の労働組合の圧力を受けた措置となる。

マイクロンは、新たな制度は既存の年次インセンティブ制度を補完するものだと説明。韓国の競合サムスン電子やＳＫハイニックスの制度と異なり、マイクロンは利益の配分比率や従業員向けに確保された総額については開示していない。

マイクロンによると、四半期ごとの賞与原資は、２６会計年度を基準年として、税引き後利益から次四半期の予想設備投資額を差し引いた額を基に算出する。賞与の半分は決算発表後に現金で支給され、残りは１年後に権利が確定する株式で支払われる。

ただ、新しい生産能力が収益を生み出し始める前に工場や設備に多額の投資を行うため、この方式では基礎的な業績が改善しても、生産能力拡大の局面では支給額が制限される可能性がある。

今回の発表は、２１日にマイクロンの大規模な台中事業所の労組との間で成立した合意を受けたものとなる。桃園の別の労組との協議は、２２日時点で合意に至っていない。

items.title: FIFA opens bidding for 2030 and 2034 World Cup media rights covering US and Puerto Rico
items.author: Frank Pingue
items.creator: Frank Pingue
items.summary: FIFA opened the bidding process for US media rights to the 2030 World Cup on Thursday along with an option to secure the 2034 edition, adding that it has yet to decide whether to keep the controversial hydration breaks introduced this year that opened up additional advertising windows for broadcasters.
items.body:
FIFA opened the bidding process for US media rights to the 2030 World Cup on Thursday along with an option to secure the 2034 edition, adding that it has yet to decide whether to keep the controversial hydration breaks introduced this year that opened up additional advertising windows for broadcasters.
FIFA said in a press release that it was open to "innovative approaches" to reach large audiences and that the bid submission deadline is November 19.
Fox held the exclusive English-language FIFA broadcast rights in the United States for the last three World Cups, including the 2026 edition that was co-hosted by the US, Canada and Mexico, while Telemundo held the Spanish language rights during that same time.
Spain, which won the 2026 World Cup, will co-host the 2030 edition with Portugal and Morocco, although Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay will also stage matches to mark the tournament's 100th anniversary. Saudi Arabia will host the 2034 World Cup.
FIFA Chief Business Officer Romy Gai, speaking to reporters after the announcement, said world soccer's governing body is still evaluating whether to keep the hydration breaks that were put in place for the 2026 World Cup to help players cope with high temperatures but also proved lucrative for broadcasters.
The hydration breaks fuelled debate over their impact on the game, with some viewers complaining about being exposed to commercials during the three-minute stoppages in each half.
"If the average temperature will be higher than the normal average is in these countries we expect to confirm having the hydration break, but not automatically," said Gai.
"It's not the final decision because this is something that we need to further engage with all the stakeholders."
According to FIFA, the 2026 World Cup averaged 13.5 million viewers per match on linear and streaming platforms in the United States, up 166% on the 2022 World Cup in Qatar.
Earlier this week, [USN:L6N45Z0QE TEXT:"Netflix"] announced that it secured the rights to broadcast the 2030 World Cup in Spain and Andorra.
The Saudi climate will likely force FIFA to hold the 2034 tournament in the Northern Hemisphere winter, just like it did for the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, but Gai said that while it is a possibility the matter has not yet been discussed officially.
"It's too early for that. But this is something that we are concretely considering," Gai said when asked about staging the 2034 World Cup in November-December of that year instead of the tournament's traditional June-July slot.
"It will be further assessed and we will share the same comments with any bidders when it will be the time to sit down and analyze how it can be to play the World Cup in 2034. It is a clear possibility ... but it's not yet confirmed. So we need to understand more."

items.body:
［イスタンブール　２２日　ロイター］ - トルコ中央銀行は２２日の金融政策決定会合で、主要政策金利を１００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き下げ、３６．０％にすると決定した。市場予想とほぼ一致した。２月末に始まった米イラン交戦がインフレに与える影響を見極めるため５会合連続で金利を据え置いていた。エネルギー価格は大幅に上昇しているものの、輸入依存型のトルコ経済への影響が懸念されたほどではないとの見方から利下げに踏み切ったもようだ。

ロイターがまとめた調査で、２２人のエコノミストが利下げを予想。据え置き予想は２人だった。今年１２月の会合でさらに１００ｂｐの利下げが見込まれている。金融緩和局面は２０２７年に入っても続き、政策金利は２７年３月末に３３％、６月末に３１％、９月末に３０％、１２月末には２８％まで低下していくと見られている。

トルコの２６年９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前月比１．８４％上昇と市場予想を下回った。前年同月比では２９．７３％上昇した。ロイター調査で、２６年末時点のインフレ率予想は２９．５％。２７年末には２３．７％まで鈍化すると見込まれている。２６年の経済成長率は２．７％、２７年は３．７％に加速すると予想されている。政府は２６年の成長率見通しを３．３％、２７年は４．２％としている。

Oct 22 : AI safety evaluators METR and Redwood Research found several new vulnerabilities in OpenAI's internal system, including an exploit agents could have used to keep hundreds of their actions from being monitored, in a pilot review earlier this year.
The exercise, conducted from July 21 to August 11, gave outside researchers "a deep level of access" to OpenAI's internal infrastructure for so-called embedded evaluations, the safety nonprofits said on Thursday.
METR and Redwood said they each sent one researcher, tested an arrangement giving access to OpenAI's internal code, documentation and some technical staff. Both were accompanied on site and used OpenAI-issued devices that "never left the premises".
OpenAI told the safety organizations it has since patched all vulnerabilities affecting its production safeguards, although METR and Redwood said they had not verified the fixes.

AI labs, experts and the Trump administration have touted independent evaluation by outside reviewers as a way to safely advance the technology without slowing its development.
However, AI companies are worried that evaluator staff working inside the companies' walls could take proprietary information to rivals, Reuters reported earlier this month.
While OpenAI received a full 61-page internal report, METR and Redwood said they agreed to publish only a broad summary publicly, and gave OpenAI the right to redact sensitive information.
Unlike in some previous evaluations, they could not independently disclose those redactions, but said they expected greater transparency in future evaluations.
The researchers also identified a potential way for OpenAI's Codex agents to bypass security restrictions and act with their users' full permissions.
The evaluators assessed the monitoring system as it existed on and before July 21, and noted that OpenAI was expanding the system during the exercise.
OpenAI said the "findings helped strengthen safeguards as we expanded the system and will help shape future research collaborations with METR and other third-party evaluators."

items.title: Yes Bank unlikely to pay AT1 bond coupons despite bond holders demand, sources say
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: Yes Bank has announced potential non-payment of coupons on additional tier-1 bonds this fiscal year following a Supreme Court decision that annulled the previous write-off of these bonds. Bondholders are advocating for repayment based on the court's ruling, which emphasizes unsettled dues. Nonetheless, Yes Bank maintains it has ultimate authority over coupon payments, raising concerns about its financial losses impacting these obligations.
items.body: India's Yes Bank is unlikely to pay coupons due this year on its additional tier-1 (AT1) bonds despite a Supreme Court ruling overturning their write-off during the lender's 2020 rescue, two persons familiar with the matter said.The bank is preparing to seek a review of the ruling, one of the sources told Reuters, while bondholders press for payment of coupons that have remained unpaid since Yes Bank wrote the bonds off six years ago.Last week, India's Supreme Court upheld a 2023 Bombay High Court ruling that set aside Yes Bank's write-off of 84 billion rupees ($886 million) worth of AT1 bonds, in a setback to the lender and regulators that had defended the move.Yes Bank did not respond to an email seeking comment.The sources declined to be named as they were not authorised to speak on the matter.Retail investors holding the bonds said on Thursday they had not received coupon payments due on October 18, three days after the SC ruling.In a letter to Axis Trustee Services Ltd, reviewed by Reuters, investors sought clarity on the status of coupon payments and urged the debenture trustee to intervene. We call upon the Trustee to obtain immediate written confirmation from Yes Bank as to whether this coupon has been paid, cancelled or remains outstanding, bondholders said.They cited the Supreme Court order that payment of annual coupons shall remain unaffected by the outcome of these appeals and must be made in terms of the Information Memoranda. The sources, however, said the bond documentation gives the bank discretion over coupon payments and that the issue can only be considered once the AT1 bonds are reinstated on the bank's balance sheet.The losses the bank accumulated during fiscal years 2020 and 2021 are expected to be fully offset only by fiscal 2028, a third source familiar with the matter told Reuters. This could weigh on the bank's decision to pay coupons on its AT1 bonds, the source added.Yes Bank carries a debit balance of 52.79 billion rupees ($557 million) in its profit and loss account, according to the lender's latest annual report.
items.raw_description: Yes Bank has announced potential non-payment of coupons on additional tier-1 bonds this fiscal year following a Supreme Court decision that annulled the previous write-off of these bonds. Bondholders are advocating for repayment based on the court's ruling, which emphasizes unsettled dues. Nonetheless, Yes Bank maintains it has ultimate authority over coupon payments, raising concerns about its financial losses impacting these obligations.

items.title: 中国チベットでＭ7の地震、16人死亡・32人負傷
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２２日 ロイター] - 中国地震ネットワークセンター（ＣＥＮＣ）によると、中国南西部のチベット自治区で２２日午後１０時３３分（１４３３ＧＭＴ、日本時間午後１１時３３分）ごろ、マグニチュード（Ｍ）７の地震が発生した。国営新華社通信は現地応急管理局の情報として、１６人が死亡、３２人が負傷したと報じた。

ＣＥＮＣのデータによると、震央はチベット北部ナクチュの標高の高い地域に位置し、震源の深さは１０キロ。震央から半径５キロ以内の平均標高は約４８６４メートル。

ＣＥＮＣによると、中国で発生した地震としては２０２４年１月以来の規模。震央は自治区の中心都市ラサから約４００キロ離れている。

地元の公営メディアが公開した映像には、住民が自宅を出て屋外や路上に駐車した車内に避難する様子が映っていた。ある住民は、強い揺れで目が覚め、家がきしむ音が聞こえたと話した。 

今回の震央から約２８０キロ離れた隣接する青海省玉樹では、２０１０年にＭ７．１の地震が発生し、少なくとも２６９８人が死亡、約３００人が行方不明となった。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２２日 ロイター] - ２２日午前の米株式市場で、メタ・プラットフォームズの株価が６．５％下落し、一時約６週間ぶりの安値を付けた。同社のクレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（ＣＤＳ）
items.body:
[２２日 ロイター] - ２２日午前の米株式市場で、メタ・プラットフォームズの株価が６．５％下落し、一時約６週間ぶりの安値を付けた。同社のクレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（ＣＤＳ） も過去最高水準に上昇している。投資家は、急成長する人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェント事業の恩恵と、野心的なＡＩ事業拡大に伴う資金負担の増大を見極めている。

マークイットのデータによると、同社の債務不履行に備える保証コストであるＣＤＳは、５年物スプレッドが７．６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）拡大し、過去最高の１１４．７９ｂｐとなった。１日の拡大幅としては少なくとも２０２５年以降で最大となる見通し。

２１日終値時点では、株価は２６年に入って５％超上昇していた。現在の下落幅が続けば、時価総額は約８５０億ドル減少する見通し。

メタが２１日に発表した第３・四半期決算は、売上高が６４６億ドルと、ＬＳＥＧが集計したアナリスト予想の６３３億７０００万ドルを上回った。第４・四半期の売上高見通しも市場予想を上回った。

また、２６年の設備投資見通しを１３５０億─１４５０億ドルとし、従来の１３００億─１４５０億ドルから下限を引き上げた。

items.title: Monedas y bolsas caen por aversión al riesgo, que aviva ruidos locales
items.author: Manuel Farías
items.creator: Manuel Farías
items.summary: Las principales monedas y bolsas de América Latina cayeron el jueves, resintiendo una jornada de aversión al riesgo en los mercados internacionales que amplificaron los ruidos locales que enfrentan las principales economías de la región, y que van desde elecciones presidenciales a datos y futuros presupuestos.
items.body:
Las principales monedas y bolsas de América Latina cayeron el jueves, resintiendo una jornada de aversión al riesgo en los mercados internacionales que amplificaron los ruidos locales que enfrentan las principales economías de la región, y que van desde elecciones presidenciales a datos y futuros presupuestos.
* Los precios del petróleo se dispararon ante los temores sobre la oferta en medio de la crisis de Oriente Medio, mientras las acciones en Wall Street se desplomaron ante la caída de los papeles de firmas de crecimiento, después de que los resultados de Tesla y Meta no lograron disipar la preocupación por la inteligencia artificial.
* El yen y el franco suizo avanzaron contra el dólar, ya que los inversores buscaron refugio en medio de la aversión al riego. La divisa estadounidense subió contra el euro debido a los temores sobre los disturbios en Francia y la fragilidad fiscal del país.
* "El día de hoy, los mercados internacionales muestran un deterioro del apetito por riesgo ante la convergencia de dudas sobre la rentabilidad de la inteligencia artificial, nuevas tensiones energéticas en Medio Oriente y preocupaciones fiscales en Europa", afirmó Pepperstone en un reporte.
* El peso mexicano bajaba por la tarde un 0,23%, a 18,7126 unidades por dólar, tras cifras de inflación local. Poco antes del dato de inflación, el peso llegó a debilitarse hasta 18,8550 unidades, un nivel no visto desde septiembre de 2025.
* La [USN:L1N4680NW TEXT:"inflación general"] de México se aceleró durante la primera quincena de octubre, ligeramente por encima de lo previsto, informó el instituto nacional de estadística. La inflación subyacente, por su parte, repuntó de forma inesperada.
* "Ajustamos al alza nuestro pronóstico para el peso al cierre de año a 18,70 desde 18,10 con el balance de riesgos sesgado al alza frente a ajustes no anticipados en la postura monetaria relativa", dijo Banamex en un reporte.
* Mientras, el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado mexicano, cayó un 0,47%, a 69.921,75 puntos, luego de cinco sesiones de alzas consecutivas en medio de la atención a los resultados corporativos trimestrales.
* La moneda brasileña, el real , se debilitó un 0,22%, a 5,0384 por dólar, en línea con las monedas de la región; mientras que el índice de referencia de la bolsa, el Bovespa (.BVSP) , perdió preliminarmente un 1,3%, a 203.814 puntos, presionada también por ajustes antes del resultado de las elecciones.
* Los mercados brasileños están atentos a la divulgación de nuevos sondeos electorales previos a la segunda vuelta presidencial que se celebrará el domingo. Las encuestas muestran una leve ventaja del senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro sobre el presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, aunque las diferencias se han estrechado aún más.
* Algunas muestras de intención de voto los muestran incluso en un empate técnico.
* El candidato opositor ganó la primera vuelta aunque la mayoría de los sondeos mostraba una ventaja del actual mandatario.
* El peso chileno , cerró la sesión con una caída del 0,81%, en 986,20/986,50 unidades por dólar, presionado por un fuerte retroceso en los precios del cobre, el mayor envío del país. Asimismo, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) se desplomó un 1,88%, a 10.780,31 puntos.
* El cobre tocó el jueves su nivel más bajo en más de cinco semanas, ya que las nuevas entradas en los almacenes de la Bolsa de Metales de Londres (LME) aliviaron en parte los temores sobre el suministro, pese a que persisten las expectativas de cuellos de botella sobre la oferta regional fuera de Estados Unidos.
* El peso colombiano borró pérdidas subió un 0,50% a 3.174 unidades por dólar, tras dos sesiones de pérdidas; mientras que el índice accionario de la bolsa, el COLCAP (.COLCAP) , bajó un 1,25% a 2.528,49 puntos, con el mercado atento a la agenda legislativa del Gobierno en materia fiscal, después de que se fijó por decreto el presupuesto de gastos para 2027, tras hundirse en el Congreso por un vicio de trámite.
* A la incertidumbre se sumó la decisión del presidente Abelardo De La Espriella de remover del cargo al ministro del Interior, Rodrigo Lara, dos meses después de su posesión.
* El peso mayorista argentino cedió un ligero 0,13% a 1.528 por dólar, mediante un seguimiento habitual del banco central (BCRA) que ya alcanza compras por unos 15.730 millones de dólares en el transcurso del año, contemplando la absorción de 61 millones este jueves. El índice bursátil MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) de Buenos Aires, en tanto, cayó un 1,31%.
* Le agregó presión a los mercados el dato divulgado en la víspera que mostró que la actividad económica de Argentina (EMAE) cayó un 1,7% interanual en agosto, una cifra muy por debajo de lo esperado por analistas privados.

items.title: Anthropic IPO stands alone as AI market jitters sideline others
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: Anthropic plans to move forward with its initial public offering next month, navigating a challenging IPO landscape. While many companies in the AI field have delayed their public listings due to fluctuating interest rates and significant market instabilities, investors still see potential in Anthropic as a leading tech contender. Concerns are arising from the recent Oura IPO regarding institutional investor interest, emphasizing the heightened scrutiny on AI investment strategies.
items.body: A once-robust fall calendar for technology IPOs is down to just Anthropic.The AI lab is pressing ahead to hold its initial public offering as planned in the middle of next month after making its prospectus public as early as late October, people familiar with the matter said, cautioning the plan and the dates are subject to change.Anthropic's planned IPO will test whether its position at the center of the booming AI business, which the company is believed to deem worthy of a potential $1.5 trillion valuation, can overcome a market environment that might typically prompt bankers and deal lawyers to counsel delay. Anthropic is expected to begin marketing its shares to prospective investors during the week of November 9, one of the people said.For live updates on US Markets, click hereOther companies in the artificial intelligence infrastructure and data center sectors have delayed their listings, facing a rise in interest rates that has helped fuel a punishing selloff in shares and bonds of AI operators such as CoreWeave and broader questions about the sustainability of AI spending.The contrast underscores Anthropic's appeal to investors even as concerns about competition from open-source models and AI safety weigh on the sector.Many large investors remain bullish on Anthropic's prospects despite the fall turbulence, viewing the firm as one of the few opportunities to gain exposure to a technology sector that long-term investors cannot afford to ignore. Other issuers are reluctant to compete with Anthropic for institutional investors' attention and capital, two of the people said.Anthropic didn't immediately respond to a request for comment.VALUATIONS COMING UNDER PRESSUREThe AI sector pullback follows a string of IPO delays and withdrawals since September, as market volatility and rising interest rates have made it harder for companies to secure attractive valuations.Switch, a data center operator, and Nscale, an AI infrastructure provider, have pushed their IPO plans back to later this year, people familiar with the matter said, while stressing that plans remain fluid and subject to change. Nscale's delay was partly driven by the need to address comments from SEC staff, one other person said. SoftBank-backed SB Energy has also postponed its listing, Reuters previously reported.Switch, NScale and SB Energy didn't immediately respond to requests for comment.South Korean AI chip startup Elice was among the latest to shelve its listing plans overnight. Blackstone-backed AirTrunk REIT and Nvidia-backed Firmus have also pulled or paused their offerings, Reuters has reported.Oura's recent IPO has added to the caution among prospective issuers. The offering attracted little participation from long-only investors, a person familiar with the matter said, raising concerns about the depth of demand from institutional investors that typically provide a stable base of shareholders for newly listed companies.SCRUTINY ON MULTIPLE FRONTSThe retreat from AI infrastructure listings reflects growing scrutiny of the enormous capital required to build data centers and whether future demand will justify the investment.Recent developments involving CoreWeave have added to concerns about a potential slowdown in AI spending, although some market participants do not expect such a downturn to materialize.Nscale publicly filed its IPO registration statement in September, while Switch submitted its filing confidentially, Reuters reported previously. A confidential filing allows a company to work with regulators on its registration statement before disclosing financial and business details to the public. Companies typically publish the filing ahead of investor roadshows, when they begin marketing shares to prospective investors.

items.title: Sebi warns investors against fraudulent WhatsApp stock tip groups
items.author: Our Bureau
items.summary: The market regulator warned that unregistered entities use invitation-only WhatsApp groups, fabricated profit testimonials and overseas numbers to lure unsuspecting investors ...
items.body: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) on Thursday cautioned investors against unregistered entities offering stock tips and trading calls through invitation-only WhatsApp groups, warning of misleading profit claims and fraudulent practices. The operators, often using overseas numbers, pose as market experts and encourage members to post fabricated profit testimonials to create an impression of credibility. Sebi said members are frequently invited to new groups through messages from different numbers after the original groups are suspended or banned. The regulator advised investors to avoid acting on such tips, transferring money to suggested platforms or sharing trading account details, and to deal only with Sebi-registered intermediaries.  Mkt regulator allows margin relief against early pay-in of securities The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) on Thursday said that clearing corporations will not collect margins from trading and clearing members on clients’ subsequent buy or sell positions in the cash segment, up to the value of securities for which early pay-in (EPI) has been successfully accepted. It aims to provide margin relief to clients who have a net sell obligation in a settlement and have completed the EPI process through the clearing corporation.  BSE widens IPO fast-tracking to top 30 firms BSE Index Services will fast-track IPOs ranked among the top 30 companies into its indices, up from the top 10 at present. The change, effective October 23, applies to all broad and market-cap indices except the BSE AllCap Index, the circular said. For the AllCap, Size and Sector indices, IPOs in the top 30 by average daily total market capitalisation will be added with five days’ notice to clients.  Nippon Life India AMC Q2 profit drops 6% Nippon Life India Asset Management on Thursday reported a 6 per cent decline in profit after tax at ₹324.4 crore for September quarter primarily driven by a one-time exceptional item of ₹96.76 crore pertaining to Sebi settlement proceedings. The company earned a profit after tax of ₹344.64 crore in the year-ago period. Revenue from operations surged 21 per cent to ₹796 crore in the quarter.

items.title: S&P 500 y Nasdaq cierran con fuertes caídas porque dudas sobre IA provocan desplome de tecnológicas
items.author: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.summary: Las bolsas estadounidenses se desplomaron el jueves y el Nasdaq registró su mayor caída diaria desde junio, tras una serie de reportes de resultados que revivieron el temor por la magnitud del gasto en la carrera de la inteligencia artificial.
items.body:
Las bolsas estadounidenses se desplomaron el jueves y el Nasdaq registró su mayor caída diaria desde junio, tras una serie de reportes de resultados que revivieron el temor por la magnitud del gasto en la carrera de la inteligencia artificial.
El S&P 500 cerró en territorio profundamente negativo. El Nasdaq, con gran peso tecnológico y lastrado por los microchips, fue el que más cayó tras una avalancha de resultados relacionados con la IA.
Los resultados de Meta Platforms (META.O) superaron las expectativas de los analistas, pero sus acciones se desplomaron después de que la empresa matriz de Facebook reportó su primer flujo negativo de efectivo en más de una década debido a sus gastos en la IA y de que anunció planes para emitir acciones sin derecho a voto para conseguir capital.
Las acciones de Tesla (TSLA.O) cayeron a pesar de que el fabricante de automóviles eléctricos reportó inesperadamente un flujo de caja libre positivo en el trimestre y recortó sus planes de inversión para 2026.
El índice Philadelphia SE Semiconductor (.SOX) , que ha impulsado gran parte de las ganancias del actual mercado alcista, se desplomó.
Con la caída del jueves, el SOX ha perdido aproximadamente una cuarta parte de su valor desde el máximo histórico de cierre del 22 de junio, pese a que sigue mostrando subida en lo que va de año, superando con creces la ganancia acumulada del S&P 500.
"Es un día maravilloso en Wall Street", dijo Paul Nolte, asesor senior de patrimonio y estratega de mercado de Murphy & Sylvest. "La única parte del mercado que realmente está sufriendo aquí es la tecnología, que ha sido la niña de los ojos de los mercados hasta aproximadamente junio".
"Los inversionistas están empezando a darse cuenta de que hay algunas lagunas en el discurso sobre la inteligencia artificial", añadió Nolte. "Y eso está afectando a los índices, ya que estos tienen una ponderación muy elevada en el sector tecnológico".
Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) perdió 92,40 puntos, o un 1,19%, a 7.664,77 unidades, mientras que el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) bajó 690,28 puntos, o un 2,58%, a 26.008,86. El Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) subió 17,51 puntos, o un 0,03%, a 52.873,60 unidades.

items.title: Earthquake of magnitude 7 strikes China's Tibet, killing 16, Xinhua reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: An earthquake of magnitude 7 struck China's southwestern region of Tibet at around 10:33 p.m. (1433 GMT) on Thursday, killing 16 people and injuring 32 others, state news agency Xinhua reported, citing Nagqu City's emergency management bureau.
items.body:
An earthquake of magnitude 7 struck China's southwestern region of Tibet at around 10:33 p.m. (1433 GMT) on Thursday, killing 16 people and injuring 32 others, state news agency Xinhua reported, citing Nagqu City's emergency management bureau.
As of 2:25 a.m. on Friday, 11 of the injured were in serious condition while 21 sustained minor injuries, Xinhua reported.
Local authorities have found at least two people injured in a village near the epicentre, with some houses in villages closest to the epicentre showing cracks, the state broadcaster said. The quake is the strongest to hit China since January 2024.
The epicentre was in a sparsely populated, high-altitude county in Nagqu, northern Tibet, at a depth of 10 km (6.2 miles). The average elevation within 5 km of the epicentre is about 4,864 metres (15,960 feet), China Earthquake Networks Center (CENC) data showed.
Videos released by local officially run media showed people leaving their homes and seeking shelter outside or in their cars parked on the street. One resident reported being awakened by the strong quake and heard the house squeaking in the tremor.
The quake was clearly felt in the local area, CENC said. The epicentre was around 400 km from the Tibetan capital of Lhasa.
Local fire and rescue teams have mobilised and are heading to the affected region, state media said.
A string of smaller tremors of around magnitude 3 and 4 have been recorded in surrounding regions following the magnitude 7 quake, CENC data showed.
In 2010, a magnitude 7.1 tremor struck Yushu in neighbouring Qinghai province, killing at least 2,698 people and leaving nearly 300 people missing.

FAST

Oct 22 : Cable production capacity is emerging as a bottleneck for AI-driven data centre construction, Nexans' finance chief said, as demand rises faster than the industry's ability to expand manufacturing capacity.
Global cable capacity is tight and building a new cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) cable production line, known in the industry as a CV line, takes around three years, limiting how quickly suppliers can respond to demand, Nexans CFO Vincent Piquet told Reuters.
"Things can't move quickly and the people building these data centres are in a great hurry," Piquet said.
Data centres require large amounts of low- and medium-voltage cable to connect power infrastructure, with larger facilities consuming proportionately more medium-voltage cable.

The strain on power infrastructure is already delaying some projects. In September, Oracle issued a force majeure notice to a Blue Owl unit developing a large data centre in New Mexico, citing potential difficulties securing sufficient power for the site.
Piquet said grid constraints, while slowing some projects, were also supporting demand for Nexans' products and allowing the company to be more selective when allocating capacity.
French distribution network operator Enedis has moved from annual procurement agreements to contracts lasting six or seven years in order to secure cable supply, he said.
While Europe generally faces fewer grid-connection challenges than the United States and benefits from stronger electricity networks in some northern countries, Piquet said lengthy regulatory processes were delaying certain projects.
He said he did not expect demand linked to artificial intelligence to slow, although Europe's data-centre expansion was likely to be less pronounced than in the United States because private investment capacity was smaller and public funding played a larger role.

items.body:
Helen Coster

[２２日　ロイター] - バンス米副大統領は２２日、オハイオ州知事選で共和党候補のビベック・ラマスワミ氏の陣営が民主党のライバル候補に対して展開した攻撃広告を擁護した。また、共和党議員に対して「泣き言を言うのはやめて」、選挙に勝つよう呼びかけた。

問題の広告は、民主党候補エイミー・アクトン氏と疎遠になっている母親ドナ・アーサー氏が登場し、幼少期にホームレス生活を送り、性的虐待を受けたというアクトン氏の主張にアーサー氏が異議を唱える内容となっている。アクトン氏によると、１９７８年以来会っていないというアーサー氏は、オハイオ州民に対しアクトン氏に投票しないよう訴えている。 アクトン氏は、１２歳の時に継父から性的虐待を受けたと主張している。 

この広告は広く非難を浴びており、品位を欠く中間選挙戦の様相を浮き彫りにした。トランプ大統領の大統領選以降、右傾化が進んだオハイオ州において、ラマスワミ氏や他の共和党候補にとって逆効果となる可能性がある。 

こうした中、バンス氏は２２日、ラマスワミ氏や共和党のジョン・ハステッド上院議員と共に演説を行い、こうした反発を一蹴した。 

バンス氏は、ラマスワミ氏との集会に先立ちシンシナティで、「共和党の同僚議員たちへの私のメッセージはこうだ。自分が信じていると述べているものを本当に信じるのなら、広告について泣き言を言うのはやめて、残り１３日の選挙戦で勝利を収めるべきだ」と強調。

その上で「皆さんへの私のメッセージは非常にシンプルだ。テレビ広告についてどう思おうと、その内容と事実に注目してほしい」と述べた。

この広告は当初、スポンサー表記のないまま２１日に交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に公開されたが、その後、ラマスワミ氏の陣営が制作元であることを認め、広告の宣伝のために４００万ドルを投じていると説明した明らかにした。 

トランプ氏は２２日、広告について何も知らないと語った。

items.title: South Africa’s Trade With China Surges After Beijing’s Zero-Tariff Deal
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: South Africa’s trade with China has increased since Beijing introduced a temporary zero-tariff scheme for qualifying South African exports in May, offering Pretoria an opportunity to expand sales to its largest trading partner as relations with the United States come under increasing strain. South African …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
South Africa’s trade with China has increased since Beijing introduced a temporary zero-tariff scheme for qualifying South African exports in May, offering Pretoria an opportunity to expand sales to its largest trading partner as relations with the United States come under increasing strain.

South African exports to China rose nearly 25% year over year between May and August, while imports from China increased 23% over the same period, Chinese Ambassador Wu Peng said at an event in Pretoria on Thursday.

South Africa has been seeking to rebalance its trade with China, which is its largest trading partner. In 2025, South Africa exported about 222 billion rand ($13.5 billion) worth of goods to China and imported nearly twice that amount, Trade Minister Parks Tau said.

South Africa’s exports to China include agricultural products, minerals and manufactured goods. The government is seeking to expand access for higher-value products as it looks to narrow the trade imbalance and diversify its export markets.

Wu said he had heard South Africa’s concerns about the imbalance in bilateral trade and expressed confidence that Chinese market access for South African products would expand.

“I am confident more and more South African high value-added products will enter the Chinese market in the future,” he said.

China’s zero-tariff preference scheme took effect on May 1, 2026, and is scheduled to run through April 30, 2028, pending a broader economic partnership arrangement between China and African countries. The temporary measure covers qualifying South African exports that meet applicable rules of origin and documentation requirements, while certain products are subject to tariff-rate quotas.

The arrangement provides South African exporters with an opportunity to compete in the Chinese market without paying customs duties on eligible goods. However, the increase in trade recorded since May does not establish how much of the growth resulted directly from the tariff changes.

For Pretoria, expanding exports to China is part of a broader effort to develop alternative markets as uncertainty over access to the U.S. market threatens an established source of export demand.

The United States has extended the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA), which gives eligible sub-Saharan African countries duty-free access to the U.S. market for thousands of products, through 2028. South Africa, however, faces the risk of exclusion as President Donald Trump’s administration has criticized several of its domestic and foreign policies.

The Trump administration has accused the South African government of persecuting white people, an allegation Pretoria denies.

South African President Cyril Ramaphosa said on October 19 that the country must prepare for the possibility of losing its AGOA benefits, as his government pursues alternative markets and holds discussions with U.S. counterparts.

Tau said he expected an announcement in early November on whether South Africa would be excluded from the program, but remained “cautiously optimistic.”

The uncertainty has added urgency to South Africa’s efforts to diversify its export destinations, including through stronger commercial ties with China. However, expanding trade with Beijing does not necessarily guarantee a reduction in the bilateral trade imbalance, particularly as imports from China are also rising.

South Africa’s ability to benefit from the Chinese scheme will depend partly on whether domestic producers can increase exports of qualifying goods and move into higher-value agricultural, industrial and processed products. The tariff preference removes customs duties on eligible exports but does not eliminate other market-access requirements.

The two countries’ trade figures point to expanding commercial ties, but the challenge for Pretoria will be to translate that growth into greater export earnings and a more balanced trading relationship.

With a decision on South Africa’s AGOA eligibility expected in early November, the country faces pressure to strengthen its position in China and other markets while seeking to preserve preferential access to the United States.

items.title: 米ブラックストーン、第3四半期13％減益　市場混乱が逆風
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２２日 ロイター] - 米大手投資会社ブラックストーンが２２日発表した第３・四半期決算は減益となった。市場環境の混乱が投資回収の重荷となった。

世界の市場は、債券利回りの急上昇や高金利の長期化観測、イラン戦争に伴う相場変動の拡大で動揺している。

この結果、多くの案件が保留となり、２０２６年上半期の取引や新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）は減速した。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、第３・四半期の世界のＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収）は前四半期比４１％減少した。

ブラックストーンの投資回収に伴う収益は３４％減の約３億３２００万ドルとなった。プライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）事業で５０％近く減少したことが響いた。

分配可能利益（株主に還元可能な利益）は１株当たり１．３２ドルと１３％減少した。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の平均は１．２６ドルだった。

一方、６３０億ドルを超える資金の純流入が業績を下支えした。運用資産残高は１兆３７００億ドルに拡大し、手数料関連利益は６％増加した。

新規の資金流入はクレジット・保険事業が約３６０億ドルと最大で、ＰＥ事業が１２６億ドルで続いた。

ＰＥファンドの運用による手数料関連利益は２６％増の６億１９００万ドルとなった。

オルタナティブ資産運用各社の株価は２６年に入り下落している。今後の成長鈍化の見通しや、人工知能（ＡＩ）の進歩が投資先企業の事業に混乱をもたらす可能性に対し、投資家が慎重姿勢を強めたためだ。

特にプライベートクレジットに対する投資家の不安は強く、大手運用各社はここ数四半期にわたり解約請求の急増を報告している。

ブラックストーンは９月、同社のファンド「ＢＣＲＥＤ」への解約請求が第３・四半期も高水準にとどまったと明らかにした。ただ、投資先のファンダメンタルズ（基礎的条件）は引き続き健全だとの見解を維持している。

同社株は２６年に入り３０％近く急落し、他の資産運用会社とおおむね同様の値動きとなっている。一方、市場全体は１３％、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００金融株指数は約２％上昇している。

FAST

BRUSSELS, Oct 22 : Digital advertisers and publishers lobbied on Thursday for EU and UK regulators to suspend Meta Platforms' new commercial terms due to come into effect on October 30, alleging that these would give Meta an unlimited right to use their content for its AI services.
Advocacy group the Movement for an Open Web, whose members include digital advertisers and publishers, said it had complained to the European Commission and the UK's Competition and Markets Authority and requested interim measures.
Publishers worldwide are stepping up their fight with AI companies that use their content without permission to train large language models, underscoring the clash between copyright owners and those citing fair use arguments.
"Meta's new terms are clearly anti-competitive. Many businesses effectively have no choice but to use Meta's services and these conditions would force them to sign away the rights to their digital content with no means of opting out," Tim Cowen, co-founder of the Movement for an Open Web, said.

"The terms would give Meta a free hand to scrape content from nearly every website in the world, potentially using that data to power AI-powered services that would then compete with those businesses," he said.
Meta said it disagreed with the complaint.
"The crawling terms we consolidated only applied to our ads and business products, and we've clarified that in the terms themselves. It does not change how Meta uses web crawlers," a Meta spokesperson said.
"As always, content owners can use robots.txt to signal their preferences. This is not about scraping news sites, and these updates don't give us new rights that supersede those preferences."
The CMA said it met with Meta on Wednesday to get more details on its new business terms.
"This is an important issue and we recognise the concerns that have been raised by businesses in the UK. We are engaged in urgent discussions with Meta as we consider our next steps," a CMA spokesperson said.
The European Commission said it has received a complaint which it would assess in line with its usual procedure and that it was committed to ensuring that Meta's practices comply with EU laws. 
Companies requesting interim measures have to show that they will suffer serious and irreparable damage from the alleged anti-competitive practices.
The criticism by the Movement for an Open Web followed similar complaints aired by the European Publishers Council (EPC) last week and Germany's Digital Publishers and Newspaper Publishers Association (BDZV) and the Association of the Free Press (MVFP) earlier this week.    

Source: Reuters

Oct 22 : Nippon Steel will invest about $3 billion in the U.S. Steel-operated Mon Valley works in Pennsylvania to upgrade the plant's hot rolling facility, the Nikkei newspaper reported on Thursday.
The move is part of the Japanese steelmaker's pledge to invest $11 billion in U.S. Steel by 2028, following its acquisition of the company in 2025.
Nippon Steel did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours.
Mon Valley's hot rolling equipment, which heats slabs of iron from blast furnaces and rolls them into thinner steel, has been in operation for about 90 years, Nikkei added.
The new equipment is set to enter operation in the second half of 2029, which would enable production of higher-quality steel, the report said.
Nippon Steel raised its fiscal 2026 earnings forecast in August, lifted by stronger U.S. Steel earnings and a firm steel market.

Oct 22 : Anyone who has watched a manta ray glide over a reef knows how unhurried these marine animals can look. Yet researchers working off Costa Rica found their movements are varied, with juveniles staying nearby and close to shore while adults venture hundreds of kilometres.
Manta rays are among the ocean's largest fish, with wing-like fins that can span up to about 8 meters (26 feet) and the largest brain of any fish.
Researchers tracked endangered oceanic manta rays between 2018 and 2025, fitting 59 of them with acoustic transmitters and tracking 12 with satellite tags, along with photo identification. 
"By combining different technologies ... we were able to piece together a highly detailed map of their movements and their use of coastal cleaning stations," said Jeffry Madrigal-Mesén, director of the research group Mantas Costa Rica and lead author of the study published in the journal Frontiers in Fish Science.

A coastal cleaning station is a rocky reef site where small fish remove parasites from the skin of the manta rays in an example of symbiotic behaviour.
Researchers found that smaller, immature mantas stayed within Costa Rica's coastal waters, called its exclusive economic zone. Larger, mature animals undertook long-distance journeys, some reaching as far as the waters off Guatemala.
"This makes us believe that smaller mantas do not risk these long migrations, likely due to the threat of large predators like orcas and tiger sharks," Madrigal-Mesén said.
The smaller animals in the study measured around 3 to 3.5 meters across (10 to 11.5 feet), compared with around 4 to 4.5 meters (13 to 15 feet) for those making the longer journeys.
DANGER FROM PREDATORS
A juvenile, at around 3 meters across, would still appear enormous to most swimmers. Yet that size may not be enough protection.
Madrigal-Mesén said that "their massive size is one of their main defence mechanisms. It is quite common to see animals missing portions of their bodies, and in many cases, the shape of the wounds strongly suggests they are bites from other large marine predators."
What prompts mantas to eventually join the migratory population remains unclear, although researchers suspect that reaching feeding and breeding grounds in highly productive waters across Central America may play a role.
The manta rays also repeatedly return to the same coastal cleaning stations. Observations of feeding, courtship and recent mating suggest these sites may also function as social hubs. Scientists do not yet know how mantas navigate back to particular sites.
"Based on the bathymetry of the different sites we monitor, there must be a relationship with the rock formations. We humans have favourite places we like to go to," Madrigal-Mesén said. "Why couldn't mantas have a preference for one cleaning station over another?"
The findings also suggest the mantas may not roam as far as once thought. Researchers initially suspected that animals seen in Costa Rica might migrate from populations in Ecuador or Mexico. The tracking data instead raises the possibility that Central America has its own distinct population, something the team is now investigating through genetic work.
Mantas are particularly vulnerable because, like other rays and sharks, they reproduce slowly and take years to reach sexual maturity. Madrigal-Mesén said that once the animals left Cocos Island, a volcanic island in the Pacific Ocean, and most monitored coastal sites, they entered waters with no protection, exposing them to threats including fishing and vessel traffic.
"Studies like this help us recognise that these coastal havens only protect them for a specific time of the year. ... This is why it is so critical to protect the marine corridors these migratory species travel through."
Coastal mantas also showed strong site fidelity, with very few moving between monitoring sites even when they were only tens of kilometres apart. 
One male became a particularly striking example. Nicknamed "Mickey Mouse" for its distinctive spot pattern, the ray was repeatedly photographed at Cabo Blanco and tracked using both satellite and acoustic tags, showing a strong attachment to the site. 
But researchers have not seen this ray in Costa Rica for more than a year. 
"We have a lot of affection for him," Madrigal-Mesén added. "We hope he comes back soon."

NEW YORK, Oct 22 : The yen was on track for its strongest daily gain in almost a month on Thursday, as investors sought safety amid fragile equity markets, elevated crude prices from the drawn-out war in the Middle East, and doubts over future returns from artificial intelligence.
The US dollar, meanwhile, rose against the euro. Worries about social unrest in France and a worsening fiscal outlook for the country outweighed concerns about the AI trade, which pushed US stocks lower.
"AI is making people nervous, as is oil ... and as is France," said Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets.
Oil prices climbed about 3 per cent to a five-month high after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concerns of further disruption to energy supplies from the key exporting region.

The Japanese yen strengthened 0.75 per cent to 156.96 per dollar.
Some of the move in the yen may also be due to its approaching the key 160 level, which is seen as increasing the odds of further intervention by Japanese authorities to shore up the currency.
Kevin Ford, lead FX and macro strategist at Convera, called it "the intervention premium," noting that "every time the yen gets closer to the 160 line, that's where there's higher speculation that the central bank will intervene."
Against the Swiss franc, another traditional safe haven, the dollar weakened 0.42 per cent to  0.821 francs per dollar.
The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, fell 0.08 per cent to 101.60, with the euro down 0.09 per cent at $1.1222.
The dollar has become increasingly tied to capital flows and to growth and inflation expectations linked to the AI trade. It fell last week as fears over the AI outlook grew. On Thursday, however, concerns about France outweighed those fears.
"You have these competing stories and weak points between US AI-related credits and then France's sovereign credit, and we've seen this push and pull in the last couple of days where at times one is more of a concern than the other,” said Erik Nelson, global head of FX strategy at Wells Fargo. “As long as France is more of a concern than US AI credits, then you're going to see the euro underperform.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that "illegitimate" protests would be banned in the coming days and blamed "seditious" ultra-left groups and vandals for last weekend's riots and looting.
Concerns about France's ability to manage its huge debt burden have hurt French government bonds and raised worries about other heavily indebted euro zone countries. The spread between France and Germany's 10-year note yields reached 177.7 basis points on Thursday, the widest gap since 2011.
Sterling strengthened 0.05 per cent to $1.3401. The Australian dollar  weakened 0.11 per cent to $0.7019.
In cryptocurrencies, bitcoin fell 4.27 per cent to $81,023.

Oct 22 : The cost of insuring Meta Platforms' debt against default touched an all-time high on Thursday, as investors grappled with concerns about its plan to spend more on its AI build-out.
Meta raised the lower end of its annual forecast for capital expenditure to between $135 billion and $145 billion this year, up from $130 billion to $145 billion expected previously.
As a result, five-year credit default swaps widened 7.6 basis points to a record high of 114.79 bps and were set for its biggest one-day jump since at least 2025, Markit data showed. Its shares were last down 6.1 per cent at $655, hitting their lowest in about six weeks.
Meta also introduced new non-voting shares and reported a free cash flow deficit of $2.12 billion in the third quarter, turning cash flow negative for the first time since 2012.

"The market has been questioning whether all the spending on AI is having the type of returns that the market originally expected," said Steve Sosnick, chief market analyst at Interactive Brokers.
"In Meta's case, investors are interpreting the new non-voting shares as a backdoor for issuing more stock and diluting holdings eventually so I think that's adding to this aggressive selloff."
Investors are growing more cautious about debt-fueled AI spending in the face of rising borrowing costs, with neocloud firm CoreWeave at the center of a storm that has erased more than 34 per cent of its market value this month.
CoreWeave shares slumped 8.4 per cent on Thursday, while rival Nebius Group and data center operators IREN and Applied Digital also saw heavy losses.
US chip stocks, widely viewed as one of the biggest winners of the AI boom, also sold off heavily with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index set to erase more than $688 billion in market value on Thursday alone.
Five-year credit default swaps of hyperscaler Oracle were also close to a record high, while that of Amazon.com held near its highest level since March 2020, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence data.
Oracle and Alphabet shares dropped more than 2 per cent, while Microsoft slipped 1.3 per cent and Amazon fell 3.7 per cent.

items.title: 米新規失業保険申請6000件減の19.4万件、約57年ぶり低水準に迫る
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　２２日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン　２２日　ロイター] - 米労働省が２２日発表した１０月１７日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比６０００件減の１９万４０００件となった。レイオフ（一時解雇）の少なさを背景に、申請件数は１９６９年以来の低水準となった７月中旬の１８万９０００件に迫る水準にある。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２０万件だった。

週ごとの変動をならした４週間移動平均は１０００件減の１９万７７５０件と、１９６９年以来の低水準となった。 

エコノミストらは、堅調な内需を背景に企業収益が伸びていることに加え、退職の増加やトランプ政権による移民取り締まりで労働力人口が縮小していることが、労働者を解雇から守っていると指摘している。ただ、中東紛争の長期化に伴う金融環境の引き締めや金利上昇が、来年の労働市場に悪影響を及ぼす恐れがあるとの懸念もある。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「政権の移民政策により労働市場は逼迫し、企業は財（モノ）・サービスの生産に必要な人手を確保できなくなっているため、既存の労働者を手放さない状況になっている」と指摘。「多くの産業において、突如として労働者が代替不可能な存在となっている」と述べた。

今回の申請件数データは、１０月の雇用統計の調査期間と重なっている。 

１０月１０日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は２万５０００件増の１７２万８０００件となった。 ただ、継続受給件数には、大学を最近卒業した人や、職歴が浅い、または全くないために受給資格がない人は含まれていない。

長期失業者の一部が、大半の州で２６週間に制限されている受給資格を使い果たした可能性もあり、これが継続受給件数が低水準で推移する一因となっている可能性がある。９月の失業期間の中央値は１１．５週と、約４年半ぶりの高水準に近いものの、９月の失業率は４．２％にとどまっており、労働市場がインフレの要因とはなっていない。

ハイ・フリークエンシー・エコノミクスのチーフエコノ ミスト、カール・ワインバーグ氏は「米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、需要を抑制しスラック（需給の緩み）を拡大して、インフレ目標回帰を確実にするために金融引き締めが必要と判断すれば、来週にも自由に利上げに踏み切ることができる」と指摘。「雇用に関するＦＲＢの責務は明らかに満たされている」と述べた。
